# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.17.56-lts (c57540de480) FIXME as compared to v26.3.17.4-lts (00f5ad7bc29)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#109131](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109131): Fixed a performance regression (introduced in [#71781](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/71781)) where reading many small files from object storage via the `s3()` and other table functions stopped prefetching and fell back to synchronous reads, significantly slowing single-threaded / low-concurrency reads of lots of tiny files. [#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108872) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#109556](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109556): Issue the initial small-object prefetch also when object storage reads go through the filesystem cache (`filesystem_cache_name`). Previously ([#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108872)) the prefetch was restored only for non-cached reads, so reads of many small files (e.g. `S3Queue` ingestion) with the filesystem cache enabled remained synchronous and latency-bound. [#109478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109478) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#108850](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108850): Fix `DataLakeCatalog` databases with `catalog_type = 'onelake'` reading table data by using the OneLake Blob endpoint (`.blob.fabric.microsoft.com`) by default. Set `onelake_use_blob_endpoint = false` to keep the previous DFS endpoint (`.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com`) behavior. [#106843](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106843) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#110487](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110487): Fixed reading of the `auth_response` length in the MySQL handshake, where a length byte `>= 128` was interpreted as a multi-gigabyte value because it was read as a signed `char`. [#107384](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107384) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#110385](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110385): MergeTree can now read a compressed stream whose blocks use different codecs. This is the read-side prerequisite for adaptive codec selection (https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/105404). [#108592](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108592) ([Raufs Dunamalijevs](https://github.com/rienath)).
* Backported in [#109268](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109268): Restore `show_data_lake_catalogs_in_system_tables` as the setting that controls only `DataLakeCatalog` visibility in `system.tables`, `system.columns`, and `system.completions`. Added `show_remote_databases_in_system_tables`, enabled by default, to let users hide `MySQL` and `PostgreSQL` databases from those system tables separately. [#109082](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109082) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110414): I always find it difficult to add multiple metrics to the dashboard during debugging sessions. This patch adds a simpler way to add them directly from the source code or documentation. [#109449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109449) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#106436](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106436): Validate column structure before applying patches. [#99531](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99531) ([Seva Potapov](https://github.com/seva-potapov)).
* Backported in [#109542](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109542): Fix credential leak in query_log for paimonCluster, paimonS3Cluster, paimonAzureCluster, and deltaLakeS3 table functions. ### Documentation entry for user-facing changes. [#100529](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100529) ([JIaQi Tang](https://github.com/JiaQiTang98)).
* Backported in [#110423](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110423): Fix LOGICAL_ERROR crash "Unexpected number of rows in column subchunk" in native Parquet V3 reader when reading nullable columns with a WHERE filter. [#102628](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102628) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108867](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108867): Fix a server abort during `RESTORE` of backups containing tables with cyclic dependencies. [#103824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103824) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#109336](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109336): Fixed a race between `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN` and a concurrent `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` (or any background merge) in `MergeTree` that could silently replace the renamed column's data with default values. The race window between publishing the new in-memory metadata and registering the rename mutation in `current_mutations_by_version` is now closed by holding `currently_processing_in_background_mutex` across both operations. [#104822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104822) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#106547](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106547): Fixed a server crash that could occur when a query reading from PostgreSQL — via the postgresql table function, the PostgreSQL table engine, or a dictionary with a PostgreSQL source — was cancelled (for example with KILL QUERY) and cancelling the remote PostgreSQL query failed. [#105949](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105949) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#109525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109525): Fix `optimize_skip_unused_shards` did not apply (and force_optimize_skip_unused_shards falsely failing) when a `Distributed` table is queried through a `Merge` table or the `merge` table function, with the predicate applied above it. [#106250](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106250) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#106510](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106510): When deserializing Avro enum data, we don't validate the values, and if those are corrupted, it leads to OOB and abort. [#106476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106476) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#110818](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110818): Fix a server crash when moving an empty part to a `plain_rewritable` disk (for example with `ALTER TABLE ... MOVE PARTITION ... TO DISK` for an empty part kept by `remove_empty_parts = 0`). [#107040](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107040) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110656): Fixed wrong query results caused by the query condition cache when on-fly mutations (`apply_mutations_on_fly`) or patch parts filtered rows before `PREWHERE`. A query reading with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 1` could poison the cache so that a later query with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 0` and the same predicate skipped marks it should have read and returned too few rows. The same fix also covers row-level security policies, which are prepended as a filter ahead of `PREWHERE`: a query run under a restrictive row policy could poison the cache for a later query that uses the same predicate without that policy. [#107145](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107145) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108918](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108918): Incremental backups no longer store `S3` credentials in the `<base_backup>` locator of the `.backup` metadata file. Backups created with `use_same_s3_credentials_for_base_backup = 1`, or with explicit base backup credentials matching this backup locator, store a non-secret marker and are restored without extra restore-time settings; for backups created with different explicit base backup credentials or extra base authentication arguments, pass them to `RESTORE` with the `base_backup` setting. Backups created by older versions with embedded credentials remain restorable. [#107357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107357) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110339](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110339): Fixed `SELECT ... FINAL` and `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` returning duplicate rows after `CREATE TABLE ... CLONE AS`, `ATTACH PARTITION ... FROM` or `MOVE PARTITION ... TO TABLE` adopted parts from a plain `MergeTree` into a `ReplacingMergeTree`, `SummingMergeTree` or `AggregatingMergeTree`. The adopted part's merge level is now reset to 0 when the source and destination engines differ, so the destination deduplicates it on the next merge. [#107481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107481) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109788](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109788): Fixed incorrect results from distributed queries selecting `ALIAS` columns that share a common subexpression: columns could be misaligned and values returned under the wrong column. [#107675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107675) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#107821](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107821): Fixed the MySQL interface being unusable with `MySQL Connector/J` 8.2.0 and newer (including 9.x). The `info` field of the `OK` packet is now length-encoded, matching the MySQL server, so the JDBC driver can connect. [#107693](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107693) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#108396](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108396): Fix performance regression for Map subcolumns with PREWHERE. Closes [#107912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107912). Caused by: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99200. [#107988](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107988) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#110808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110808): A transient error while refreshing data parts of a read-only table no longer permanently stops the background refresh task. [#108034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108034) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110962](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110962): Hide sensitive info in system.query_views_log.view_query. [#108214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108214) ([Valerii Mordovskii](https://github.com/Fidelaggio)).
* Backported in [#109152](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109152): `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` now requires the new `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` privilege. Previously any authenticated user (including `readonly` ones) could run it and repeatedly reset the DDL worker state, blocking `ON CLUSTER` DDL. [#108460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108460) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109820](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109820): Restrict the model path of `catboostEvaluate` to the `user_files` directory, like `file()` and the dictionary sources. Previously the function accepted an arbitrary filesystem path with no containment check, which allowed probing the existence of and triggering reads of files outside `user_files`. Models must now be located inside `user_files`. [#108463](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108463) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109274](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109274): Fixed wrong results when using `SELECT [...] SAMPLE [...]` together with the query condition cache (setting `use_query_condition_cache = 1` which is also the default). [#108488](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108488) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108897](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108897): Fixed a server crash (stack overflow) caused by deeply nested expressions such as `[[[ ... ]]]` or `array(array( ... ))` when `max_parser_depth` is set to a large value. [#108493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108493) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109632](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109632): The MySQL wire protocol commands `COM_FIELD_LIST` (`mysql_list_fields`) and `COM_INIT_DB` (`USE database`) now enforce the same access control as their SQL equivalents (`SHOW COLUMNS`/`DESCRIBE` and `USE`). Previously they could disclose column names of tables the user only had partial column grants on, and switch the current database without the `SHOW DATABASES` privilege. [#108508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108508) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109569): Match `http_forbid_headers` case-insensitively. HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so forbidding `Authorization` now also blocks `authorization`, `AUTHORIZATION` and other case variants. Configured `header_regexp` patterns are now matched case-insensitively without needing an explicit `(?i)` flag. [#108509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108509) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110096](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110096): Fix a `SELECT *` projection returning a column's type default (e.g. `0`) instead of its `DEFAULT` value (e.g. `-1`) when reading a column added with `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT` after the projection was created. Reads from the base table were already correct; only reads answered by the projection were affected, until the projection was rebuilt. [#108569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108569) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#108663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108663): Fixed direct read from multiple partially materialized text indexes. [#108607](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108607) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#108893](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108893): Fixed a startup failure where a `DataLakeCatalog` database created by an older version (25.12 or earlier) with a malformed `auth_header` could not be attached after upgrading to 26.2 or later, preventing the server from starting. The `auth_header` is now validated only on `CREATE`, and on `ATTACH` the catalog is built lazily on first use instead of during startup, so a single misconfigured or unreachable catalog database no longer blocks server startup. [#108674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108674) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108823](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108823): Fixed partition and primary key pruning being silently disabled when a `LowCardinality(FixedString)` (or `LowCardinality(Nullable(FixedString))`) key column is wrapped in a function in the key, for example `PARTITION BY sipHash64(k) % N` with `WHERE k = 'literal'`. Such queries scanned all partitions instead of pruning them. [#108777](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108777) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108905](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108905): Fixed `insert_quorum = 'auto'` not rejecting inserts up front when fewer than a majority of replicas were alive. Such inserts now fail immediately with `TOO_FEW_LIVE_REPLICAS` instead of writing a local part and later timing out with `UNKNOWN_STATUS_OF_INSERT`. [#108800](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108800) ([Gagan Dhakrey](https://github.com/gagandhakrey)).
* Backported in [#109142](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109142): Fix a segmentation fault when merging `uniqExact` aggregate states with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` or `CUBE` and `max_threads > 1`. [#108928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108928) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109561](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109561): Fixed a server crash on asynchronous insert with deduplication when `optimize_on_insert` makes the inserted block empty (for example, rows summing to zero in `SummingMergeTree`). [#109229](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109229) ([Den Kalantaevskii](https://github.com/Diskein)).
* Backported in [#109626](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109626): Fix a data race (and resulting rare crash) in the parallel merge of `uniqExact` aggregate states with two-level sets, which could occur with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` and `CUBE`. [#109389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109389) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109656): Fix redundant file segment contention introduced in 26.1+. [#109577](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109577) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#109826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109826): Fix `system.tables` silently skipping databases for users with per-database grants when the query reads only the `name`/`database` columns. Introduced in 26.2. [#109723](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109723) ([Samay Sharma](https://github.com/samay-sharma)).
* Backported in [#110358](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110358): Make headers in `getClientHTTPHeader` case-insensitive according to [RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-5.1). Fixes [#103957](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/103957) by adding `authorization` to the filtered-out headers. [#109791](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109791) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#110900](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110900): Fix reading Iceberg tables whose default sort order references a column that needs quoting (e.g. `@timestamp`). Such tables were unreadable because the synthesized storage `ORDER BY` was built from the raw column name and failed to parse with `SYNTAX_ERROR`. [#110233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110473](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110473): Fixed a possible crash (heap-buffer-overflow) when a `quantileTDigest`-family aggregate-function state column was used as a `GROUP BY` key and serialized concurrently by several threads. [#110263](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110263) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#109914](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109914): Bump libarchive from 3.8.7 to 3.8.8. [#109874](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109874) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110256](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110256): Bump c-ares from 1.34.6 to 1.34.8. [#109905](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109905) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110869](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110869): Fix krb5 CVE-2026-40355 & CVE-2026-40356. [#109910](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109910) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#110544](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110544): Fix flaky test 04146_iceberg_orc_row_policy_prewhere on release branches. [#107970](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107970) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109029](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109029): Don't check empty schema in SchemaProcessor. [#108945](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108945) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#109099](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109099): Use try-lock in LRUFileCachePriority::tryIncreasePriority. [#109065](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109065) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#110218](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110218): fix startup_console_log_level removal. [#109858](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109858) ([Garrett Thomas](https://github.com/garrettthomaskth)).
* Backported in [#109983](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109983): CI: Pass -Zsanitizer=address to Rust in the combined address,undefined build. [#109950](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109950) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#110558](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110558): Fix flaky test_server_no_logging: poll for async "Restored console logger level" line. [#110033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110033) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.18.32-lts (bb40d836b15) FIXME as compared to v26.3.17.110-lts (59141459d99)

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#113887](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113887): Skip unnecessary mark file loads for JSON advanced shared data. [#107051](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107051) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#114383](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114383): Fix `LOGICAL_ERROR` exceptions when reading `Iceberg` or `DeltaLake` data lake tables through paths that can reach the read pipeline without a pinned `datalake_table_state`, such as concurrent `Iceberg` metadata updates or `merge` reads over `DeltaLake` tables. [#102033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102033) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114299](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114299): Fix dynamic cache resize race in 26.1+. [#103702](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103702) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#114903](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114903): Fix a rare `LOGICAL_ERROR` "Attempt to release query context that does not exist" and the accompanying server crash when reading `MergeTree` tables through a filesystem cache disk created with `enable_filesystem_query_cache_limit = 1`. [#107028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107028) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114446](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114446): Fixed reading Iceberg v3 tables whose Parquet data files contain reserved row-lineage columns (such as `_row_id`); the native Parquet reader no longer raises `ICEBERG_SPECIFICATION_VIOLATION` for reserved field ids that are not part of the table schema. [#107377](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107377) ([Greg Maher](https://github.com/gregakinman)).
* Backported in [#112790](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112790): Fix `type_json_allow_duplicated_key_with_literal_and_nested_object` not working with typed paths in JSON. [#108218](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108218) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#109169](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109169): Fixes a null-pointer dereference segfault in `StreamingStorageRegistry` that occurs when `StreamingStorageRegistry::shutdown` and `StorageObjectStorageQueue::shutdown` are called concurrently. [#108810](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108810) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#114712](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114712): Fix possible logical error "Unexpected substream ... for column ..." during bump of compatibility setting. [#109496](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109496) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#111115](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111115): Fix a segfault when a query arrives while the server is shutting down after an error during startup that happens in a narrow window between servers' startup and creating an exit scope for stopping and reaping of servers. [#109675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109675) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#113873](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113873): Fix out-of-bounds read in SerializationReplicated on the native protocol on corrupted indexes data. [#112331](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112331) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#114736](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114736): Fixed a crash when reading a Parquet file with inconsistent bloom filter metadata. Such files could also silently return fewer rows than they should. [#112498](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112498) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#113374](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113374): Fixed server startup and `ATTACH` failing with `WITH RECURSIVE is not supported with the old analyzer` for a view with a recursive CTE when `enable_analyzer = 0` is the server default. [#112784](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112784) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#113790](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113790): Fixed a case where `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Distributed(...)` without a column list could reveal the structure of a local table the creating user is not allowed to see. For a `CREATE` the local server executes itself, the structure is now inferred under the user's own context, so `SHOW COLUMNS` on the target table is required, as it already is for the `Remote` engine. A `CREATE` replayed from the DDL queue (`ON CLUSTER`, or one inside a `Replicated` database) is not covered. [#113220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113220) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113929](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113929): Fixed reading the internal `_temporary_and_external_tables` database through the `merge` table function and the `Merge` table engine, which allowed one session to read the temporary tables of other sessions and other users, and caused an exception on the old analyzer path. A database regexp now skips that database, and naming it explicitly is denied, the same way as direct access to it is. [#113224](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113224) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113495](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113495): Fix a rare use-after-free bug that is triggered in a rare event of the async insert queue having different entries with identical deadlines. Now it's handled gracefully. [#113363](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113363) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#113801](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113801): Fixed a case where `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Buffer(...)` without a column list could reveal the structure of a destination table the creating user is not allowed to see. For a `CREATE` the local server executes itself, the structure is now inferred under the user's own context, so `SHOW COLUMNS` on the destination is required, as it already is for `Merge` and `Remote`. A `CREATE` replayed from the DDL queue (`ON CLUSTER`, or inside a `Replicated` database) is not covered. [#113372](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113372) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114332](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114332): Fixed `ATTACH` of a `Kafka` table when `kafka_num_consumers` exceeds the limit derived from the number of CPU cores. [#113390](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113390) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#114308](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114308): Fixed a row policy containing a scalar subquery being evaluated only once and then reused forever after the table had been read through a `Merge` table. The parsed policy condition is cached and shared by all queries, and reading it through `Merge` rewrote the cached expression in place, which also caused a data race between concurrent queries using the same policy. [#113563](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113563) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114808): Fix `CANNOT_CONVERT_TYPE` and an exception in `GroupingAggregatedTransform` when reading a `Merge` table with one child being a `Distributed` table under custom-key parallel replicas (`parallel_replicas_mode = 'custom_key_sampling'` or `'custom_key_range'`). Closes [#113741](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113741). [#113742](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113742) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114717](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114717): Fixed `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` returning fewer rows than requested, possibly none, when a row policy was the only filter of the query and the sort column had a `minmax` skip index. The top-K optimization narrowed the read before the row policy was applied. [#114073](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114073) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114875](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114875): Fixed heap memory corruption when reading Parquet through an input format that owns its read buffer, for example a dictionary with `SOURCE(FILE(... format 'Parquet'))`. Background prefetch and decode tasks could still read and write through the buffer after the pipeline released it, which could abort the server. [#114668](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114668) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#113546](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113546): Update the vendored `libexpat` to 2.8.2. [#112593](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112593) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113166](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113166): Update `simdjson` to v4.6.5. [#112594](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112594) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113539](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113539): Update Apache Arrow to 25.0.0 and Apache ORC to 2.3.1. [#112604](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112604) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113536): Update Protocol Buffers to v35.1 and gRPC to v1.83.0. [#112614](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112614) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#113948](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113948): Fix flaky `test_insert_select_from_cluster_with_partition_pruning`. [#105525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105525) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113973](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113973): Unflaky `test_kafka_engine_put_errors_to_stream`. [#107025](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107025) ([János Benjamin Antal](https://github.com/antaljanosbenjamin)).
* Backported in [#114224](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114224): Iterate ColumnObject subcolumns in sorted path order. [#112601](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112601) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#113785](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113785): Keep the Map `bucket_indexes` stream in sync when rows are skipped. [#113047](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113047) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113829](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113829): Make the boolean case of `04308_arrow_oob_reads_value` corrupt only the declared row count, so it reaches the per-element bit-packed buffer guard it is meant to cover. [#113593](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113593) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Map arrow `OutOfMemory` status to `MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` when reading Parquet record batches (26.3). [#113970](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113970) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.19.3-lts (5a1dec715af) FIXME as compared to v26.3.18.32-lts (bb40d836b15)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#115089](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115089): `RESTORE` now fsyncs the restored part files when the destination table has `fsync_after_insert` enabled, so a restored part is as durable against power loss as an inserted one. Previously restored files were only written and closed (never fsynced), so a power loss right after `RESTORE` returned `RESTORED` could leave the parts torn and the table empty. [#111378](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111378) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Use curl 8.21.0. [#115211](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115211) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.2.3-lts (a1a0cf365ce) FIXME as compared to v26.3.1.896-lts (c152d9127cd)

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#100900](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100900): Added bucketed serialization for Map columns in MergeTree (`map_serialization_version = 'with_buckets'`). Keys are split into hash-based buckets so that reading a single key (`m['key']`) only reads one bucket instead of the entire column, providing 2-49x speedup for single-key lookups depending on map size. The number of buckets and the bucketing strategy can be controlled by new MergeTree settings: `map_serialization_version`, `max_buckets_in_map`, `map_buckets_strategy`, `map_buckets_coefficient`, and `map_buckets_min_avg_size`. The setting `map_serialization_version_for_zero_level_parts` allows keeping basic serialization for inserts to avoid write overhead while merged parts use buckets. Skip indexes on `mapKeys/mapValues` are supported with bucketed serialization. The `optimize_functions_to_subcolumns` pass rewrites `m['key']` to a per-key subcolumn read when buckets are available. [#99200](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99200) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#100866](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100866): Fix `If`, `Distinct`, `DistinctIf`, `IfState ` aggregate function combinators with `Tuple` return type and one or more `Nullable` argument not being able to read older serialized states after introduction of `Nullable(Tuple)`. Closes [#98917](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/98917). [#100826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100826) ([Nihal Z. Miaji](https://github.com/nihalzp)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.20.7-lts (22647405581) FIXME as compared to v26.3.19.3-lts (5a1dec715af)

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#115214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115214): The hive partitioning sample path for object storage tables (e.g. `S3`) is resolved on the first use of the table instead of `CREATE`/`ATTACH`, so an unreachable endpoint no longer blocks table creation and server startup. [#111842](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111842) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#115419](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115419): Fixed `singleValueOrNullMerge` returning a concrete value instead of `NULL` when merging a state that had already observed multiple distinct values. [#105734](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105734) ([Minh Vu](https://github.com/fallintoplace)).
* Backported in [#115284](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115284): Fixes cases where row policy was not used for MergeTree Projections during query execution. [#112329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112329) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#115208](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115208): Fix `DROP TABLE` and `SYSTEM STOP VIEW` hanging when a Refreshable Materialized View is blocked while planning its refresh query. [#113188](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113188) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#115367](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115367): Disable distributed index analysis with projections (wrong results). [#115132](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115132) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#114700](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114700): Update `libssh` to 0.12.0. [#108329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108329) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.21.7-lts (eab23fa14e8) FIXME as compared to v26.3.20.7-lts (22647405581)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#115430](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115430): Fix exception when Iceberg metadata file path setting contains a null byte. [#100283](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100283) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#106555](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106555): Fix a server crash (SIGSEGV) reachable by any user with `CREATE TABLE` rights when sending `CREATE TABLE ... TO INNER UUID '...'` without an `ENGINE` clause over HTTP or the native protocol. The same bug also crashed the client. The parser now reports a proper `BAD_ARGUMENTS` error instead of dereferencing a null pointer. [#105579](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105579) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115449): Fixed `CREATE OR REPLACE MATERIALIZED VIEW ... POPULATE` leaving the new view unsubscribed from its source table, which silently dropped every row inserted after the replace. [#108728](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108728) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114892](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114892): Fixes a bug where an access entity carrying a `Map`-valued setting, such as a settings profile with `http_response_headers` or `additional_table_filters`, is stored in a form that ClickHouse cannot read back, leaving the entity permanently unloadable after a restart. [#114620](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114620) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115469): Fixed wrong results for `SELECT count(arrayJoin(arr))` with the default `optimize_trivial_count_query = 1`. The stored row count was returned instead of the number of array elements, and on `file()` and `url()` the query returned `0`. Closes [#115123](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115123). [#115227](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115227) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115599](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115599): Fixed `uniq`, `uniqExact`, `uniqHLL12` and `uniqTheta` returning a wrong result for an argument wrapped in an injective function that hides nullability, such as `uniqExact(tuple(x))` over a `Nullable` column. The `optimize_injective_functions_inside_uniq` optimization removed the wrapping function, after which NULL rows were skipped instead of counted. [#115466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115466) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.22.7-lts (ff4a967c271) FIXME as compared to v26.3.21.7-lts (eab23fa14e8)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#114797](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114797): Fixed a use-after-free when a `JOIN` with `join_algorithm = 'direct'` onto a dictionary was given a join key that is stored with sparse serialization. `getColumnVectorData` returned a reference to a temporary column, so the dictionary lookup read freed memory: release builds could return wrong results and debug or sanitizer builds aborted. [#112327](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112327) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115438](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115438): Reject corrupted/malicious dictionary where `lcp` exceeds the previous token or `lcp + data_size` overflows, before the buffer write. [#114155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114155) ([Elmi Ahmadov](https://github.com/ahmadov)).
* Backported in [#116147](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116147): Fixed a row policy bypass where the mergeTreeIndex table function exposed primary key and minmax index values of the rows hidden by a SELECT row policy on the source table; reading mergeTreeIndex for a table with a row policy is now denied. [#115304](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115304) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#115728](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115728): Fixed a bug in the function `formatRowNoNewline` that could produce incorrect results or a logical error when a row is formatted to an empty result. [#115669](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115669) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116110](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116110): Add Objects' paths to deduplication hashing, preventing incorrect deduplication. [#115866](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115866) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#115240](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115240): This patch: 1. Removes the global error screen (blue screen) and replaces it with a note above the dashboards. In this approach, on any error, already fetched graphs will not be hidden. 2. Dashboard now opens the graphs view immediately. 3. Reload button and any other button can be pressed during runtime refresh - this will cancel all in-flight queries and start a new refresh with the new configuration immediately. 4. Newly added graphs do not trigger a full page refresh; only new graphs will be fetched. [#115019](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115019) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.23.7-lts (19fdace0b54) FIXME as compared to v26.3.22.7-lts (ff4a967c271)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#115912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115912): Fixes `has`, `indexOf`, `countEqual`, `mapContainsKey`, `mapContainsValue` and `Map` subscript returning "not found" for a constant `LowCardinality` needle equal to the element type's default value, such as an empty `String` or a zero number. [#114624](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114624) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115536): Fix propagation of query settings and NULL handling in `accurateCastOrDefault`. [#114912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114912) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116061](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116061): Fixed a hang when dropping a `TimeSeries` table whose name sorts lexicographically below its inner tables' names, for example `` DROP TABLE `-ts` `` or dropping a materialized view declared with `ENGINE = TimeSeries`. The drop self-deadlocked on the DDL guard and could not be cancelled with `KILL QUERY`. [#114953](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114953) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116264](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116264): Fixed a bypass of settings constraints: `SET <name> = DEFAULT` reset a setting without checking the constraints from the user's profile, so a `MIN`/`MAX`/`CONST` constraint could be escaped by resetting the setting instead of assigning to it, and a session could leave readonly mode with `SET readonly = DEFAULT`. [#115334](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115334) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116350](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116350): Validate the states of the `stochasticLinearRegression`, `stochasticLogisticRegression`, `groupUniqArray`, `groupArrayIntersect` and `topK` aggregate functions and of the `Resample` combinator on deserialization: a malformed state could be read out of bounds. [#115701](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115701) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115927](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115927): Do not return uninitialized memory in the result of a binary string literal whose length is not a multiple of eight, and from the LZ4 decompressor when a compressed block has no body. [#115704](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115704) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

* Backported in [#116533](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116533): Fixed an out-of-bounds read while deserializing corrupted posting lists of a text index. [#115222](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115222) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).

[#115976](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115976) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

### ClickHouse release v26.3.26.3-lts (4545d1a94b0) FIXME as compared to v26.3.25.2-lts (a85663dca31)

### ClickHouse release v26.3.27.3-lts (22b1ff96abf) FIXME as compared to v26.3.26.3-lts (4545d1a94b0)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#116762](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116762): Fix a crash for `ORDER BY ALL` in a `WINDOW VIEW`, and `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` errors for `INTERPOLATE`, `WINDOW` and `LIMIT BY` in a query over a `Merge` or `Distributed` table with a join, with the old analyzer. # 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.28.5-lts (5e3081f5df4) FIXME as compared to v26.3.27.3-lts (22b1ff96abf)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#117289](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117289): Sped up SQL function `formatDateTime` with non-const timezone arguments. [#116851](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116851) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#113850](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113850): Added fs cache download wait timeout configured by `filesystem_cache_wait_for_concurrent_download_timeout_milliseconds`. This timeout defined only the wait for a single chunk (buffer bytes of ~1mb) of data, not the whole file segment. [#113322](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113322) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#117154](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117154): Fixed a settings-constraint bypass: a `SETTINGS` clause inside a subquery, a CTE or a view's inner query was applied without checking the settings constraints, so it could be used to leave readonly mode or to override a `CONST`, `MIN` or `MAX` constraint (for example `additional_table_filters`, breaking row-level isolation). The nested clause is now clamped to the constraints: violating changes are dropped, out-of-bounds values are clamped into their bounds, and the rest of the clause applies. Existing views whose inner query carries such a clause keep working, with the constraints enforced; a clause on the outer query still throws, as before. [#115397](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115397) ([Itamar Tempelhof](https://github.com/tempel-it)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#117360](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117360): This patch fixes `removePartAndCoveredParts` when it is being called for a part that is actually present in the active data part set. The problem was that part itself will always be in `parts_covered_by,` so the subsequent remove in the loop will not be able to remove it twice. [#115640](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115640) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.29.7-lts (9d44dc7ea69) FIXME as compared to v26.3.28.5-lts (5e3081f5df4)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#116719](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116719): Fixed a credential leak where the legacy `storage_aws_access_key_id`, `storage_aws_secret_access_key`, `storage_catalog_credential`, and `storage_auth_header` settings of the `DataLakeCatalog` database engine were shown in plaintext in `system.databases.engine_full` and `SHOW CREATE DATABASE`. They are now redacted as `[HIDDEN]`. [#108470](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108470) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117502](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117502): Fix `allow_feature_tier` rejecting `merge_tree_`-prefixed settings in settings profiles as unknown, and rejecting `CREATE TABLE` because of `MergeTree` settings set by the server through `compatibility` or the `merge_tree` config section. Also fix constraints on a `merge_tree_`-prefixed setting being bypassed when the setting is written through its alias, and a statement that rewrites the value such a setting already has being refused by a `CONST` constraint. [#113156](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113156) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#117470](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117470): Fix a case where expensive ZooKeeper exception logging could delay session finalization and leave pending requests unresolved. [#115396](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115396) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#116650](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116650): Fix crashes of the Parquet, ORC and Iceberg readers on malformed input: a `DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY` page with an empty length stream, a `DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY` page of a `Decimal` column read under a filter, an out-of-range enum in an Iceberg manifest file and an oversized allocation in the ORC library. [#115703](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115703) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117073](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117073): Fix a crash of a window function over a `Tuple` with a sparse element, for example `groupConcat(t) OVER ()`. [#115705](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115705) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116708](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116708): Fix wrong window function results for `PARTITION BY` over a floating-point key (also `JSON`, `Dynamic`, and these types nested in `Nullable`/`LowCardinality`/`Array`/`Tuple`/`Map`/`Variant`) with `max_threads > 1`: values that compare as equal, such as `-0.` and `0.`, could hash into different threads, and one logical partition got several window frames. [#116315](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116315) ([Alexander Gololobov](https://github.com/davenger)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.3.20-lts (5342e88d453) FIXME as compared to v26.3.2.3-lts (a1a0cf365ce)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#101224](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101224): Fix async insert queries reporting zero `written_rows`, `read_rows`, and `result_rows` in `query_log` and client output. [#99879](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99879) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#100891](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100891): Validate file entry paths in backup metadata to reject path traversal, absolute paths, and empty names during `RESTORE`. [#100483](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100483) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#101394](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101394): Fix `session_timezone` being ignored when parsing `DateTime` values during async inserts (TCP) and all inserts over HTTP. [#100647](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100647) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#100922](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100922): Fix server crash when using `has()` function with PREWHERE/WHERE on a Tuple key containing LowCardinality elements. [#100760](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100760) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#101187](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101187): Fix null pointer dereference segfault when loading dictionaries during server shutdown. `Context::getUserDefinedSQLObjectsStorage` (dereferences `user_defined_sql_objects_storage`) is called by dictionary threads concurrently with the main thread calling `Context::shutdown` (sets `user_defined_sql_objects_storage` to null). We need to make sure we disable future updates in the dictionaries loader, kill the currently running dictionary queries and join the dictionary loading threads - all before running `Context::shutdown`. Similar to what we do with normal queries. [#100839](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100839) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#101091](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101091): Fix buffer overflow in `ULIDStringToDateTime` when input contains non-ASCII bytes. [#100843](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100843) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#101015](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101015): Fix exception in `intDiv`/`intDivOrZero` on arrays of nullable tuples, e.g. `SELECT intDiv([divide((1, 2), ... AND NULL)], 2)`. [#100895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100895) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#101250](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101250): Evaluate engine arguments for `StorageAlias` before storing the definition, so that expressions like `currentDatabase()` are resolved to literals before being saved to the database. [#100902](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100902) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#101140](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101140): Fixed a crash when using a text search index with an `IN` clause containing a tuple subquery, e.g. `WHERE (id, str) IN (SELECT (id, str) FROM ...)`, or when the number of columns in the subquery does not match the tuple on the left side of `IN`. [#100959](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100959) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#101080](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101080): Fix `sumCountOrDefault` aggregate function with one or more `Nullable` argument not being able to read older serialized states after introduction of `Nullable(Tuple)`. Closes [#100882](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100882). [#101021](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101021) ([Nihal Z. Miaji](https://github.com/nihalzp)).
* Backported in [#101169](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101169): Fix exception in `optimizeLazyMaterialization` when a projection with PREWHERE is used with `ORDER BY ... LIMIT`. [#101115](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101115) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#101349](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101349): Fix a case which can lead to `Having zero bytes, ...` logical error from cache arising from a remote object being overwritten in between `list` and `read` which previously resulted in a stale object metadata. [#101219](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101219) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#101373](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101373): ... [#101230](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101230) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).

#### NO CL CATEGORY

* Backported in [#101392](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101392):. [#101241](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101241) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#101198](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101198): This patch fixes cache disk startup, which, before this patch, skipped the access check. [#99741](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99741) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#100970](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100970): Fixes [#99996](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/99996). [#100064](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100064) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#100808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100808): This patch changes the behaviour of `removeObjectsIfExist` from a sequential removal loop to batch removal. [#100522](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100522) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#101002](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101002): Properly recalculate locations after config reload. [#100907](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100907) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#101341](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101341): fix double count result rows. [#101226](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101226) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).

### ClickHouse release v26.3.30.9-lts (a7132c33074) FIXME as compared to v26.3.29.7-lts (9d44dc7ea69)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#117557](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117557): Fix a server crash in predicate pushdown (`enable_optimize_predicate_expression`, legacy analyzer) when a `UNION` subquery appears inside a `JOIN ... ON` condition. [#107930](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107930) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117458](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117458): Fixed `parallel_view_processing` setting being ignored when inserting into a table with materialized views — since 25.10, views always ran in parallel regardless of the setting. [#109170](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109170) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#117748](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117748): Fixed reading a corrupted `Native`-format stream whose `Dynamic` type count or `JSON`/`Object` path count is close to `SIZE_MAX`: such malformed input is now rejected with a clear `INCORRECT_DATA` error instead of an uncaught `std::length_error`. [#110590](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110590) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117691](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117691): Fixes memory leaks of abandoned nested aggregate states. [#113926](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113926) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117750](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117750): Fixed silently incorrect results and undefined behavior when reading a malformed `AggregateFunction(uniq, ...)` state. The `skip_degree` field of the serialized state was used as a shift exponent without validation, so an out-of-range value produced an arbitrary cardinality instead of an error. Such states are now rejected with `INCORRECT_DATA`. [#115276](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115276) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115751](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115751): Fix `read_rows`, `read_bytes`, `written_rows` and `written_bytes` in `system.query_thread_log` reporting a thread lifetime running total instead of the values for the logged query. Rows of long-lived pooled threads, in particular the query's initiating `HTTPHandler` thread, were affected. [#115596](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115596) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117656): Fixed wrong results from `sumKahan` when the aggregated batch does not start at the first row of the block. `sumKahanIf`, and `sumKahan` over a `Nullable` argument, tested each row against the wrong element of the condition or null map, returning silently incorrect sums inside window frames such as `ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`, in parallel `GROUP BY`, and under `optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1`. [#116990](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116990) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117889](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117889): Check the overflow when allocating a block of aggregate function states on deserialization: a malformed `Native` block could make the server write out of bounds. [#117370](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117370) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.31.5-lts (45643f435eb) FIXME as compared to v26.3.30.9-lts (a7132c33074)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#117568](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117568): Fix a `Bad cast from type DB::ColumnSparse to DB::ColumnString` logical error (server abort in debug and sanitizer builds) when `groupConcat` is applied to a `Tuple` whose `String` element is stored sparse. [#108790](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108790) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117867](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117867): Fixed a privilege-escalation gap where the `executable` table function did not enforce the `TABLE ENGINE ON Executable` grant. With `table_engines_require_grant` enabled, a user denied `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Executable` could still run the same server-side script via `SELECT ... FROM executable(...)`. It now requires `GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON Executable`, matching `CREATE TABLE`. [#109331](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109331) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114968](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114968): Fixed wrong results when a hash join has a single `LowCardinality` key of a type wider than 8 bytes (`UInt128`, `Int128`, `UInt256`, `Int256`, and their `Nullable` variants). Such a join silently returned rows whose key values are not equal. [#113230](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113230) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118018](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118018): Fix a path traversal on `RESTORE`. A backup metadata entry whose `<name>` was not already in normal form, for example one containing `//` or fewer `..` than the depth of its own directory prefix, was validated in normalized form but stored verbatim, so restoring the part wrote the entry outside the part's directory while `RESTORE` reported success. Such names are now rejected with `INSECURE_PATH`. [#117371](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117371) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.32.14-lts (b7f89885710) FIXME as compared to v26.3.31.5-lts (45643f435eb)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#109074](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109074): Fix runtime join filter producing wrong results for JSON columns. Closes [#107646](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107646). [#107663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107663) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#117668](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117668): Enforce the `http_forbid_headers` configuration during schema inference for the `url()` table function and `URL` storage engine. Previously a forbidden header was still sent over the network while inferring the schema (for example with the `Regexp` format or `DESCRIBE`), and its response body could be reflected back in a parse error, leaking secrets. The header filter is now checked before any network access on the inference path, matching the existing behavior of `urlCluster`. [#108476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108476) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118296](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118296): Fixed incremental backups to Azure Blob Storage storing the beginning of each file instead of its tail. Restoring such a backup silently dropped all the data written after the base backup. [#114975](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114975) ([Smita Kulkarni](https://github.com/SmitaRKulkarni)).
* Backported in [#116401](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116401): Validate Variant discriminator in ColumnVariant arena deserialization. [#115443](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115443) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).
* Backported in [#118199](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118199): Fix an integer overflow in the deserialization of `String` values in the binary formats, and bound the recursion of the binary deserialization of `Dynamic` and `JSON` values. [#115702](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115702) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116131](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116131): Reject invalid names of projections and indexes. [#115824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115824) ([Alexander Tokmakov](https://github.com/tavplubix)).
* Backported in [#118295](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118295): Fixed reading uninitialized memory as literal data when decompressing a malformed `LZ4`-compressed block. [#116992](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116992) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118078](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118078): Fixed a stack overflow when reading hadoop-snappy data containing many blocks that decode to nothing. [#116994](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116994) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118138](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118138): Fix background `Distributed` inserts that deleted unsent spool files after a split batch got a transient error. ClickHouse now keeps the files and retries the batch. [#117034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117034) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#118062](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118062): `ENGINE = EmbeddedRocksDB(ttl, rocksdb_dir, read_only)` with an explicit `rocksdb_dir` now requires the `FILE` source grant that `file` requires for the same directory: `READ ON FILE` to create such a table, plus `WRITE ON FILE` when `read_only = 0`. Previously it required no source grant, so a user holding only `CREATE TABLE` in a database of their own could point a table at another table's directory and read its rows. `ON CLUSTER` and `Replicated`-database DDL are not covered: the replay runs with no user. The argument-less form is unaffected. Backward incompatible for anyone already using an explicit `rocksdb_dir` without them. [#117665](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117665) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#117914](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117914): Fixed `format_schema_source='query'` running the schema query with full privileges when used from a background task, such as a streaming engine consumer (`Kafka`, `NATS`, `RabbitMQ`, `ObjectStorageQueue`) or a `Buffer` background flush. The schema query is now rejected there; use `format_schema_source='file'` or `'string'` instead, or pre-populate the schema cache. [#117737](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117737) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#118208](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118208): Fix `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` and `EXPLAIN SYNTAX` exposing column names and types of tables the user has no privileges for: the analyzer now checks that the user may see at least one column of the table at the moment a table identifier is resolved. The check also makes the error kind independent of whether the queried column exists and stops recording column names the user may not see into `missing_privileges` of the query log. Closes [#78938](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/78938). [#117979](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117979) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118288](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118288): Fixed a privilege escalation in implicit access-rights computation: holding any single child privilege of the `ALTER TABLE` group (for example `ALTER MODIFY COMMENT`) on a view implicitly conferred the entire `ALTER VIEW` group, so such a user could run `ALTER TABLE <view> MODIFY QUERY` and rewrite the view's query. `ALTER VIEW` is now implied only by the complete `ALTER TABLE` grant. A deployment that relied on a partial `ALTER TABLE` grant to alter views must now grant `ALTER VIEW` (or one of its members) or the full `ALTER TABLE` explicitly. [#118194](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118194) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
