# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.33.24-lts (211b7286fd9) FIXME as compared to v26.3.32.14-lts (b7f89885710)

#### Backward Incompatible Change
* Backported in [#118546](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118546): Reading a `File` source with `rename_files_after_processing` set now requires the `WRITE ON FILE` grant on top of `READ ON FILE`, on the initiator for `fileCluster`: the setting renames the files a `SELECT` has read, which is a write to the source, and it used to happen for anyone who could read them. A query relying on it now needs `GRANT WRITE ON FILE`. A per-query renaming rule is also no longer cached by a `Filesystem` database, where it could make an unrelated later query rename files, or be dropped silently. [#117895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117895) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#118602](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118602): Fix `Block structure mismatch in stream` error caused by unnecessary columns returned from Lazy materialization. Fixes [#95191](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/95191). [#96682](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/96682) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#118753](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118753): Fix out-of-bounds access in lazy materialization optimization that could cause an exception in debug builds. [#101144](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101144) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117912): Fix an out-of-bounds write when reading a `Variant` column from a malformed Native block whose discriminators reference a variant index that does not exist. [#107991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107991) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#118083](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118083): Fixed SQL injection in the PostgreSQL wire protocol emulation. Prepared-statement parameters — the `Parse`/`Bind`/`Execute` extended-query path used by `psycopg2`, JDBC, `node-postgres`, Npgsql and others, and the simple-query `EXECUTE` path — were substituted into the executed SQL by raw string splicing, so a crafted parameter could break out of its value position and inject SQL. Parameters are now bound as data. This also fixes string parameters that previously failed with `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` when a client sent them unquoted. [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108469) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118613](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118613): Fix `ObjectStorageQueue`/`AzureQueue` (and the `azureBlobStorage` table function) silently skipping objects when the object storage returns an empty listing page together with a continuation token. Azure Blob Storage does this (e.g. when a listing crosses an internal partition boundary), and the async list iterator was treating the empty page as the end of the listing and dropping the token. It now follows the continuation token. [#109761](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109761) ([Gal Ben Moshe](https://github.com/GalBenMoshe)).
* Backported in [#116189](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116189): Fix a data race (and rare crash) when a parsing/analysis error is reported while reading a file/object storage table. A parse error raised during lazy `KeyCondition` initialization was shared as a single exception object across reader threads, and two threads could concurrently append `(in file/uri ...)` to its message, racing on the exception message string. [#109911](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109911) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118543](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118543): RabbitMQ Security related bugfix. [#112479](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112479) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#118726](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118726): Fixed `LOGICAL_ERROR` when reading a table with a `set` skip index defined on an expression and the query repeats that expression with a `Nullable` operand, for example `WHERE intDiv(id, (SELECT 1000)) = 3` over `INDEX b_set intDiv(id, 1000) TYPE set(100)`. A scalar subquery is enough to trigger it, since it is typed `Nullable`. [#113244](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113244) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#115558](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115558): Fix `std::out_of_range: map::at: key not found` when a `MergeTree` key expression contains a `mortonEncode` or `hilbertEncode` call that is not itself a key column, for example `ORDER BY mortonEncode(hilbertEncode(x, y), x, y)` or `PARTITION BY mortonEncode(x, y) % 4`. [#114233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118446](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118446): Fixes asynchronous inserts into `JSON` columns ignoring the `max_dynamic_subcolumns_in_json_type_parsing` setting. Previously, an asynchronous insert (`async_insert = 1`) could store more dynamic paths than the setting allows, giving a different column layout than a synchronous insert with the same settings. The cap is now preserved when asynchronous inserts aggregate parsed data. [#115329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115329) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#117662](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117662): Reject a bare carriage return (`\r`), in addition to a line feed (`\n`), in HTTP header names and values that pass through the HTTP header filter. This closes an HTTP header injection (request/response splitting) gap for features that pass user-provided headers, such as the `url` table function and engine, HTTP dictionaries, and data lake catalogs. [#115510](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115510) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#118676](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118676): Fix a use-after-free in the gRPC server when a query with a streaming input finishes while a read of the next message is still in flight. [#115707](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115707) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118565](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118565): Fixed `h3Line` returning uninitialized memory in the tail of the result array when a line between two valid H3 indices cannot be drawn because it crosses pentagon distortion. Such a call now throws `INCORRECT_DATA`. [#116583](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116583) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118651](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118651): The handshake response of the MySQL wire protocol is now bounded, so a client can no longer make the server grow memory during the handshake. The `mysql_require_secure_transport` server setting is now enforced from the actual state of the connection instead of a capability bit advertised by the client. [#117003](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117003) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118808): Hide the credentials that a setting value can carry, such as the password in `format_avro_schema_registry_url` or `url_base`, everywhere a setting value is displayed or logged. `system.query_log`, `system.processes`, `system.settings`, `system.settings_profile_elements`, `system.session_log`, `system.distributed_ddl_queue`, `SHOW CREATE USER` and `SHOW CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` previously showed them in plaintext to any user who could read them. [#117523](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117523) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118529](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118529): Several aggregate function deserializers allocated memory from a size declared in the serialized state before reading the payload, so a state of a few bytes could request gigabytes. They now read only what the buffer already holds. [#117536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117536) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118033): Fixes a potential out-of-bounds write of function `formatDateTimeInJodaSyntax` when called with a time zone name longer than 32 characters. [#117925](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117925) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#118324](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118324): `CREATE USER OR REPLACE` and the `OR REPLACE` form of `CREATE ROLE`, `CREATE QUOTA`, `CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` and `CREATE ROW POLICY` now require the corresponding `DROP` privilege in addition to `CREATE`, because they overwrite an existing entity. Previously `CREATE USER` alone was enough to reset the password of any other user, including a privileged one. [#117960](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117960) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118747](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118747): A simple `Query` in the PostgreSQL wire protocol now destroys the unnamed prepared statement and the unnamed portal, as PostgreSQL does, so a later `Bind` or `Execute` on them is rejected instead of silently reusing stale extended-query state. A `Flush` or unimplemented message sent outside an extended-query cycle also no longer leaves the connection unable to answer further queries; that half only affects unreleased code from [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108469). [#118210](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118210) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118692](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118692): Fixed object storage listing silently skipping objects when S3 returns an empty page together with a continuation token. This could make a `plain_rewritable` disk appear empty and hide table parts, and could make data lake tables read a stale snapshot. [#118615](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118615) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#118777](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118777): Make 05054_embedded_rocksdb_explicit_dir_file_grant stress-restart safe. [#118220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118220) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* For `04238_alter_rename_column_merge_race`, apply 1 code line change suggested by AI. For `04408_lazy_materialization_part_offset_prewhere`, disable parallel replicas. [#118783](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118783) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.34.136-lts (4c1242ee175) FIXME as compared to v26.3.33.24-lts (211b7286fd9)

#### Backward Incompatible Change
* Backported in [#121228](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121228): Outbound TLS connections now verify that the server certificate names the host that was connected to. This affects `clickhouse-client --secure`, `remoteSecure()`, `Distributed` over the secure native protocol, secure Keeper connections, and HTTPS clients such as `s3()`, `url()`, HTTP dictionaries and JWT token endpoints. Connecting to an endpoint whose certificate does not name it, for example an IP address with no matching SAN, an S3-compatible gateway fronted by a different name, or an internal CA with missing SANs, now fails with `Unacceptable certificate`. Set `openSSL.client.extendedVerification` to `false` to restore the previous behaviour, or pass `--tls-sni-override` to name the host the certificate was issued for. Loopback addresses stay exempt unless `verificationMode` is `strict`, and the default for `openSSL.server.extendedVerification` is unchanged. [#116724](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116724) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122174](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122174): A MySQL dictionary source created with a `CREATE DICTIONARY` query can no longer enable `enable_local_infile`, at the source or at one of its `REPLICA` entries; loading such a dictionary fails with `BAD_ARGUMENTS`, which with the default `dictionaries_lazy_load` is on first use rather than at `CREATE`. A `REPLICA` that does not set the key inherits the source's value, as the connection pool does. To keep the option, define the dictionary in a server configuration file; `enable_local_infile 0`, and a `SOURCE(MYSQL(NAME ...))` reference to a named collection where the key was never read, are unaffected. [#120972](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120972) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#121586](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121586): You can now disable reading through the `executable` table function and from `Executable`/`ExecutablePool` tables with the new `allow_executable_tables` setting, for a deployment that must not run arbitrary server-side scripts. It defaults to `true`, so existing behavior is unchanged. [#120713](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120713) ([Hanzi Jiang](https://github.com/HanziJiang)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#117529](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117529): Avoid eager JSON serialization of Iceberg manifest entries when iceberg_metadata_log_level is below the call site's threshold. [#110437](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110437) ([Andy Bradshaw](https://github.com/andybradshaw)).
* Backported in [#120624](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120624): Parsing an HTTP request that carries many query parameters or headers with the same name (for example thousands of repeated `role=` parameters) no longer takes quadratic time. [#114410](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114410) ([James](https://github.com/sanjams2)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#120627](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120627): Treat `max_size = 0` and `max_elements = 0` in `IFileCachePriority::check` as "no limit", consistent with how `canFit` interprets these values. This silences spurious `Cache limits violated` logical errors on priorities created with zero limits (such as the per-query filesystem cache priority used when `enable_filesystem_query_cache_limit` is on). [#101428](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101428) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120571](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120571): More security validations for biglake catalog. [#105117](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105117) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119903](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119903): Write partition field summaries into the Iceberg manifest list. [#118796](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118796) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119966](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119966): Bump the internal libssh from 0.12.0 to 0.12.2. [#119262](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119262) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#122371](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122371): Iceberg partition pruning now uses the partition value of a `day`, `month`, `year` or `hour` transform for a filter that wraps the partition source column in a monotonic function, such as `WHERE toDate(ts) = '2024-01-20'`, including for partition values from before 1970. [#119302](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119302) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#122187](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122187): Fix LOGICAL_ERROR crash "Current component is empty" when querying `system.part_moves_between_shards` with `enforce_keeper_component_tracking` enabled. [#101462](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101462) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119002](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119002): Fixes silent data loss for TTL expressions that apply large intervals directly to `Date` / `DateTime` source columns by widening the arithmetic away from 16/32-bit overflow. [#101793](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101793) ([BoloniniD](https://github.com/BoloniniD)).
* Backported in [#119208](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119208): Fixed the `max_memory_usage_soft_limit` was not updated on-the-fly when the configuration changed. The soft memory limit was calculated once at startup and cached, so subsequent config reloads had no effect. After this fix, the limit is recalculated and applied immediately on every config reload, no Keeper restart required. [#104940](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104940) ([Kai Zhu](https://github.com/nauu)).
* Backported in [#119245](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119245): Fixed a rare issue in new Kafka table engine where messages could be incorrectly handled during topic partition reassignment, potentially leading to skipped messages after offset rollback. [#105500](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105500) ([János Benjamin Antal](https://github.com/antaljanosbenjamin)).
* Backported in [#119260](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119260): Reject out-of-range `IntervalKind` bytes during `RowBinaryWithNamesAndTypes` type decoding (`input_format_binary_decode_types_in_binary_format = 1`) with a clear `INCORRECT_DATA` error instead of constructing a `DataTypeInterval` with an invalid kind that could subsequently trip undefined behavior in hash paths. [#106261](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106261) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122005](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122005): Fix a compound `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN a TO b, RENAME COLUMN c TO a` that reuses a freed column name (a "swap") between columns of different types. The materialized part recorded the wrong column type, so a later `SELECT` failed with `Conversion between numeric types and IPv6 is not supported` (or aborted on part load in debug builds). [#107064](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107064) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115248](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115248): Fix a `LOGICAL_ERROR` (`Expected the argument N to have X rows, but it has Y`) when executing a function over a `Dynamic` column built by a JOIN over `Dynamic` (for example the non-joined rows of a `RIGHT`/`FULL JOIN`, or a correlated `EXISTS` subquery decorrelated into a join). [#107095](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107095) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121399](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121399): Fixed an out-of-bounds read when finalizing a crafted `analysisOfVariance` aggregate state whose internal arrays have mismatched lengths. [#107860](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107860) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#119364](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119364): Fixed a server crash (`LOGICAL_ERROR: 'Unexpected exception in refresh scheduling'`) that could happen on startup when a coordinated refreshable materialized view in a `Replicated` database was attached on a Keeper that does not support the `MULTI_READ` feature flag (for example after a Keeper downgrade). The view is now stopped gracefully instead of aborting the server. [#108441](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108441) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121043](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121043): The `hasColumnInTable` function now requires the `SHOW COLUMNS` privilege on the target table, the same grant required by `DESCRIBE` and `SHOW CREATE TABLE`. Previously any user could call `hasColumnInTable` to probe column names and test table and database existence without any access check. [#108464](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108464) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121310](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121310): Validate the redirect target of an S3 `301 Moved Permanently` response against `remote_url_allow_hosts` (`RemoteHostFilter`). Previously the AWS-SDK 301 handling followed the attacker-supplied endpoint from the response (`Location` header or `<Endpoint>` element) without the host check, so a malicious or compromised S3-compatible server could redirect ClickHouse to an arbitrary host (SSRF). The 307 redirect path already performed this check; both paths are now consistent. [#108466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108466) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120194](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120194): Fixed SQL injection in the MySQL wire protocol: the `SHOW TABLE STATUS LIKE` argument and the `SET <mysql_setting>` value sent over the MySQL interface (port 9004) are now parsed and re-quoted instead of being concatenated verbatim into the rewritten query. Also fixed `KILL QUERY <id>` over the MySQL interface silently ignoring multi-digit connection ids. [#108474](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108474) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118973](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118973): Fixed RabbitMQ table engine hanging indefinitely on `DROP TABLE` or server shutdown when the broker closes the AMQP connection due to missed heartbeats without sending a TCP RST. All blocking event loop calls now have a 30-second timeout so shutdown always completes. [#108497](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108497) ([Aly Ayman](https://github.com/alyelmorsy-dataengineer)).
* Backported in [#117537](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117537): The `ArrowFlight` table engine and the `arrowFlight` table function now honor the `<remote_url_allow_hosts>` allow-list. Previously the connection host and port were not validated, so a query could reach hosts not present in the allow-list. [#108507](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108507) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121883](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121883): Fixed dropping whole parts with TTL (`ttl_only_drop_parts = 1`) still reading all data from large, fully-expired parts. [#108626](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108626) ([Michael Jarrett](https://github.com/EmeraldShift)).
* Backported in [#118921](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118921): Rejects non-monotonic `Array` offsets on every read path that decodes them as absolute values, instead of only in the `Native` format. A corrupt `set` skip index granule previously passed unchecked and was then read out of bounds. [#109212](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109212) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119203](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119203): Fix a crash when reading Iceberg tables with equality delete files. If a column is nullable in the equality delete file but non-nullable in the table schema (or vice versa), the values read from the delete file were inserted into a column of a different type through an unchecked cast (a column type confusion), corrupting the column and crashing the server. [#109551](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109551) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#122117](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122117): Fix an accounting leak in memory tracking: when an allocation was rejected by a parent memory tracker (for example, the server-wide memory limit), the thread, query, and user level trackers kept the rejected amount. The error accumulated over time, inflating `MemoryTracking` and per-query/per-user memory usage, and could lead to spurious `MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` errors. [#110784](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110784) ([Seva Potapov](https://github.com/seva-potapov)).
* Backported in [#118991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118991): Fix `PREWHERE` (and row-level policies) on an Iceberg column that was renamed by schema evolution silently returning `0` rows for old data files. Such queries now return the correct rows, matching `WHERE`. [#110941](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110941) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119620](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119620): Fixed potential data loss when an `INSERT` into `ReplicatedMergeTree` was cancelled or timed out while ClickHouse was recovering an uncertain Keeper commit. [#111196](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111196) ([kakao-tars-case](https://github.com/kakao-tars-case)).
* Backported in [#122241](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122241): Fixes a server crash (double free) when finalizing an aggregate function with the `-State` combinator nested under a combinator that transfers several sub-states in one call (`-Resample`, `-ForEach`, `-Map`, `-Tuple`), for example `groupArrayStateResample`, if an exception such as a memory limit is thrown part-way through the transfer. [#111287](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111287) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118997](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118997): Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE` leaving the replaced object behind under an internal name when the caller lacks the drop privilege on it. [#111466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111466) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#114443](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114443): Restrict local object access only for user files path. Continuation of https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99405. [#111483](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111483) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#118761](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118761): Fixed a SQL injection in the PostgreSQL metadata queries. The `schema` of the `PostgreSQL` database engine, the requested column names and the publication name were formatted into SQL literals without escaping, so a value containing a quote could execute arbitrary SQL on the connected PostgreSQL server as the role ClickHouse connects with. Reaching it through `schema` needed only `CREATE DATABASE` plus use of a named collection whose `schema` is overridable. [#111516](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111516) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#120601](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120601): Fix a race between a `ReplicatedMergeTree` mutation and the removal of old temporary directories that could publish a mutated part with some of its files missing, making reads of that part and all its later mutations fail. [#111992](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111992) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119875](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119875): Fixed a crash when reading a subcolumn of a `Variant`, `Dynamic` or `JSON` column whose own type is `Nullable` or `LowCardinality(Nullable)` from a `MergeTree` table, for example ``SELECT value.`Tuple(a Nullable(UInt32), b String)`.a`` over a `Dynamic` column. Previously such a read hit a `LOGICAL_ERROR` in debug builds and crashed in release builds. [#112338](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112338) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121929](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121929): Fixed Iceberg `INSERT` writing no `lower_bounds`/`upper_bounds` at all into the manifest entry when the table has a column whose type cannot be serialized into a statistics bound (for example `Array(Int32)`), or a column that is entirely `NULL`. Such a field is now omitted individually and the bounds of every other column are still written, so min/max file pruning keeps working. Closes [#112706](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112706). [#112934](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112934) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118593](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118593): Fixed a data race and a use-after-free on the metadata of a DeltaLake or Iceberg table. Two concurrent queries that read `total_rows` or `total_bytes` from `system.tables` for the same table could have one query replace the table's metadata while the other was still reading it, which could crash the server. Closes [#113265](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113265). [#113427](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113427) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120889](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120889): Fix `Logical error: Duplicate announcement received for replica number N` when automatic parallel replicas (`automatic_parallel_replicas_mode`) adopts a plan whose single-node variant was sharded by `query_plan_join_shard_by_pk_ranges`. [#113730](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113730) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121324](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121324): A table or database whose name is substituted into a `ReplicatedMergeTree` ZooKeeper path through the `{database}` or `{table}` macro is now rejected if the name would not be a single safe path component. Previously a name containing `/` was spliced in unescaped, so the table registered its znodes inside another table's keeper subtree and permanently broke `ALTER` and `OPTIMIZE` there. A `.` or `..` component, a control character and macro syntax are rejected too. Existing tables keep loading and attaching. [#114006](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114006) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119971](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119971): Apply `remote_url_allow_hosts` before SQL-supplied S3 and Azure endpoints send schema, metadata, or container requests. [#114357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114357) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#116863](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116863): Fixes a server abort (`Logical error: Part patch-... doesn't exist`) when a `DROP TABLE` runs concurrently with a lightweight `UPDATE` on a `ReplicatedMergeTree` table. The update now holds the table's shared lock until its patch part is committed, so the `DROP` waits instead of removing it. [#114826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114826) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118104](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118104): Fixed wrong results from `if`, `multiIf` and `CASE` when one branch is a `Date` or `Date32` and the result type is `DateTime` or `DateTime64`. With `compile_expressions = 1` (the default) the compiled expression copied the date's day count into the timestamp column without converting days to seconds, so `if(cond, toDate32('1900-01-01'), toDateTime64('1970-01-01', 3))` returned `1969-12-31 23:59:34.433`. Closes [#115272](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115272). [#115325](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115325) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120299](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120299): Fix reading a column that has two streams whose names differ only by escaping, for example a `Tuple` element named `size0` inside an `Array`, or a `JSON` typed path named like a substream of a sibling path. Such columns returned wrong values, failed with `CANNOT_READ_ALL_DATA` or a logical error, and made the table unmergeable. [#115670](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115670) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#119654](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119654): Fix `LOGICAL_ERROR: No available columns` when a query reads no columns from a table expression that has no columns at all, for example `SELECT count() FROM loop(db, tbl)` where `tbl` is an `Alias` table whose target was dropped, or a parameterized view. Such a query now fails with `UNSUPPORTED_METHOD` instead of aborting the server in debug and sanitizer builds. [#115716](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115716) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119673](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119673): Fixes a server abort in debug and sanitizer builds when inserting into a materialized view whose `TO` target is another materialized view. Such an insert already failed on released versions, with an uninformative `Code: 1001 STD_EXCEPTION`; it now reports `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming the offending view. [#115985](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115985) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121322](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121322): Fixed `ATTACH TABLE ... AS REPLICATED` and the `convert_to_replicated` flag file accepting a conversion whose ZooKeeper path is not a safe path. On a server whose `default_replica_path` substitutes `{database}` or `{table}`, a name containing `/` used to resolve to a path inside another table's subtree, letting the converted table register a replica under a table it has no privileges on. Such a conversion is now rejected with `BAD_ARGUMENTS`, the same way an equivalent `CREATE` already was. Closes [#115967](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115967). [#115991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115991) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119950](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119950): Fix a segmentation fault when reading in order from a `Merge` table over `MergeTree` tables whose sorting key is shorter than the key prefix chosen for the query: the prefix was forwarded to the underlying reader unchecked, which grew its cloned sorting-key expression list to that length and appended null AST nodes that were then dereferenced. [#116364](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116364) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122201](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122201): Fixed asynchronous TLS connections occasionally failing with an unrelated OpenSSL error left by another connection on the same OS thread. This could terminate distributed queries with a misleading network exception. [#116692](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116692) ([Dmitriy Borisenko](https://github.com/otselnik)).
* Fix wrong `IS NULL` / `IS NOT NULL` / `count()` results with `optimize_functions_to_subcolumns` on a column that was made `Nullable` by a metadata-only `ALTER MODIFY COLUMN T` to `Nullable(T)`. For parts written before the conversion, the `.null` subcolumn was filled from the storage-type default (NULL) instead of being derived from the physically-present parent column, so existing not-null rows were wrongly reported as NULL. [#116837](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116837) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120824): Messages of the PostgreSQL wire protocol are now parsed within their declared size, so a malformed message can no longer make the server allocate memory for a payload that never arrives. [#116998](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116998) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121928): Fix out of bound in `timeSeriesGroupArray()`. [#117404](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117404) ([Vitaly Baranov](https://github.com/vitlibar)).
* Backported in [#122001](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122001): Fixed SQL injection through identifiers when inserting into a table with the `SQLite` engine. The remote table name and the column names were escaped with backslashes, which SQLite does not honour inside a quoted identifier, so a name containing a double quote could close its own identifier and have the rest of it executed as SQL. It is now also possible to insert into a SQLite table whose name, or column name, legitimately contains a double quote or a backslash. [#117421](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117421) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120139](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120139): Each code for Time-based one-time password is now accepted at most once, as required by RFC 6238: reusing an already used code, or a code for an earlier time step, is rejected. A user with `time_based_one_time_password` can successfully authenticate at most once per `period`. [#117563](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117563) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#120154](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120154): Fixed the byte width of the Iceberg manifest `lower_bounds` and `upper_bounds` written for `int` and `date` columns: they were 8 bytes wide where the Iceberg specification requires 4. Spec-conformant readers such as `pyiceberg` failed with `unpack requires a buffer of 4 bytes` while planning any scan carrying a filter on such a column. [#117571](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117571) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121610](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121610): Fix a crash when a client sends a block over the Native TCP protocol that selects the internal `Detached` serialization kind for a column. [#117699](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117699) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#119110](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119110): Fixed OOM when reading parquet file with invalid `num_children` field in schema. [#117797](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117797) ([Michael Kolupaev](https://github.com/al13n321)).
* Backported in [#119500](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119500): Expressions supplied through the `additional_table_filters` and `parallel_replicas_custom_key` settings are now subject to the column-level `SELECT` check, and are no longer injected into the body of `SQL SECURITY DEFINER` or `NONE` views. Previously a user could evaluate predicates over columns they were not granted. [#118063](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118063) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#118204](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118204): Fix complex types schema evolution typos. [#118127](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118127) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#120045](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120045): `format_display_secrets_in_show_and_select` works as expected in EXPLAIN. [#118129](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118129) ([Kirill Kopnev](https://github.com/Fgrtue)).
* Backported in [#118338](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118338): `TRUNCATE DATABASE ... ON CLUSTER` and `TRUNCATE [ALL] TABLES FROM ... ON CLUSTER` ran without checking any privilege: a user holding only `SELECT` and `CLUSTER` could destroy every table in a database, and `readonly = 1` did not prevent it. Both now require `DROP DATABASE`, the privilege the non-cluster spellings have always required. [#118155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118155) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118589](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118589): Fixed `SELECT count()` returning too many rows for a negated comparison (`!=`, `NOT IN`, `NOT LIKE`) over a `Nullable` primary key column: the exact-count optimization counted the NULL-key rows that the `WHERE` condition rejects. [#118214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118214) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#122038](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122038): `KILL TRANSACTION ... ON CLUSTER`, `KILL PART_MOVE_TO_SHARD ... ON CLUSTER`, `SYSTEM STOP THREAD FUZZER ON CLUSTER`, `SYSTEM START THREAD FUZZER ON CLUSTER` and `SYSTEM RESET COVERAGE ON CLUSTER` ran without checking any privilege, so a user holding only `CLUSTER` could roll back other users' transactions, cancel part moves between shards, and flip the thread fuzzer and the coverage counters on every host. Each now requires what its non-`ON CLUSTER` spelling has always required: `KILL TRANSACTION` and `SELECT` on `system.transactions`; `SELECT` on `system.part_moves_between_shards`, `ALTER MOVE PARTITION` and `MOVE PARTITION BETWEEN SHARDS`; `SYSTEM THREAD FUZZER`; and `SYSTEM`. [#118360](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118360) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119725](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119725): Fixed the server deserializing the payload of a `Data` packet that arrives on a connection before any query. In interserver mode the connection is not authenticated until the `Query` packet is processed, so such a packet was rejected only after its Native block had been read, which let an unauthenticated peer choose the column type the server constructed. The packet is now rejected before its payload is touched. [#118588](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118588) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119779](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119779): Fixed a server that refused to start after the directory backing a `Filesystem` database had been removed. Such a database is now loaded without tables and can be inspected and dropped, while a `CREATE DATABASE` or `ATTACH DATABASE` issued by a user is still rejected when the path does not exist. [#118684](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118684) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121013](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121013): Fixed `optimize_or_like_chain` returning extra rows for `OR` chains of `LIKE`/`ILIKE` patterns that do not end in `%`: a value followed by a trailing newline wrongly matched the filter. [#118766](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118766) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#119020](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119020): Fix a crash and wrong results when reading the `DWARF` format with column types other than the ones the format produces, for example `SELECT * FROM file('a.elf', DWARF, 'tag String')`. Requesting a column that does not exist in the format now reports a proper error instead of `std::out_of_range`. [#118794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118794) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#119674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119674): Fixed a server crash that could happen when a `WORKLOAD` setting limiting concurrency (e.g. `max_concurrent_queries` or `max_bytes_inflight`) was lowered below the number of currently in-flight resource requests while the workload was active. [#118836](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118836) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#119308](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119308): Fixed an out-of-bounds access that could happen with `getURLHostRFC` function. [#119026](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119026) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119483](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119483): Fixed a `Filesystem` database serving a table from its internal cache without the `READ ON FILE` grant. The grant was checked only while a table name was resolved for the first time, so once any user holding it had read a name, every user with `SELECT` on the database was served the contents of the file. `EXISTS TABLE`, which requires only `SHOW TABLES`, answered from that cache and probed the directory without the grant too. Both now require it, and a user without it is refused before the existence of the file is observed. [#119029](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119029) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120580](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120580): Make `mergeTreeTextIndex` stricter with row policies: reading the text index is now denied whenever a row policy applies to the table, regardless of which columns the policy uses. [#119032](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119032) ([Elmi Ahmadov](https://github.com/ahmadov)).
* Backported in [#119854](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119854): Fixed a crash and a `LOGICAL_ERROR` for statements that write `trim(BOTH '' FROM x)` (or the `LEADING`/`TRAILING` spelling) where a function is expected: a column's `STATISTICS(...)` or `CODEC(...)` list, `INDEX ... TYPE`, `ALTER TABLE ... ADD STATISTICS`, `auto_statistics_types`, a table function, a named collection and `SETTINGS`. The parser folded it into its operand instead of building a `trimBoth` call, and those places cast or dereference the result as a function. The fold also bypassed the function's own checks, so `trim(BOTH '' FROM <non-string>)` now raises `ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT` and a `FixedString` argument now yields `String`, as every other `trim` spelling does. [#119317](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119317) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119908](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119908): Fix statistics computation on top of azure storage. [#119369](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119369) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#120017](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120017): Fixed cleartext credentials in `system.asynchronous_insert_log.query`. Secrets of table functions such as `s3`, `url` or `mysql` are now masked as `[HIDDEN]`, the same way `system.query_log` masks them. [#119487](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119487) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#120792](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120792): Fixed a `HDFS` database serving a table from its internal cache without the `READ ON HDFS` grant. The grant and the `remote_url_allow_hosts` filter were checked only while a table name was resolved for the first time, so once any user holding the grant had read a name, every user with `SELECT` on the database was served the contents of the file, and that table kept being served after its host was removed from the allowlist. `EXISTS TABLE`, which requires only `SHOW TABLES`, answered from the same cache and so reported which names other users had resolved. Both checks now run before the cache is consulted, and the existence probe no longer consults it. [#119523](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119523) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122199](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122199): Fix a patch part whose `source_parts.dat` lost its content to a zeroed block loading as an empty index, which silently unapplied an acknowledged lightweight `UPDATE` and then let background cleanup delete the only copy of it. Such a part is now detached as broken. [#119585](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119585) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119794): Fixed a stack buffer overflow when reading a `BIT` column from MySQL, reachable through the `mysql` table function, the `MySQL` table and database engines, and MySQL dictionaries. The length of the value sent by the server was copied without being validated. Reported by AgentiCensor (https://agenticensor.ai/). [#119680](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119680) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120845](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120845): Fixed filesystem containment checks accepting a path with an embedded NUL byte. A `DeltaLakeLocal` or `IcebergLocal` table could be pointed outside of `user_files` this way. [#119846](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119846) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120732](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120732): Fixed ClickHouse Keeper terminating when a client sent a `multi` request with no subrequests. Such a request was written to the changelog before it failed, so the termination repeated on every restart. [#119847](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119847) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120756](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120756): Fixed `PARALLEL WITH`, `EXECUTE AS` and the `QueryRunner` table engine skipping the access checks of the `CREATE` statements they execute, which allowed creating tables and databases without the corresponding privileges, and defeated the `readonly` and `allow_ddl` settings. [#119848](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119848) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120090](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120090): Fixed the server not validating the schema of the second and subsequent data blocks that a client sends for an external table over the native protocol. Such a block could make the data be interpreted as a type other than the one it was sent as. [#119849](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119849) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120012](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120012): Fixed a crash of the server caused by a table with `ENGINE = NATS` whose credentials the broker started to reject, for example after a password rotation or on an expired token. Such a table now recreates its connection and resumes consuming once the credentials are accepted again, instead of staying silently idle. [#119853](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119853) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120334](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120334): Iceberg tables recovered from stored metadata no longer enable background compaction or old-file cleanup unless those settings are explicitly stored in the table definition. [#119977](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119977) ([János Benjamin Antal](https://github.com/antaljanosbenjamin)).
* Backported in [#120345](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120345): Fixed a `NATS` table whose settings all come from a named collection (`ENGINE = NATS(collection)` with no `SETTINGS` clause) being written to its metadata file with a dangling `SETTINGS` keyword. The stored definition could not be parsed again, so the table failed to load and aborted the load of its whole database, making unrelated tables in it inaccessible. Closes [#119120](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119120). [#120025](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120025) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122192](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122192): Fixed `http_max_multipart_form_data_size` silently truncating oversized multipart data instead of failing the query, and made it span a form's external-table parts instead of resetting per part. [#120036](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120036) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#121570](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121570): Fixed two ways a table with the `Redis` engine mishandled an `MGET` reply. Reading the whole table stopped at the first key without a string value and silently dropped every key scanned after it, so one key of another Redis type was enough to truncate the result. A reply carrying a different number of elements than keys requested made the engine read and write past the end of an array sized from the request, which could crash the server; such a reply is now rejected with `INTERNAL_REDIS_ERROR`. [#120230](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120230) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121225](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121225): Fixed an out-of-bounds read when reading a `Variant` column from a truncated `Native` stream using compact discriminators serialization. [#120252](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120252) ([Raufs Dunamalijevs](https://github.com/rienath)).
* Backported in [#122088](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122088): Bound the header column count in `RowBinary` formats to avoid excessive memory allocation from a crafted header. [#120282](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120282) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#120566](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120566): Now ClickHouse reject relative paths in `checksums.txt`. [#120356](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120356) ([alesapin](https://github.com/alesapin)).
* Backported in [#121224](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121224): Fix S3 client refresh overwriting static authentication settings and breaking subsequent queries. [#120433](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120433) ([alesapin](https://github.com/alesapin)).
* Fix reading subcolumns of a column that has a `DEFAULT` expression and is not materialized in a part (e.g. after `ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN` or before `ALTER TABLE MATERIALIZE COLUMN` completes): the subcolumn was filled with type default values instead of the evaluated `DEFAULT` expression. This closes [#120326](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120326). [#120613](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120613) ([Vighnesh Pathrikar](https://github.com/VighneshPath)).
* Backported in [#121452](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121452): Fix a server crash (`std::terminate` with `write failed`) in the embedded SSH client when the client's terminal was closed before the line reader was destroyed. [#120764](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120764) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120997](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120997): Fix a server abort when an Azure Blob Storage endpoint reports an asynchronous blob copy as completed without the optional `x-ms-copy-source` or `x-ms-copy-status-description` header. [#120935](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120935) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121832](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121832): Fixes a segmentation fault that happens when a refreshable materialized view is started up and shut down at the same time, for example when a failed `ATTACH DATABASE` rolls the database back, or when the server shuts down while tables are still loading asynchronously. [#121037](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121037) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121633](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121633): `TRUNCATE ALL TABLES FROM` and `TRUNCATE TABLES FROM ... LIKE ...` now skip `Alias` tables, which hold no data of their own. Previously such a statement could fail with `LOGICAL_ERROR: RWLock is already locked in exclusive mode`, truncate a target in another database, or fail when the alias target was missing. An explicit `TRUNCATE TABLE <alias>` still truncates the target. [#121134](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121134) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121602](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121602): `remote(<cluster name>, 'db', 'table', 'user', 'password')`, and the same form of `remoteSecure` and of the `Remote` and `RemoteSecure` table engines, wrote the password into `system.query_log`, `system.text_log` and the server log in cleartext, while the `remote('addresses_expr', ...)` form hid it. The password is now replaced with `[HIDDEN]` for the cluster-name form too. [#121474](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121474) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121731](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121731): Fix wrong values and a `LOGICAL_ERROR` when reading a partitioned Delta Lake table with `allow_delta_kernel_rs = 0` and column types that differ from the ones in `_delta_log`. [#121544](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121544) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Fix Azure object metadata retrieval throwing `NOT_INITIALIZED` after a successful request. [#121857](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121857) ([bbrown-oai](https://github.com/bbrown-oai)).
* Backported in [#122253](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122253): Fixed a server crash when the `flameGraph` aggregate function was constructed on a thread without a query context, for example while attaching a stored table whose column type names `AggregateFunction(flameGraph, ...)`. [#121894](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121894) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Fixes a problem that MySQL/Postgres queries may run in an expired session. [#122076](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/122076) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#120894](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120894): Use `cctz` tzdata 2026c. [#116539](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116539) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#119050](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119050): Update `libxml2` to 2.15.4. [#118649](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118649) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#121919](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121919): Bump `croaring` from v4.5.1 to v5.1.1. Serialized bitmaps are unchanged on little-endian platforms; on big-endian platforms the on-disk layout of `groupBitmap` states changes to the portable little-endian format. [#118917](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118917) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#119342](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119342): Update `openssl` to 3.5.8. [#118927](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118927) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#121362](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121362): Update `mongo-c-driver` to 2.5.4 and `mongo-cxx-driver` to r4.6.0. [#119346](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119346) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#121427](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121427): Fix spurious `NATS` connection failures when the vendored `nats-io` client gets `EINTR` while waiting for a socket, and include the upstream JetStream pull-subscription deadlock fix in the vendored client. [#120202](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120202) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121788](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121788): Update `cctz` to 2026d. Time zone names with the `file:` prefix are now rejected. [#121325](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121325) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).

#### NO CL CATEGORY

* Backported in [#119248](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119248): Fix: filesystem cache disk IO error during `MergeTree` part loading no longer incorrectly marks parts as broken when S3 data is intact. Add `skip_cache_on_disk_failure` cache disk setting to control error propagation behavior. [#99386](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99386) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).

* Backported in [#119447](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119447): Make test_cluster_all_replicas_query deterministic by gating on a pause-effective probe. [#104167](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104167) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119471](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119471): Not required (CI Fix or Improvement). [#105112](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105112) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

* Backported in [#119659](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119659): Fix flaky test_kafka_formats_with_broken_message integration test. [#108252](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108252) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120821](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120821): Fix flaky test_backup_restore_on_cluster restore timeout. [#108993](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108993) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120260](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120260): Fix flaky test_rename_distributed_parallel_insert_and_select. [#111121](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111121) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119652](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119652): Fix flaky test_kafka_formats_with_broken_message. [#111701](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111701) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120004](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120004): Fix flaky `test_filesystem_split_cache::test_split_cache_system_files_no_eviction`. The baseline System-segment count was sampled straight after `wait_for_cache_initialized`, which only reports that the cache became usable while background loading keeps adding segments, so the baseline was a partially populated snapshot (416 or 467 against a steady state of 701). The assertion was also two-sided (`abs`), so it failed when the count *grew* — the opposite of what a no-eviction test should check, and the cause of every observed failure. Both comparison points now sample once the count has settled, and the assertion only fails on a drop. Fixes failures like this one https://s3.amazonaws.com/clickhouse-test-reports/json.html?PR=111406&sha=6282394660bff978c2f06b63ecfd9f27d28b1e97&name_0=PR&name_1=Integration+tests+%28amd_tsan%2C+3%2F6%29. [#112099](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112099) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#120534](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120534): Wait for replication before asserting a row count in test_rename_distributed. [#114274](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114274) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122079](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122079): Reject a compressed block whose codec stores data verbatim (`NONE`, `Quantized`) when its declared uncompressed size does not match the body length. Previously the passthrough read path accepted such a block while every other decompression path rejected it. [#114344](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114344) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120768](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120768): Wait for DETACH DATABASE to release tables in three integration tests. [#114628](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114628) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119636](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119636): CI: fix integration test session timeouts (shard balance and batch count). [#116591](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116591) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121001](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121001): Fixed `01076_parallel_alter_replicated_zookeeper` silently testing nothing when its ALTER thread and its DETACH thread picked the same replica. [#118712](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118712) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119057](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119057): Update usearch to include the arena capacity limitation fix. [#118828](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118828) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#120170](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120170): Split the ASan integration test jobs into eight batches. [#118933](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118933) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119452](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119452): Do not let a setting masking rule throw. [#119028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119028) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Just what the title says. [#119424](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119424) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* distroless: backport base-nossl swap and production-last stage order to 26.3. [#119493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119493) ([Rahul Nair](https://github.com/motsc)).
* Run only shell-free tests for distroless images in the docker library check (26.3). [#119532](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119532) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119755](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119755): Do not leave a `Filesystem` database pointing at a removed directory, which makes the server refuse to start. [#119618](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119618) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#122180](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122180): Fix flaky `01780_column_sparse`: order the `arrayFilter` result before limiting it. [#119686](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119686) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120545](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120545): Not required (CI only). [#119999](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119999) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* [26.3] Disable croaring AVX-512 kernels in MSan builds (clang-21 false positive). [#121979](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121979) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.36.6-lts (c4ca8966720) FIXME as compared to v26.3.35.3-lts (3ea8391f6b8)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#122648](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122648): Chained `ARRAY JOIN`s no longer materialize the whole block of a lazily replicated array column before expanding it, which cuts their peak memory by several times. [#121397](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121397) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#122757](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122757): Fixed silently empty tables when more than one `ENGINE = Backup` database is created from the same backup, or when such a database is recreated under a different name. The storage policy that backs a `Backup` database is now identified by a name that also covers the local database name, so each database gets the disk built for its own data path. [#113378](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113378) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122640](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122640): `ALTER DATABASE ... MODIFY COMMENT` on a database with `ENGINE = Backup` no longer writes a definition the server cannot read back, which made it refuse to start; metadata already written in that form now loads too. Backward incompatibility: a backup taken by an older server of a database with `ENGINE = Backup` stores the locator quoted into a string literal, and such a definition is no longer accepted from a `RESTORE`. Restoring it onto a missing database fails with `Expected function`, and onto an existing one with `CANNOT_RESTORE_DATABASE` because the live definition now spells the locator as a function; use `SETTINGS allow_different_database_def = 1` for the latter, or recreate the database with the function form. [#118674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118674) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#122642](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122642): Fixed settings constraints from a settings profile not being enforced against the other setting assignments in the same statement. `SET profile = 'p', <setting> = <value>` could override a `CONST`, `MIN`/`MAX` or `readonly` constraint that profile `p` installs. The same escape existed through an in-query `SETTINGS` clause, HTTP URL parameters and Arrow Flight session options. [#120376](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120376) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#122414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122414): Unreleased regression from [#116692](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116692), not present in any release, no changelog entry required. [#122222](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/122222) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.4.11-lts (8186e0e780d) FIXME as compared to v26.3.3.20-lts (5342e88d453)

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#101603](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101603): Cgroupv2 memory tracking now excludes `slab_reclaimable` from kernel memory, giving a more accurate measure of non-reclaimable memory usage. [#100901](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100901) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#101868](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101868): The text index is now GA and stays enabled regardless of the `compatibility` setting, preventing unexpected disabling during backup restores or when running in compatibility mode. [#101518](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101518) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#101862](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101862): Bump libarchive from 3.8.5 to 3.8.6. [#101658](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101658) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#101856](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101856): Bump curl from 8.18 to 8.19. [#101662](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101662) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#101461](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101461): Fixed a bug in Keeper where a read request could get stuck (causing session to time out) if a different unrelated session on the same server was closed at just the wrong moment. [#99484](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99484) ([Michael Kolupaev](https://github.com/al13n321)).
* Backported in [#101689](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101689): Fix heap-buffer-overflow in usearch `sorted_buffer_gt::insert()` that could crash or silently corrupt memory during vector similarity search. [#100537](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100537) ([Dustin Healy](https://github.com/dustinhealy)).
* Backported in [#101633](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101633): Fix undefined behavior (signed integer overflow) in parseDateTimeBestEffort when parsing datetime strings with more than 18 fractional-second digits. [#100948](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100948) ([Vasily Chekalkin](https://github.com/bacek)).
* Backported in [#101364](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101364): Fix `MAX`/`MIN` aggregate functions on `Decimal` columns returning incorrect results when JIT compilation is enabled (after the compilation threshold is reached). [#101203](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101203) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#101625](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101625): Fix server crash (Logical error: "Variant ... is empty") when a query reads both a Tuple column containing a Dynamic Map type and its subcolumn simultaneously (e.g., `SELECT ... WHERE NOT ignore(*, mapKeys(t.m))`). [#101448](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101448) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#101829](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101829): Use `aws-sdk-cpp` 1.11.771. [#100582](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100582) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.3.5.12-lts (172e4255c5c) FIXME as compared to v26.3.4.11-lts (8186e0e780d)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#101736](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101736): Fix significant INSERT performance regression when `deduplicate_insert=enable` (default since 26.2) by deferring data hash computation from squashing to the sink and using batch column hashing via `updateHashWithValueRange`, reducing overhead from ~2.5s to ~0.5s for 5M rows with 22 columns. [#101494](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101494) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#101949](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101949): Optimize cache loading on server startup. [#101500](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101500) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#102140](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102140): Bumped internal mongo-c-driver from 2.2.2 to 2.2.3. [#101655](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101655) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#101962](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101962): Fix wrong results when JOIN with shard-by-PK optimization uses query condition cache and some parts are filtered out by cached conditions. [#100926](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100926) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#101987](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101987): Fixed "Target table doesn't exist" errors for materialized views with inner tables during async startup, caused by incorrect startup dependency ordering. [#100946](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100946) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#101563](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101563): Fix insert-select from delta lake cluster with replicated merge tree. [#101299](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101299) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#102076](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102076): Fix use-after-scope in parallel deserialization of `Object` type dynamic paths, which could cause crashes when reading tables with many dynamic paths. [#101823](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101823) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#102102](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102102): Fixed incorrect output in function `formatDateTime` with formatter`%W` with certain (non-default) formatting settings. [#101847](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101847) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#102030](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102030): Fix UDF registry loss when ZooKeeper session expires during periodic refresh — all user-defined functions could become unavailable until a full refresh succeeds. [#101891](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101891) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#102094](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102094): The `splitByString` tokenizer now rejects empty separator strings. [#101928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101928) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#102088](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102088): Fix heap-buffer-overflow in `leftPad/rightPad` functions. [#101951](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101951) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

### ClickHouse release v26.3.6.5-lts (76a4a77bb24) FIXME as compared to v26.3.5.12-lts (172e4255c5c)

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#102253](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102253): Add asynchronous metrics for kernel TCP receive and transmit buffer memory (`sk_rmem_alloc`, `sk_wmem_alloc`) of HTTP connection pool sockets, reported as p50/p75/p90/p95 percentiles and totals per connection group. [#100575](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100575) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).

* Backported in [#102296](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102296): Fix possible logical error during reading Map subcolumns. Closes [#100769](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/100769). Closes [#101336](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/101336). [#101641](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101641) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#102267](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102267): Fix SLRU race bug in filesystem cache 26.1+, which can lead to space reservation logical error. In debug build it can also lead to failed assert: `'Previous state is Evicting, but expected state to be Active while setting Evicting flag for 2c1e3484ecdc6b78a8978fa5b17c5097:0:339 (state: Evicting)'.`. [#101991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101991) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#102174](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/102174): Fix crash in UDF refresh caused by `ZooKeeperRetriesControl` retrying on a stale (expired) ZooKeeper session without renewing it. [#102059](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102059) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
