# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.5.6.113-stable (ab581010f0c) FIXME as compared to v26.5.5.8-stable (1d04e5e9f07)

#### Experimental Feature
* Backported in [#108984](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108984): Add `aiEmbed` function for using LLM APIs to generate embeddings from within ClickHouse. [#102922](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102922) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#112525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112525): Removing requirement for api key in AI credential named collections. [#105701](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105701) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#112819](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112819): AI functions no longer take the named collection as the first positional argument. Credentials come from the `ai_function_text_default_credentials` / `ai_function_embedding_default_credentials` settings or from a `credentials` key in an optional trailing `Map(String, String)` argument, which also carries tunables (`model`, `max_tokens`, `temperature`, `system_prompt`, `instructions`, `dimensions`). [#109232](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109232) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#112939](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112939): Tag OpenAI-format HTTP requests with the SQL name of the calling AI function for upstream endpoint identification. [#110449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110449) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#109133](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109133): Fixed a performance regression (introduced in [#71781](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/71781)) where reading many small files from object storage via the `s3()` and other table functions stopped prefetching and fell back to synchronous reads, significantly slowing single-threaded / low-concurrency reads of lots of tiny files. [#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108872) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#109558](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109558): Issue the initial small-object prefetch also when object storage reads go through the filesystem cache (`filesystem_cache_name`). Previously ([#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108872)) the prefetch was restored only for non-cached reads, so reads of many small files (e.g. `S3Queue` ingestion) with the filesystem cache enabled remained synchronous and latency-bound. [#109478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109478) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#110799](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110799): Account for Map subcolumn on-disk size in prewhere optimization. This fixes the regression in PREWHERE introduced in https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99200. Part of [#110462](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110462). [#110623](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110623) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#111636](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111636): Lazy materialization is now applied to queries with `FINAL`, a filter, and a small `LIMIT`, even without `ORDER BY` (for `ReplacingMergeTree`). [#110722](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110722) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#111462](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111462): Fixed O(P×N) deduplication hash recomputation in async insert flushes that split across P partitions. `DeduplicationInfo::prewarmDataHashes` is now called once before the partition loop in `MergeTreeSink` and `ReplicatedMergeTreeSink`, so all per-partition clones inherit pre-computed `data_hash_batch` values instead of recomputing them P times. This reduces `DuplicationElapsedMicroseconds` proportionally to the number of partitions. [#111150](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111150) ([Valery Petrov](https://github.com/valerypetrov)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#110858](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110858): Support compatibility with the old analyzer under the `analyzer_compatibility_allow_non_aggregate_in_having` setting. If enabled, non-aggregate conjunctions will be moved from HAVING to WHERE. [#104232](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104232) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#108852](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108852): Fix `DataLakeCatalog` databases with `catalog_type = 'onelake'` reading table data by using the OneLake Blob endpoint (`.blob.fabric.microsoft.com`) by default. Set `onelake_use_blob_endpoint = false` to keep the previous DFS endpoint (`.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com`) behavior. [#106843](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106843) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#112901](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112901): Support the `REDUCED_REDUNDANCY`, `STANDARD_IA`, `ONEZONE_IA`, `GLACIER_IR`, and `EXPRESS_ONEZONE` values (in addition to `STANDARD` and `INTELLIGENT_TIERING`) for the `s3_storage_class_name` setting. [#107251](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107251) ([Aditya Kumar](https://github.com/adityaksolves)).
* Backported in [#110489](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110489): Fixed reading of the `auth_response` length in the MySQL handshake, where a length byte `>= 128` was interpreted as a multi-gigabyte value because it was read as a signed `char`. [#107384](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107384) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#112663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112663): AI functions (`aiGenerate`, `aiEmbed`, `aiClassify`, `aiExtract`, `aiTranslate`) now retry transient network failures (connection resets, TLS connect failures, timeouts, unreachable addresses) when `ai_function_max_retries` is set, matching the retry behavior of the `url` table function. Previously only provider-side HTTP error responses were retried. [#107927](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107927) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#109565](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109565): Reduce filesystem cache per-segment and per-key memory metadata. [#108477](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108477) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#110387](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110387): MergeTree can now read a compressed stream whose blocks use different codecs. This is the read-side prerequisite for adaptive codec selection (https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/105404). [#108592](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108592) ([Raufs Dunamalijevs](https://github.com/rienath)).
* Backported in [#109270](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109270): Restore `show_data_lake_catalogs_in_system_tables` as the setting that controls only `DataLakeCatalog` visibility in `system.tables`, `system.columns`, and `system.completions`. Added `show_remote_databases_in_system_tables`, enabled by default, to let users hide `MySQL` and `PostgreSQL` databases from those system tables separately. [#109082](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109082) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110416](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110416): I always find it difficult to add multiple metrics to the dashboard during debugging sessions. This patch adds a simpler way to add them directly from the source code or documentation. [#109449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109449) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#111752](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111752): Added the `jemalloc_merge_tree_arenas` server setting controlling the dedicated jemalloc arena(s) used for `MergeTree` part and table metadata: `0` disables it, `1` uses a single arena (default), and `N` creates a per-CPU pool. On many-core servers a pool reduces memory-allocator lock contention between concurrent merges. The dedicated arena was also narrowed to hold only long-lived metadata. [#109490](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109490) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112367](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112367): The effective named collections storage type is now available as `named_collections_storage.type` in `system.server_settings` and through `getServerSetting('named_collections_storage_type')`. [#111806](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111806) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#112474](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112474): Reduce CPU usage when making snapshot for huge amout of files. [#112297](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112297) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#112750](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112750): Fix logical error exception when reading Iceberg tables whose format version was upgraded by an external tool (e.g. Spark). [#100407](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/100407) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#109338](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109338): Fixed a race between `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN` and a concurrent `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` (or any background merge) in `MergeTree` that could silently replace the renamed column's data with default values. The race window between publishing the new in-memory metadata and registering the rename mutation in `current_mutations_by_version` is now closed by holding `currently_processing_in_background_mutex` across both operations. [#104822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104822) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111002](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111002): Add a new compatibility setting `analyzer_compatibility_prefer_alias_over_subcolumn` (disabled by default). When enabled, the new analyzer prefers the alias-prefix interpretation over Tuple-subcolumn / dotted-column matches for multi-part identifiers, restoring the previous interpreter's behavior. This avoids `AMBIGUOUS_IDENTIFIER` (and related) errors when a query joins a table whose name matches an inner table of a CTE/subquery that uses `SELECT *` over a join, where asterisk-renamed columns (e.g. `b.id`) would otherwise leak the inner table identifiers into the outer scope. [#105491](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105491) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#109921](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109921): Added data validation on insertions https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/98284#issuecomment-4592701308. [#106236](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106236) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#109528](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109528): Fix `optimize_skip_unused_shards` did not apply (and force_optimize_skip_unused_shards falsely failing) when a `Distributed` table is queried through a `Merge` table or the `merge` table function, with the predicate applied above it. [#106250](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106250) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#110753](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110753): Fix `RestCatalog::empty` returning the wrong result when an Iceberg REST catalog contains tables. [#106301](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106301) ([Lefteris](https://github.com/LefterisXefteris)).
* Backported in [#108209](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108209): Fix memory usage growth in filesystem cache. [#106387](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106387) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#109677](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109677): Fixed a bug where the `used_privileges` and `missing_privileges` columns of `system.query_log` could contain privilege strings leaked from unrelated earlier queries of a different user, database, or session. [#106425](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106425) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110820](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110820): Fix a server crash when moving an empty part to a `plain_rewritable` disk (for example with `ALTER TABLE ... MOVE PARTITION ... TO DISK` for an empty part kept by `remove_empty_parts = 0`). [#107040](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107040) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108174](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108174): Fixed a `Block structure mismatch in UnionStep stream` logical error (server abort on debug/sanitizer builds, `Code: 49` on release builds) that occurred when one branch of a `UNION`/`INTERSECT`/`EXCEPT` read a `Sparse`-serialized column while the sibling branch read the same column as a full one (for example when pushing to a materialized view). [#107041](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107041) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110658](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110658): Fixed wrong query results caused by the query condition cache when on-fly mutations (`apply_mutations_on_fly`) or patch parts filtered rows before `PREWHERE`. A query reading with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 1` could poison the cache so that a later query with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 0` and the same predicate skipped marks it should have read and returned too few rows. The same fix also covers row-level security policies, which are prepended as a filter ahead of `PREWHERE`: a query run under a restrictive row policy could poison the cache for a later query that uses the same predicate without that policy. [#107145](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107145) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108920](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108920): Incremental backups no longer store `S3` credentials in the `<base_backup>` locator of the `.backup` metadata file. Backups created with `use_same_s3_credentials_for_base_backup = 1`, or with explicit base backup credentials matching this backup locator, store a non-secret marker and are restored without extra restore-time settings; for backups created with different explicit base backup credentials or extra base authentication arguments, pass them to `RESTORE` with the `base_backup` setting. Backups created by older versions with embedded credentials remain restorable. [#107357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107357) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110341](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110341): Fixed `SELECT ... FINAL` and `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` returning duplicate rows after `CREATE TABLE ... CLONE AS`, `ATTACH PARTITION ... FROM` or `MOVE PARTITION ... TO TABLE` adopted parts from a plain `MergeTree` into a `ReplacingMergeTree`, `SummingMergeTree` or `AggregatingMergeTree`. The adopted part's merge level is now reset to 0 when the source and destination engines differ, so the destination deduplicates it on the next merge. [#107481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107481) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112100](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112100): Fix a `Logical error: Stream ... variant_discr ... is not found` that could occur when merging or reading a `MergeTree` part produced by a mutation of a table with a `Dynamic` column. [#107562](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107562) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#109076](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109076): Fix runtime join filter producing wrong results for JSON columns. Closes [#107646](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107646). [#107663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107663) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#109790](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109790): Fixed incorrect results from distributed queries selecting `ALIAS` columns that share a common subexpression: columns could be misaligned and values returned under the wrong column. [#107675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107675) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#111912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111912): Fix server crash (SIGSEGV) when reading Protobuf data with `input_format_allow_errors_num > 0` and a valid message precedes a bad (skippable) message in the same block. [#107739](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107739) ([Andrey Tsarevskiy | Андрей Царевский ](https://github.com/atsarevskiy)).
* Backported in [#110801](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110801): A transient error while refreshing data parts of a read-only table no longer permanently stops the background refresh task. [#108034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108034) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#108901](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108901): Fix a logical error when casting a `Dynamic` or `Variant` column nested inside a `Tuple` to a non-`Nullable` element type with `accurateCastOrNull` or `accurateCastOrDefault`. [#108061](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108061) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110964](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110964): Hide sensitive info in system.query_views_log.view_query. [#108214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108214) ([Valerii Mordovskii](https://github.com/Fidelaggio)).
* Backported in [#111601](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111601): Fix `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` error for queries that use the `_part_starting_offset/_part_offset` virtual columns in WHERE together with lazy materialization. [#108287](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108287) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#109154](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109154): `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` now requires the new `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` privilege. Previously any authenticated user (including `readonly` ones) could run it and repeatedly reset the DDL worker state, blocking `ON CLUSTER` DDL. [#108460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108460) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109822): Restrict the model path of `catboostEvaluate` to the `user_files` directory, like `file()` and the dictionary sources. Previously the function accepted an arbitrary filesystem path with no containment check, which allowed probing the existence of and triggering reads of files outside `user_files`. Models must now be located inside `user_files`. [#108463](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108463) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109276](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109276): Fixed wrong results when using `SELECT [...] SAMPLE [...]` together with the query condition cache (setting `use_query_condition_cache = 1` which is also the default). [#108488](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108488) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108899](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108899): Fixed a server crash (stack overflow) caused by deeply nested expressions such as `[[[ ... ]]]` or `array(array( ... ))` when `max_parser_depth` is set to a large value. [#108493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108493) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109634](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109634): The MySQL wire protocol commands `COM_FIELD_LIST` (`mysql_list_fields`) and `COM_INIT_DB` (`USE database`) now enforce the same access control as their SQL equivalents (`SHOW COLUMNS`/`DESCRIBE` and `USE`). Previously they could disclose column names of tables the user only had partial column grants on, and switch the current database without the `SHOW DATABASES` privilege. [#108508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108508) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109571](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109571): Match `http_forbid_headers` case-insensitively. HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so forbidding `Authorization` now also blocks `authorization`, `AUTHORIZATION` and other case variants. Configured `header_regexp` patterns are now matched case-insensitively without needing an explicit `(?i)` flag. [#108509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108509) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110090](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110090): Fix a `SELECT *` projection returning a column's type default (e.g. `0`) instead of its `DEFAULT` value (e.g. `-1`) when reading a column added with `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT` after the projection was created. Reads from the base table were already correct; only reads answered by the projection were affected, until the projection was rebuilt. [#108569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108569) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#108895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108895): Fixed a startup failure where a `DataLakeCatalog` database created by an older version (25.12 or earlier) with a malformed `auth_header` could not be attached after upgrading to 26.2 or later, preventing the server from starting. The `auth_header` is now validated only on `CREATE`, and on `ATTACH` the catalog is built lazily on first use instead of during startup, so a single misconfigured or unreachable catalog database no longer blocks server startup. [#108674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108674) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109144](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109144): Fix a segmentation fault when merging `uniqExact` aggregate states with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` or `CUBE` and `max_threads > 1`. [#108928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108928) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112836](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112836): Fix a server crash (out-of-bounds access) in `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` with `enable_hash_ring_filtering = 1` when a batch contained a non-processable file and the Keeper request to set the batch as processing failed at the same time. [#108977](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108977) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109539](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109539): Fix schema inference for the `Arrow`, `ArrowStream`, `Avro` formats and the legacy `ORC` and `Parquet` readers returning `Nullable(Tuple)` for nullable struct columns while the `Nullable(Tuple)` type is not allowed (`allow_experimental_nullable_tuple_type` is disabled). `DESCRIBE` returned a type that `CREATE TABLE` rejects, so creating a table or inserting data using the inferred schema failed with the error `Nullable Tuple type is not allowed`. [#109185](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109185) ([Nihal Z. Miaji](https://github.com/nihalzp)).
* Backported in [#109563](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109563): Fixed a server crash on asynchronous insert with deduplication when `optimize_on_insert` makes the inserted block empty (for example, rows summing to zero in `SummingMergeTree`). [#109229](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109229) ([Den Kalantaevskii](https://github.com/Diskein)).
* Backported in [#110271](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110271): Fix S3 settings priority so a URL-scoped `<s3>` endpoint block takes precedence over the top-level `<s3>` defaults. [#109251](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109251) ([Bharat Nallan](https://github.com/bharatnc)).
* Backported in [#112624](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112624): Fix data loss of a column with no default expression when a merge runs concurrently with `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN`, or when the column's only values come from a lightweight `UPDATE`. The column could be dropped from the merged part, so all of its values read back as NULL. [#109356](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109356) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111641](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111641): Fix `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` error on `ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN` when another column has a `DEFAULT` or `MATERIALIZED` expression that defines and references an inline alias. [#109374](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109374) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#109628](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109628): Fix a data race (and resulting rare crash) in the parallel merge of `uniqExact` aggregate states with two-level sets, which could occur with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` and `CUBE`. [#109389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109389) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111082](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111082): This patch fixes an infinite rescheduling of the rollup merge. [#109410](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109410) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#109807](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109807): Fix a segfault in `groupArrayLastMerge`. Deserialization of aggregated function state is now validated. So a broken state does not lead to OOB. [#109485](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109485) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#111071](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111071): This patch fixes the group by mutations for tables with materialized and virtual columns. If the table has materialized columns or enabled persistent virtual columns, these columns will be aggregated using `any` aggregate. [#109532](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109532) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#109658](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109658): Fix redundant file segment contention introduced in 26.1+. [#109577](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109577) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#111564](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111564): Fixed a false `ICEBERG_SPECIFICATION_VIOLATION` error when reading an Iceberg table whose decimal (or other parameterized primitive) type is serialized with different whitespace across metadata files, e.g. `decimal(20,0)` in the table metadata and `decimal(20, 0)` in the manifest. Such spec-equivalent type strings are now compared ignoring whitespace. [#109676](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109676) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109828](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109828): Fix `system.tables` silently skipping databases for users with per-database grants when the query reads only the `name`/`database` columns. Introduced in 26.2. [#109723](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109723) ([Samay Sharma](https://github.com/samay-sharma)).
* Backported in [#112322](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112322): Fix credential leaks in `SHOW CREATE`, `system.query_log`, server logs and `EXPLAIN` output. Every `S3` locator form now masks `session_token` and Google ADC secrets, `extra_credentials`/`headers` values at any argument position, duplicated or expression secret keys, invalid positional forms (fail closed), and credentials embedded in S3 URLs; this covers the explicit-url and named-collection `s3`/`s3Cluster` table functions, the S3-backed table engines (`S3`, `GCS`, the data-lake engines, `S3Queue`), the `S3` database engine, `BACKUP ... TO S3` and the `Backup` database engine. In addition, secret arguments of `encrypt`/`decrypt`/HMAC that are built by an expression (including ones inlined from a SQL UDF) are now hidden in projection names, `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` and `EXPLAIN actions`. [#109768](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109768) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#110360](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110360): Make headers in `getClientHTTPHeader` case-insensitive according to [RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-5.1). Fixes [#103957](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/103957) by adding `authorization` to the filtered-out headers. [#109791](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109791) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#110902](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110902): Fix reading Iceberg tables whose default sort order references a column that needs quoting (e.g. `@timestamp`). Such tables were unreadable because the synthesized storage `ORDER BY` was built from the raw column name and failed to parse with `SYNTAX_ERROR`. [#110233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111541](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111541): Fixed wrong results for functions `has`, `mapContainsKey` and `mapContainsValue` with an empty needle when a text index is present. [#110246](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110246) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110475](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110475): Fixed a possible crash (heap-buffer-overflow) when a `quantileTDigest`-family aggregate-function state column was used as a `GROUP BY` key and serialized concurrently by several threads. [#110263](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110263) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112073](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112073): Fix `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` ordered mode with persistent processing nodes: bucket locks are now refreshed during streaming, so that the TTL cleanup (`persistent_processing_node_ttl_seconds`) does not remove locks of a live processor. If lock ownership is nevertheless lost, it is detected and reported (a logical error and the `ObjectStorageQueueBucketLockLostOwnership` profile event), and streaming recovers with a fresh file iterator. [#110292](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110292) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#111112](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111112): Fixed a server crash (native stack overflow) when a deeply nested `Array`/`Tuple`/`Map`/`Object` literal is copied or destroyed, for example a query with a very deeply nested literal at a raised `max_parser_depth`. [#110393](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110393) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#111712](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111712): Fixed a read-only object-storage replica (a disk configured with `read_only = true`) not discovering new parts via `refresh_parts_interval`, and `table_disk = true` being rejected on such a disk with "table_disk is not supported for non-ObjectStorage disks". [#110460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110460) ([Julia Kartseva](https://github.com/jkartseva)).
* Backported in [#111096](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111096): Fix a logical error (`Column ... already added for reading`, a server abort in debug/sanitizer builds) when the same text-index predicate is used in both `PREWHERE` and `WHERE` of a query over a `Merge` table on top of a `Distributed` table. [#110710](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110710) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111132](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111132): Fix a use-after-free segfault during graceful server shutdown after Iceberg tables were queried from sessions that also used temporary tables. [#110914](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110914) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#111338](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111338): Fix a LOGICAL_ERROR ("No set is registered for key") in ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN, ALTER TABLE ... DELETE/UPDATE mutations, and lightweight DELETE, on tables that have an ALIAS column whose expression uses an IN operator (including through another ALIAS column). [#111039](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111039) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#111360](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111360): Fixed silent data loss with async inserts and deduplication (`async_insert=1`, `async_insert_deduplicate=1`). When several async-insert entries with distinct `insert_deduplication_token` values were coalesced into one flush that wrote to disjoint partitions, each token was registered in the deduplication log of every partition the flush touched, not only the partition its own rows landed in. A later insert reusing one of those tokens in a partition it never wrote to was then silently deduplicated away. Tokens are now registered only against the partition their rows actually landed in. [#111049](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111049) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111262](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111262): Fixed reading `Arrow`/`ArrowStream` data with empty nested `Array`/`Map` columns produced by Apache Arrow Java < 19.0.0 (bundled with Apache Spark), which were previously rejected with an `INCORRECT_DATA` error about the offsets buffer being too small. [#111101](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111101) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112722](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112722): Fix a logical error `block.rows() == getRows()` (an out-of-bounds read and broken insert deduplication in release builds) when an `INSERT` flows through a dependent materialized view whose target is an `Alias` and whose inner query changes the number of rows, with a deduplicating table reachable behind the alias hop. [#111103](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111103) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#111316](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111316): Fixed asynchronous Native-format inserts so one buffered entry that becomes incompatible after `ALTER ... MODIFY COLUMN` no longer causes the whole batch to fail. [#111108](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111108) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#111635](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111635): Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE` of a dictionary with an object of another kind: it failed with `CANNOT_DETACH_DICTIONARY_AS_TABLE` after the replace was already committed, leaving an orphan `_tmp_replace_*` table. [#111142](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111142) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#112724](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112724): Fix `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` error for columns qualified by CTE name (`cte_name.column`) in queries stored in views when the analyzer is enabled. [#111386](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111386) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#111813](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111813): Fix a memory leak of the peer certificate on every TLS handshake with certificate verification enabled: `SecureSocketImpl::verifyPeerCertificateImpl` did not free the certificate returned by `SSL_get1_peer_certificate`. [#111425](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111425) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#112276](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112276): Fix checking paths against `user_files`. [#111442](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111442) ([Alexander Tokmakov](https://github.com/tavplubix)).
* Backported in [#111586](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111586): Fix typo in complex schema evolution. [#111489](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111489) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#111856](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111856): Fix mutations with a query parameter as the partition (`ALTER TABLE ... UPDATE/DELETE ... IN PARTITION {param:Type}`): the substituted partition value was serialized into the mutation entry in a form that could not be parsed back, which broke loading of the table (for replicated tables, on every replica). Mutation commands are now also verified to be parseable back before they are written to ZooKeeper or disk, so that a similar mismatch would fail the `ALTER` query instead of breaking the table. [#111518](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111518) ([Michael Kolupaev](https://github.com/al13n321)).
* Backported in [#112283](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112283): Fix a segfault due to out-of-bounds memory access when deserializing a malformed aggregate function state containing a `String` value. Such states are now validated and rejected instead of leading to segfaults. [#111606](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111606) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#112619](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112619): Fix overflow while parsing in system.zookeeper_info. [#111629](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111629) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#112540](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112540): Fixes `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` when a `FINAL` query filters on a sorting-key column that is not in the `SELECT` list and the filter is moved to `PREWHERE` (for example `SELECT s FROM t FINAL WHERE k GROUP BY s` with `optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1`). [#111721](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111721) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112174](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112174): Fixes `AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN_NAME` (`Block structure mismatch in (columns with identical name must have identical structure)`) for a query that repeats a `JOIN ON` condition in `WHERE` with `join_use_nulls = 1`. Such a query now returns its result instead of failing. [#112007](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112007) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112538](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112538): Fixed Paimon table reads that could fail while the mutable `snapshot/LATEST` hint was being replaced concurrently. Invalid or stale hints now safely fall back to snapshot listing. [#112010](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112010) ([JIaQi Tang](https://github.com/JiaQiTang98)).
* Backported in [#113001](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113001): Fixes a segfault and silent data corruption when an `INSERT` into the `File` engine or the `file` table function appends to a non-empty file in a format that does not support appending, such as `Avro`. Writing through a file descriptor or a partitioned path bypassed the existing check, so the format prefix was suppressed and a second header was written after the existing bytes, leaving the file unreadable. Such an `INSERT` is now rejected with `CANNOT_APPEND_TO_FILE`, as it already is for a plain path. [#112839](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112839) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113016](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113016): Fix `ReadBufferFromEncryptedFile: Wrong file position` logical error when reading a `Compact` part from an `encrypted` disk with direct I/O, which made merges get stuck in `system.replication_queue`. [#112943](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112943) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#112425](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112425): Bump `openssl` to 3.5.7. [#106844](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106844) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#109916](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109916): Bump libarchive from 3.8.7 to 3.8.8. [#109874](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109874) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110258](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110258): Bump c-ares from 1.34.6 to 1.34.8. [#109905](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109905) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110871](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110871): Fix krb5 CVE-2026-40355 & CVE-2026-40356. [#109910](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109910) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#113104](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113104): Updated the bundled Apache Thrift library to version 0.24.0. [#111278](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111278) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113066](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113066): This PR bumps aws-c-http v0.11.0. [#112413](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112413) ([Govind R Nair](https://github.com/Revertionist)).
* Backported in [#113167](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113167): Update `simdjson` to v4.6.5. [#112594](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112594) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#112684](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112684): Update the bundled SQLite amalgamation from 3.41.2 to 3.53.4. [#112599](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112599) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#107184](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107184): Not user-visible: integration test stabilization. [#105395](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105395) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113070](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113070): Batch CREATE TABLE loop in test_replicated_database::test_sync_replica. [#107379](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107379) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110469): Fix flaky test 04146_iceberg_orc_row_policy_prewhere on release branches. [#107970](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107970) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109031](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109031): Don't check empty schema in SchemaProcessor. [#108945](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108945) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#109101](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109101): Use try-lock in LRUFileCachePriority::tryIncreasePriority. [#109065](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109065) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#109237](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109237): Praktika: prioritize errors over warnings when truncating build logs. [#109156](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109156) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#110220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110220): fix startup_console_log_level removal. [#109858](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109858) ([Garrett Thomas](https://github.com/garrettthomaskth)).
* Backported in [#109985](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109985): CI: Pass -Zsanitizer=address to Rust in the combined address,undefined build. [#109950](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109950) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#110560](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110560): Fix flaky test_server_no_logging: poll for async "Restored console logger level" line. [#110033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110033) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110748](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110748): Harden 00965_send_logs_level_concurrent_queries: match <Trace> marker instead of awk field 8. [#110035](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110035) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112136](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112136): Lower max_snapshot_commit_thread_pool_size to 16. [#111417](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111417) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backport the runtime TSAN suppression for `NonblockingBoundedQueue` to 26.5. [#112899](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112899) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.5.6.64-stable (5d0e75c1456) FIXME as compared to v26.5.5.8-stable (1d04e5e9f07)

#### Experimental Feature
* Backported in [#108984](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108984): Add `aiEmbed` function for using LLM APIs to generate embeddings from within ClickHouse. [#102922](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102922) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#109133](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109133): Fixed a performance regression (introduced in [#71781](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/71781)) where reading many small files from object storage via the `s3()` and other table functions stopped prefetching and fell back to synchronous reads, significantly slowing single-threaded / low-concurrency reads of lots of tiny files. [#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108872) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#109558](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109558): Issue the initial small-object prefetch also when object storage reads go through the filesystem cache (`filesystem_cache_name`). Previously ([#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108872)) the prefetch was restored only for non-cached reads, so reads of many small files (e.g. `S3Queue` ingestion) with the filesystem cache enabled remained synchronous and latency-bound. [#109478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109478) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#110799](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110799): Account for Map subcolumn on-disk size in prewhere optimization. This fixes the regression in PREWHERE introduced in https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99200. Part of [#110462](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110462). [#110623](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110623) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#110858](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110858): Support compatibility with the old analyzer under the `analyzer_compatibility_allow_non_aggregate_in_having` setting. If enabled, non-aggregate conjunctions will be moved from HAVING to WHERE. [#104232](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104232) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#108852](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108852): Fix `DataLakeCatalog` databases with `catalog_type = 'onelake'` reading table data by using the OneLake Blob endpoint (`.blob.fabric.microsoft.com`) by default. Set `onelake_use_blob_endpoint = false` to keep the previous DFS endpoint (`.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com`) behavior. [#106843](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106843) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#110489](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110489): Fixed reading of the `auth_response` length in the MySQL handshake, where a length byte `>= 128` was interpreted as a multi-gigabyte value because it was read as a signed `char`. [#107384](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107384) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#110387](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110387): MergeTree can now read a compressed stream whose blocks use different codecs. This is the read-side prerequisite for adaptive codec selection (https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/105404). [#108592](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108592) ([Raufs Dunamalijevs](https://github.com/rienath)).
* Backported in [#109270](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109270): Restore `show_data_lake_catalogs_in_system_tables` as the setting that controls only `DataLakeCatalog` visibility in `system.tables`, `system.columns`, and `system.completions`. Added `show_remote_databases_in_system_tables`, enabled by default, to let users hide `MySQL` and `PostgreSQL` databases from those system tables separately. [#109082](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109082) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110416](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110416): I always find it difficult to add multiple metrics to the dashboard during debugging sessions. This patch adds a simpler way to add them directly from the source code or documentation. [#109449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109449) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#109338](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109338): Fixed a race between `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN` and a concurrent `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` (or any background merge) in `MergeTree` that could silently replace the renamed column's data with default values. The race window between publishing the new in-memory metadata and registering the rename mutation in `current_mutations_by_version` is now closed by holding `currently_processing_in_background_mutex` across both operations. [#104822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104822) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111002](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111002): Add a new compatibility setting `analyzer_compatibility_prefer_alias_over_subcolumn` (disabled by default). When enabled, the new analyzer prefers the alias-prefix interpretation over Tuple-subcolumn / dotted-column matches for multi-part identifiers, restoring the previous interpreter's behavior. This avoids `AMBIGUOUS_IDENTIFIER` (and related) errors when a query joins a table whose name matches an inner table of a CTE/subquery that uses `SELECT *` over a join, where asterisk-renamed columns (e.g. `b.id`) would otherwise leak the inner table identifiers into the outer scope. [#105491](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105491) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#109921](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109921): Added data validation on insertions https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/98284#issuecomment-4592701308. [#106236](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106236) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#109528](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109528): Fix `optimize_skip_unused_shards` did not apply (and force_optimize_skip_unused_shards falsely failing) when a `Distributed` table is queried through a `Merge` table or the `merge` table function, with the predicate applied above it. [#106250](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106250) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#110753](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110753): Fix `RestCatalog::empty` returning the wrong result when an Iceberg REST catalog contains tables. [#106301](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106301) ([Lefteris](https://github.com/LefterisXefteris)).
* Backported in [#109677](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109677): Fixed a bug where the `used_privileges` and `missing_privileges` columns of `system.query_log` could contain privilege strings leaked from unrelated earlier queries of a different user, database, or session. [#106425](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106425) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110820](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110820): Fix a server crash when moving an empty part to a `plain_rewritable` disk (for example with `ALTER TABLE ... MOVE PARTITION ... TO DISK` for an empty part kept by `remove_empty_parts = 0`). [#107040](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107040) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108174](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108174): Fixed a `Block structure mismatch in UnionStep stream` logical error (server abort on debug/sanitizer builds, `Code: 49` on release builds) that occurred when one branch of a `UNION`/`INTERSECT`/`EXCEPT` read a `Sparse`-serialized column while the sibling branch read the same column as a full one (for example when pushing to a materialized view). [#107041](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107041) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110658](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110658): Fixed wrong query results caused by the query condition cache when on-fly mutations (`apply_mutations_on_fly`) or patch parts filtered rows before `PREWHERE`. A query reading with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 1` could poison the cache so that a later query with `apply_mutations_on_fly = 0` and the same predicate skipped marks it should have read and returned too few rows. The same fix also covers row-level security policies, which are prepended as a filter ahead of `PREWHERE`: a query run under a restrictive row policy could poison the cache for a later query that uses the same predicate without that policy. [#107145](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107145) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108920](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108920): Incremental backups no longer store `S3` credentials in the `<base_backup>` locator of the `.backup` metadata file. Backups created with `use_same_s3_credentials_for_base_backup = 1`, or with explicit base backup credentials matching this backup locator, store a non-secret marker and are restored without extra restore-time settings; for backups created with different explicit base backup credentials or extra base authentication arguments, pass them to `RESTORE` with the `base_backup` setting. Backups created by older versions with embedded credentials remain restorable. [#107357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107357) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#110341](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110341): Fixed `SELECT ... FINAL` and `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` returning duplicate rows after `CREATE TABLE ... CLONE AS`, `ATTACH PARTITION ... FROM` or `MOVE PARTITION ... TO TABLE` adopted parts from a plain `MergeTree` into a `ReplacingMergeTree`, `SummingMergeTree` or `AggregatingMergeTree`. The adopted part's merge level is now reset to 0 when the source and destination engines differ, so the destination deduplicates it on the next merge. [#107481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107481) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109076](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109076): Fix runtime join filter producing wrong results for JSON columns. Closes [#107646](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107646). [#107663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107663) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#109790](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109790): Fixed incorrect results from distributed queries selecting `ALIAS` columns that share a common subexpression: columns could be misaligned and values returned under the wrong column. [#107675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107675) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#110801](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110801): A transient error while refreshing data parts of a read-only table no longer permanently stops the background refresh task. [#108034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108034) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#108901](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108901): Fix a logical error when casting a `Dynamic` or `Variant` column nested inside a `Tuple` to a non-`Nullable` element type with `accurateCastOrNull` or `accurateCastOrDefault`. [#108061](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108061) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110964](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110964): Hide sensitive info in system.query_views_log.view_query. [#108214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108214) ([Valerii Mordovskii](https://github.com/Fidelaggio)).
* Backported in [#109154](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109154): `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` now requires the new `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` privilege. Previously any authenticated user (including `readonly` ones) could run it and repeatedly reset the DDL worker state, blocking `ON CLUSTER` DDL. [#108460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108460) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109822): Restrict the model path of `catboostEvaluate` to the `user_files` directory, like `file()` and the dictionary sources. Previously the function accepted an arbitrary filesystem path with no containment check, which allowed probing the existence of and triggering reads of files outside `user_files`. Models must now be located inside `user_files`. [#108463](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108463) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109276](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109276): Fixed wrong results when using `SELECT [...] SAMPLE [...]` together with the query condition cache (setting `use_query_condition_cache = 1` which is also the default). [#108488](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108488) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108899](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108899): Fixed a server crash (stack overflow) caused by deeply nested expressions such as `[[[ ... ]]]` or `array(array( ... ))` when `max_parser_depth` is set to a large value. [#108493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108493) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109634](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109634): The MySQL wire protocol commands `COM_FIELD_LIST` (`mysql_list_fields`) and `COM_INIT_DB` (`USE database`) now enforce the same access control as their SQL equivalents (`SHOW COLUMNS`/`DESCRIBE` and `USE`). Previously they could disclose column names of tables the user only had partial column grants on, and switch the current database without the `SHOW DATABASES` privilege. [#108508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108508) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109571](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109571): Match `http_forbid_headers` case-insensitively. HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so forbidding `Authorization` now also blocks `authorization`, `AUTHORIZATION` and other case variants. Configured `header_regexp` patterns are now matched case-insensitively without needing an explicit `(?i)` flag. [#108509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108509) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110090](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110090): Fix a `SELECT *` projection returning a column's type default (e.g. `0`) instead of its `DEFAULT` value (e.g. `-1`) when reading a column added with `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT` after the projection was created. Reads from the base table were already correct; only reads answered by the projection were affected, until the projection was rebuilt. [#108569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108569) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#108895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108895): Fixed a startup failure where a `DataLakeCatalog` database created by an older version (25.12 or earlier) with a malformed `auth_header` could not be attached after upgrading to 26.2 or later, preventing the server from starting. The `auth_header` is now validated only on `CREATE`, and on `ATTACH` the catalog is built lazily on first use instead of during startup, so a single misconfigured or unreachable catalog database no longer blocks server startup. [#108674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108674) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109144](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109144): Fix a segmentation fault when merging `uniqExact` aggregate states with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` or `CUBE` and `max_threads > 1`. [#108928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108928) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109539](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109539): Fix schema inference for the `Arrow`, `ArrowStream`, `Avro` formats and the legacy `ORC` and `Parquet` readers returning `Nullable(Tuple)` for nullable struct columns while the `Nullable(Tuple)` type is not allowed (`allow_experimental_nullable_tuple_type` is disabled). `DESCRIBE` returned a type that `CREATE TABLE` rejects, so creating a table or inserting data using the inferred schema failed with the error `Nullable Tuple type is not allowed`. [#109185](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109185) ([Nihal Z. Miaji](https://github.com/nihalzp)).
* Backported in [#109563](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109563): Fixed a server crash on asynchronous insert with deduplication when `optimize_on_insert` makes the inserted block empty (for example, rows summing to zero in `SummingMergeTree`). [#109229](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109229) ([Den Kalantaevskii](https://github.com/Diskein)).
* Backported in [#110271](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110271): Fix S3 settings priority so a URL-scoped `<s3>` endpoint block takes precedence over the top-level `<s3>` defaults. [#109251](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109251) ([Bharat Nallan](https://github.com/bharatnc)).
* Backported in [#109628](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109628): Fix a data race (and resulting rare crash) in the parallel merge of `uniqExact` aggregate states with two-level sets, which could occur with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` and `CUBE`. [#109389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109389) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111082](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111082): This patch fixes an infinite rescheduling of the rollup merge. [#109410](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109410) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#109807](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109807): Fix a segfault in `groupArrayLastMerge`. Deserialization of aggregated function state is now validated. So a broken state does not lead to OOB. [#109485](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109485) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#111071](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111071): This patch fixes the group by mutations for tables with materialized and virtual columns. If the table has materialized columns or enabled persistent virtual columns, these columns will be aggregated using `any` aggregate. [#109532](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109532) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#109658](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109658): Fix redundant file segment contention introduced in 26.1+. [#109577](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109577) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#109828](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109828): Fix `system.tables` silently skipping databases for users with per-database grants when the query reads only the `name`/`database` columns. Introduced in 26.2. [#109723](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109723) ([Samay Sharma](https://github.com/samay-sharma)).
* Backported in [#110360](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110360): Make headers in `getClientHTTPHeader` case-insensitive according to [RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-5.1). Fixes [#103957](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/103957) by adding `authorization` to the filtered-out headers. [#109791](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109791) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#110902](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110902): Fix reading Iceberg tables whose default sort order references a column that needs quoting (e.g. `@timestamp`). Such tables were unreadable because the synthesized storage `ORDER BY` was built from the raw column name and failed to parse with `SYNTAX_ERROR`. [#110233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110475](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110475): Fixed a possible crash (heap-buffer-overflow) when a `quantileTDigest`-family aggregate-function state column was used as a `GROUP BY` key and serialized concurrently by several threads. [#110263](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110263) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111112](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111112): Fixed a server crash (native stack overflow) when a deeply nested `Array`/`Tuple`/`Map`/`Object` literal is copied or destroyed, for example a query with a very deeply nested literal at a raised `max_parser_depth`. [#110393](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110393) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#111096](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111096): Fix a logical error (`Column ... already added for reading`, a server abort in debug/sanitizer builds) when the same text-index predicate is used in both `PREWHERE` and `WHERE` of a query over a `Merge` table on top of a `Distributed` table. [#110710](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110710) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111338](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111338): Fix a LOGICAL_ERROR ("No set is registered for key") in ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN, ALTER TABLE ... DELETE/UPDATE mutations, and lightweight DELETE, on tables that have an ALIAS column whose expression uses an IN operator (including through another ALIAS column). [#111039](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111039) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#111360](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111360): Fixed silent data loss with async inserts and deduplication (`async_insert=1`, `async_insert_deduplicate=1`). When several async-insert entries with distinct `insert_deduplication_token` values were coalesced into one flush that wrote to disjoint partitions, each token was registered in the deduplication log of every partition the flush touched, not only the partition its own rows landed in. A later insert reusing one of those tokens in a partition it never wrote to was then silently deduplicated away. Tokens are now registered only against the partition their rows actually landed in. [#111049](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111049) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111262](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111262): Fixed reading `Arrow`/`ArrowStream` data with empty nested `Array`/`Map` columns produced by Apache Arrow Java < 19.0.0 (bundled with Apache Spark), which were previously rejected with an `INCORRECT_DATA` error about the offsets buffer being too small. [#111101](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111101) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#109916](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109916): Bump libarchive from 3.8.7 to 3.8.8. [#109874](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109874) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110258](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110258): Bump c-ares from 1.34.6 to 1.34.8. [#109905](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109905) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110871](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110871): Fix krb5 CVE-2026-40355 & CVE-2026-40356. [#109910](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109910) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#110469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110469): Fix flaky test 04146_iceberg_orc_row_policy_prewhere on release branches. [#107970](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107970) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109031](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109031): Don't check empty schema in SchemaProcessor. [#108945](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108945) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#109101](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109101): Use try-lock in LRUFileCachePriority::tryIncreasePriority. [#109065](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109065) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#109237](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109237): Praktika: prioritize errors over warnings when truncating build logs. [#109156](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109156) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#110220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110220): fix startup_console_log_level removal. [#109858](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109858) ([Garrett Thomas](https://github.com/garrettthomaskth)).
* Backported in [#109985](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109985): CI: Pass -Zsanitizer=address to Rust in the combined address,undefined build. [#109950](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109950) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#110560](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110560): Fix flaky test_server_no_logging: poll for async "Restored console logger level" line. [#110033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110033) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110748](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110748): Harden 00965_send_logs_level_concurrent_queries: match <Trace> marker instead of awk field 8. [#110035](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110035) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
