# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.6.2.81-stable (0900e6f16a7) FIXME as compared to v26.6.1.1193-stable (6615864161f)

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#108687](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108687): Introduce a memory reservation feature for workloads. More details https://clickhouse.com/docs/operations/workload-scheduling. [#82414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/82414) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#109481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109481): Added a postprocessor to the text index which transforms the tokens after tokenization. [#108606](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108606) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#110684](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110684): Improve execution of `arrayElement` on `Array(LowCardinality(String))` and map LIKE functions on maps with `LowCardinality(String)` keys or values by avoiding unnecessary string materialization. [#107450](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107450) ([Michael Jarrett](https://github.com/EmeraldShift)).
* Backported in [#109124](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109124): Fixed a performance regression (introduced in [#71781](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/71781)) where reading many small files from object storage via the `s3()` and other table functions stopped prefetching and fell back to synchronous reads, significantly slowing single-threaded / low-concurrency reads of lots of tiny files. [#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108872) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#109559](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109559): Issue the initial small-object prefetch also when object storage reads go through the filesystem cache (`filesystem_cache_name`). Previously ([#108872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108872)) the prefetch was restored only for non-cached reads, so reads of many small files (e.g. `S3Queue` ingestion) with the filesystem cache enabled remained synchronous and latency-bound. [#109478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109478) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#110859](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110859): Support compatibility with the old analyzer under the `analyzer_compatibility_allow_non_aggregate_in_having` setting. If enabled, non-aggregate conjunctions will be moved from HAVING to WHERE. [#104232](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104232) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#109566](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109566): Reduce filesystem cache per-segment and per-key memory metadata. [#108477](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108477) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#110379](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110379): MergeTree can now read a compressed stream whose blocks use different codecs. This is the read-side prerequisite for adaptive codec selection (https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/105404). [#108592](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108592) ([Raufs Dunamalijevs](https://github.com/rienath)).
* Backported in [#109271](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109271): Restore `show_data_lake_catalogs_in_system_tables` as the setting that controls only `DataLakeCatalog` visibility in `system.tables`, `system.columns`, and `system.completions`. Added `show_remote_databases_in_system_tables`, enabled by default, to let users hide `MySQL` and `PostgreSQL` databases from those system tables separately. [#109082](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109082) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#109318](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109318): Reduce memory consumption in aggregator. [#109224](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109224) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#110417](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110417): I always find it difficult to add multiple metrics to the dashboard during debugging sessions. This patch adds a simpler way to add them directly from the source code or documentation. [#109449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109449) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#108870](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108870): Fix a server abort during `RESTORE` of backups containing tables with cyclic dependencies. [#103824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103824) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#109323](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109323): Fixed a race between `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN` and a concurrent `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... FINAL` (or any background merge) in `MergeTree` that could silently replace the renamed column's data with default values. The race window between publishing the new in-memory metadata and registering the rename mutation in `current_mutations_by_version` is now closed by holding `currently_processing_in_background_mutex` across both operations. [#104822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104822) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109778](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109778): Fixes `LOGICAL_ERROR` about duplicate column names in row policy actions. [#106438](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106438) ([János Benjamin Antal](https://github.com/antaljanosbenjamin)).
* Backported in [#109484](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109484): Fixed wrong results when querying a `ReplacingMergeTree` table with `FINAL` and a filter on a text index while `query_plan_optimize_lazy_final` was enabled. The lazy `FINAL` optimization built reading steps that did not reproduce the direct read from the text index, so the filter dropped all matching rows. [#106894](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106894) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#109494](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109494): Closes [#106837](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/106837). [#106945](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106945) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#110794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110794): Fix a server crash when moving an empty part to a `plain_rewritable` disk (for example with `ALTER TABLE ... MOVE PARTITION ... TO DISK` for an empty part kept by `remove_empty_parts = 0`). [#107040](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107040) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108844](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108844): Incremental backups no longer store `S3` credentials in the `<base_backup>` locator of the `.backup` metadata file. Backups created with `use_same_s3_credentials_for_base_backup = 1`, or with explicit base backup credentials matching this backup locator, store a non-secret marker and are restored without extra restore-time settings; for backups created with different explicit base backup credentials or extra base authentication arguments, pass them to `RESTORE` with the `base_backup` setting. Backups created by older versions with embedded credentials remain restorable. [#107357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107357) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#109018](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109018): Fix NULL values being silently converted to empty strings when inserting Arrow/ORC data into a LowCardinality(Nullable(...)) column. This was a regression introduced in 26.5. [#107532](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107532) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#108646](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108646): Fixed `RESTORE` for `ReplicatedMergeTree` tables so duplicate-content parts from a backup are preserved instead of being silently deduplicated. [#107652](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107652) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#108542](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108542): Fix runtime join filter producing wrong results for JSON columns. Closes [#107646](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107646). [#107663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107663) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#109695](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109695): Fixed incorrect results from distributed queries selecting `ALIAS` columns that share a common subexpression: columns could be misaligned and values returned under the wrong column. [#107675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107675) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#110802](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110802): A transient error while refreshing data parts of a read-only table no longer permanently stops the background refresh task. [#108034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108034) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#110965](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110965): Hide sensitive info in system.query_views_log.view_query. [#108214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108214) ([Valerii Mordovskii](https://github.com/Fidelaggio)).
* Backported in [#109523](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109523): `index_granularity_bytes` is now honored for `AggregateFunction` state columns. Previously the granule byte cap was ignored for such columns (for example `uniqExact` states in `AggregatingMergeTree` tables and aggregating projections), producing granules far larger than the configured limit and increasing read amplification and query-time memory. [#108297](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108297) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109809](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109809): Fix CREATE OR REPLACE of a Refreshable MV with a TO target. [#108392](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108392) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#108750](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108750): Vector search queries that SELECT from the `_distance` column now return a proper error instead of failing with a `LOGICAL_ERROR`. [#108423](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108423) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#109155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109155): `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` now requires the new `SYSTEM RESET DDL WORKER` privilege. Previously any authenticated user (including `readonly` ones) could run it and repeatedly reset the DDL worker state, blocking `ON CLUSTER` DDL. [#108460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108460) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109719](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109719): Restrict the model path of `catboostEvaluate` to the `user_files` directory, like `file()` and the dictionary sources. Previously the function accepted an arbitrary filesystem path with no containment check, which allowed probing the existence of and triggering reads of files outside `user_files`. Models must now be located inside `user_files`. [#108463](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108463) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108706](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108706): Fixed `ssl_certificate` user identification so a single `*` wildcard matches exactly one name component (RFC 6125 6.4.3). Previously a wildcard in a `CN` or `DNS:` SAN subject (for example `*.corp.example.com`) also matched multi-label names such as `evil.deep.corp.example.com`, letting a holder of a certificate for a deeper subdomain authenticate as the wildcard user. `URI:` SAN matching is unchanged. [#108472](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108472) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109150](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109150): Fixed wrong results when using `SELECT [...] SAMPLE [...]` together with the query condition cache (setting `use_query_condition_cache = 1` which is also the default). [#108488](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108488) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108832](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108832): Fixed a server crash (stack overflow) caused by deeply nested expressions such as `[[[ ... ]]]` or `array(array( ... ))` when `max_parser_depth` is set to a large value. [#108493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108493) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109635](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109635): The MySQL wire protocol commands `COM_FIELD_LIST` (`mysql_list_fields`) and `COM_INIT_DB` (`USE database`) now enforce the same access control as their SQL equivalents (`SHOW COLUMNS`/`DESCRIBE` and `USE`). Previously they could disclose column names of tables the user only had partial column grants on, and switch the current database without the `SHOW DATABASES` privilege. [#108508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108508) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109572](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109572): Match `http_forbid_headers` case-insensitively. HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so forbidding `Authorization` now also blocks `authorization`, `AUTHORIZATION` and other case variants. Configured `header_regexp` patterns are now matched case-insensitively without needing an explicit `(?i)` flag. [#108509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108509) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108719](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108719): Fix `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` when a compound predicate is aliased in `GROUP BY` and referenced again, with `enable_identifier_resolve_cache` enabled (the default). The `optimize_and_compare_chain` optimization was not idempotent and a shared resolved node accumulated a duplicate transitive conjunct. [#108553](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108553) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110091](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110091): Fix a `SELECT *` projection returning a column's type default (e.g. `0`) instead of its `DEFAULT` value (e.g. `-1`) when reading a column added with `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN ... DEFAULT` after the projection was created. Reads from the base table were already correct; only reads answered by the projection were affected, until the projection was rebuilt. [#108569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108569) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#108669](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108669): Fixed direct read from multiple partially materialized text indexes. [#108607](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108607) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#108699](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108699): Fix a metadata-disclosure where `DESCRIBE loop('db', 'table')` and `DESCRIBE loop(<inner table function>)` bypassed the `SHOW COLUMNS` / source access check, letting an unprivileged user read a table's column schema. [#108624](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108624) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108795](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108795): Fixed a startup failure where a `DataLakeCatalog` database created by an older version (25.12 or earlier) with a malformed `auth_header` could not be attached after upgrading to 26.2 or later, preventing the server from starting. The `auth_header` is now validated only on `CREATE`, and on `ATTACH` the catalog is built lazily on first use instead of during startup, so a single misconfigured or unreachable catalog database no longer blocks server startup. [#108674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108674) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109652](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109652): Fix `NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS_DOESNT_MATCH` error when a subquery on a `Distributed` table reads two or more `ALIAS` columns that expand to the same expression (for example `a1 String ALIAS toString(x), a2 String ALIAS toString(x)`) and the subquery feeds an outer query, e.g. `SELECT count() FROM (SELECT a1, a2 FROM dist GROUP BY a1, a2)`. [#108725](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108725) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108826): Fixed partition and primary key pruning being silently disabled when a `LowCardinality(FixedString)` (or `LowCardinality(Nullable(FixedString))`) key column is wrapped in a function in the key, for example `PARTITION BY sipHash64(k) % N` with `WHERE k = 'literal'`. Such queries scanned all partitions instead of pruning them. [#108777](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108777) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108911](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108911): Fixed `insert_quorum = 'auto'` not rejecting inserts up front when fewer than a majority of replicas were alive. Such inserts now fail immediately with `TOO_FEW_LIVE_REPLICAS` instead of writing a local part and later timing out with `UNKNOWN_STATUS_OF_INSERT`. [#108800](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108800) ([Gagan Dhakrey](https://github.com/gagandhakrey)).
* Backported in [#109145](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109145): Fix a segmentation fault when merging `uniqExact` aggregate states with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` or `CUBE` and `max_threads > 1`. [#108928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108928) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#109918](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109918): Fixed a bug in the new analyzer where FINAL on one table of a JOIN (e.g. `FROM t1 FINAL JOIN t2`) was incorrectly applied to the other joined tables as well, what could made such queries slower. [#108979](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108979) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#109506](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109506): Fix schema inference for the `Arrow`, `ArrowStream`, `Avro` formats and the legacy `ORC` and `Parquet` readers returning `Nullable(Tuple)` for nullable struct columns while the `Nullable(Tuple)` type is not allowed (`allow_experimental_nullable_tuple_type` is disabled). `DESCRIBE` returned a type that `CREATE TABLE` rejects, so creating a table or inserting data using the inferred schema failed with the error `Nullable Tuple type is not allowed`. [#109185](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109185) ([Nihal Z. Miaji](https://github.com/nihalzp)).
* Backported in [#109564](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109564): Fixed a server crash on asynchronous insert with deduplication when `optimize_on_insert` makes the inserted block empty (for example, rows summing to zero in `SummingMergeTree`). [#109229](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109229) ([Den Kalantaevskii](https://github.com/Diskein)).
* Backported in [#110272](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110272): Fix S3 settings priority so a URL-scoped `<s3>` endpoint block takes precedence over the top-level `<s3>` defaults. [#109251](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109251) ([Bharat Nallan](https://github.com/bharatnc)).
* Backported in [#110232](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110232): Fixed a bug where column `DEFAULT` values were not applied for `INSERT INTO TABLE FUNCTION` (for example `remote(...)` or `file(...)`) with inline `VALUES` data when the server parses the inline data itself (`send_table_structure_on_insert_with_inline_data = 0`). An explicit `NULL` inserted into a non-`Nullable` column with a `DEFAULT` became `0` instead of the declared default. It now behaves like a plain table `INSERT` and the HTTP protocol. [#109258](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109258) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109418](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109418): Fixed a server crash on `CREATE HYPOTHETICAL INDEX ... TYPE set` (and `ngrambf_v1`/`tokenbf_v1`) when the required index argument is omitted. Such statements are now rejected with a clear error. [#109294](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109294) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109431](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109431): `clickhouse-local` acting as a server (after `SYSTEM START LISTEN HTTP`) now serves HTTP connections using the `TabSeparated` default output format, matching `clickhouse-server`, instead of the interactive `PrettyCompact` default. This fixes connecting to `clickhouse-local` over HTTP with drivers such as `clickhouse-connect`. The interactive terminal session still renders results as `PrettyCompact`. [#109362](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109362) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#109629](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109629): Fix a data race (and resulting rare crash) in the parallel merge of `uniqExact` aggregate states with two-level sets, which could occur with `GROUPING SETS`, `ROLLUP` and `CUBE`. [#109389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109389) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109808): Fix a segfault in `groupArrayLastMerge`. Deserialization of aggregated function state is now validated. So a broken state does not lead to OOB. [#109485](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109485) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#109819](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109819): Fix segfault in `largestTriangleThreeBuckets` aggregate function by rejecting broken aggregate function state at the deserialization level. [#109492](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109492) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#109776](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109776): Fix a crash when reading Iceberg tables with equality delete files. If a column is nullable in the equality delete file but non-nullable in the table schema (or vice versa), the values read from the delete file were inserted into a column of a different type through an unchecked cast (a column type confusion), corrupting the column and crashing the server. [#109551](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109551) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#109659](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109659): Fix redundant file segment contention introduced in 26.1+. [#109577](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109577) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#109829](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109829): Fix `system.tables` silently skipping databases for users with per-database grants when the query reads only the `name`/`database` columns. Introduced in 26.2. [#109723](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109723) ([Samay Sharma](https://github.com/samay-sharma)).
* Backported in [#110361](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110361): Make headers in `getClientHTTPHeader` case-insensitive according to [RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc9110/#section-5.1). Fixes [#103957](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/103957) by adding `authorization` to the filtered-out headers. [#109791](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109791) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#110903](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110903): Fix reading Iceberg tables whose default sort order references a column that needs quoting (e.g. `@timestamp`). Such tables were unreadable because the synthesized storage `ORDER BY` was built from the raw column name and failed to parse with `SYNTAX_ERROR`. [#110233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110353](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110353): Fixed `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER: Missing columns: '_block_offset'` error when running `ALTER TABLE ... MATERIALIZE INDEX` on the implicit minmax index created by `add_minmax_index_for_block_number_column`/`add_minmax_index_for_block_offset_column` on a table that has freshly inserted (0-level) parts. The index is now built for those parts instead of failing. [#110236](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110236) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110476): Fixed a possible crash (heap-buffer-overflow) when a `quantileTDigest`-family aggregate-function state column was used as a `GROUP BY` key and serialized concurrently by several threads. [#110263](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110263) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#110027](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110027): Bump libpng from 1.6.48 to 1.6.58. [#109869](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109869) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#109917](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109917): Bump libarchive from 3.8.7 to 3.8.8. [#109874](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109874) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110259](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110259): Bump c-ares from 1.34.6 to 1.34.8. [#109905](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109905) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#110872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110872): Fix krb5 CVE-2026-40355 & CVE-2026-40356. [#109910](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109910) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#109987](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109987): Add a regression test for `LOGICAL_ERROR` "Column identifier is already registered" on the `ALTER UPDATE`/`ALTER DELETE` + `EXISTS` path and for `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` rejection of correlated subqueries in mutations. The fixes themselves are already on `master`. [#106025](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106025) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110825](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110825): Add regression test for ReplicatedAccessStorage race that evicted a just-created entity (UNKNOWN_ROLE). [#106525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106525) ([Eugene Klimov](https://github.com/Slach)).
* Backported in [#110470](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110470): Fix flaky test 04146_iceberg_orc_row_policy_prewhere on release branches. [#107970](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107970) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108754](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108754): Fix flaky test_kafka_formats_with_broken_message integration test. [#108252](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108252) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#108752](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108752): Fix flaky test_s3_plain_rewritable: opt in to legacy REPLACE PARTITION from empty source. [#108350](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108350) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109653](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109653): Reduce 03274_squashing_transform_sparse_bug size. [#108368](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108368) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#108603](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108603): Move metric. [#108453](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108453) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#109609](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109609): Fix flaky test 02161_addressToLineWithInlines. [#108500](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108500) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109102](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109102): Use try-lock in LRUFileCachePriority::tryIncreasePriority. [#109065](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109065) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#109167](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109167): Fix flaky 04256_packed_skip_indices_layout_transitions under randomized sparse serialization. [#109095](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109095) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109238](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109238): Praktika: prioritize errors over warnings when truncating build logs. [#109156](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109156) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#109644](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109644): Fix flaky test 03522_join_using_bug_78907. [#109514](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109514) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110221](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110221): fix startup_console_log_level removal. [#109858](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109858) ([Garrett Thomas](https://github.com/garrettthomaskth)).
* Backported in [#109986](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109986): CI: Pass -Zsanitizer=address to Rust in the combined address,undefined build. [#109950](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109950) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#110561](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110561): Fix flaky test_server_no_logging: poll for async "Restored console logger level" line. [#110033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110033) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#110749](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/110749): Harden 00965_send_logs_level_concurrent_queries: match <Trace> marker instead of awk field 8. [#110035](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110035) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.6.3.62-stable (c40659002db) FIXME as compared to v26.6.2.160-stable (493d30c1214)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#113189](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113189): Reduced peak memory usage of `BACKUP` by no longer copying the internal list of file infos when writing backup entries (significant for backups containing millions of files). [#111162](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111162) ([Julia Kartseva](https://github.com/jkartseva)).
* Backported in [#113822](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113822): Fix a ~1.5x performance regression introduced in 26.5 in `GROUP BY` over `Dynamic` keys and over `JSON` path subcolumns. [#112316](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112316) ([Utkal Singh](https://github.com/Utkal059)).
* Backported in [#113466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113466): Fixed a performance regression where a single lightweight `DELETE` disabled the query condition cache for the whole table. Repeated selective queries over a table that had ever been touched by a lightweight delete stopped pruning granules and fell back to reading every mark. [#112947](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112947) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#113889](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113889): Skip unnecessary mark file loads for JSON advanced shared data. [#107051](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107051) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#113894](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113894): Now it's possible to alter some auth settings of one-lake catalog with `ALTER DATABASE ... MODIFY SETTING = 'xxx'`. [#110019](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110019) ([alesapin](https://github.com/alesapin)).
* Backported in [#113658](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113658): Added the setting `analyzer_compatibility_multiple_joins_qualify_column_names` (default `false`). When enabled and the `FROM` clause of a query contains two or more `JOIN`s, result column names produced by the analyzer mimic the old analyzer's multiple-joins rewrite: columns expanded from `*` are named `<alias-or-table>.<column>`, and an unaliased column reference in the `SELECT` list keeps its name exactly as written. This makes outer queries that reference such qualified names, like `SELECT ll.Date FROM (SELECT * FROM t AS ll JOIN t1 ON ... JOIN t2 ON ...)`, work as they did with the old analyzer. Also fixed the analyzer losing qualified result column names for columns expanded from `*` when `group_by_use_nulls` is combined with `ROLLUP`, `CUBE` or `GROUPING SETS`, which produced duplicate result column names and broke outer references to those columns. [#110746](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110746) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#115217](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115217): The hive partitioning sample path for object storage tables (e.g. `S3`) is resolved on the first use of the table instead of `CREATE`/`ATTACH`, so an unreachable endpoint no longer blocks table creation and server startup. [#111842](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111842) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#114887](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114887): Support distributed query plans (`make_distributed_plan`) for queries whose source provably produces no rows at planning time, such as a read from an empty `MergeTree` table. Such queries previously failed with `SUPPORT_IS_DISABLED`. [#111941](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111941) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#114529](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114529): Fix `LOGICAL_ERROR` exceptions when reading `Iceberg` or `DeltaLake` data lake tables through paths that can reach the read pipeline without a pinned `datalake_table_state`, such as concurrent `Iceberg` metadata updates or `merge` reads over `DeltaLake` tables. [#102033](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/102033) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114586](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114586): Fix a rare `LOGICAL_ERROR` "Attempt to release query context that does not exist" and the accompanying server crash when reading `MergeTree` tables through a filesystem cache disk created with `enable_filesystem_query_cache_limit = 1`. [#107028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107028) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114158](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114158): Reject unsupported uses of `AggregateFunction` columns in TTL expressions at `CREATE TABLE` time (e.g. `TTL toDateTime(state)`) instead of failing later during TTL execution with `ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT`. This also covers states carried inside `Variant` alternatives and `Dynamic` values. Valid state-aware consumers such as `finalizeAggregation` are still accepted. [#107366](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107366) ([Ria Khatoniar](https://github.com/Ria-K912)).
* Backported in [#114448](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114448): Fixed reading Iceberg v3 tables whose Parquet data files contain reserved row-lineage columns (such as `_row_id`); the native Parquet reader no longer raises `ICEBERG_SPECIFICATION_VIOLATION` for reserved field ids that are not part of the table schema. [#107377](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107377) ([Greg Maher](https://github.com/gregakinman)).
* Backported in [#112792](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112792): Fix `type_json_allow_duplicated_key_with_literal_and_nested_object` not working with typed paths in JSON. [#108218](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108218) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#114714](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114714): Fix possible logical error "Unexpected substream ... for column ..." during bump of compatibility setting. [#109496](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109496) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#113091](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113091): With `analyzer_compatibility_join_using_top_level_identifier = 1`, an identifier in `JOIN ... USING` can now be resolved from an alias defined on a subexpression inside the SELECT list (for example, `SELECT uniqExact(lower(x) AS id) FROM t1 JOIN t2 USING (id)`), matching the old analyzer behavior. Previously only top-level projection aliases were considered, and such queries failed with an `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` exception even with the setting enabled. The error hint suggesting the setting is now also produced when the matching alias is nested. [#110739](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110739) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#113569](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113569): Fixed a `LOGICAL_ERROR` ("Bad cast from ColumnString to ColumnLowCardinality") during primary-key index analysis when a `LowCardinality` key column is wrapped in a nested `CAST` chain that re-introduces `LowCardinality`, e.g. `WHERE CAST(CAST(s, 'LowCardinality(String)'), 'String') < '5'`. In debug and sanitizer builds this aborted the server; in release it failed the query. [#111050](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111050) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113567](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113567): Fixed a logical error `Block structure mismatch` (in debug and sanitizer builds) and an `Illegal types of arguments` error for set operations over compatible aggregate-state columns (e.g. `quantileState` and `quantilesState(0.9)`) nested inside container columns such as `Tuple`, `Array`, `Map`, `Nullable`, or `Variant`. [#111191](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111191) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115091](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115091): `RESTORE` now fsyncs the restored part files when the destination table has `fsync_after_insert` enabled, so a restored part is as durable against power loss as an inserted one. Previously restored files were only written and closed (never fsynced), so a power loss right after `RESTORE` returned `RESTORED` could leave the parts torn and the table empty. [#111378](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111378) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113199](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113199): Now RestCatalog throw proper exception instead of silence or "UNKNOWN_TABLE" in case of stale credentials. [#111379](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111379) ([alesapin](https://github.com/alesapin)).
* Backported in [#114392](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114392): Fix a logical error `Block structure mismatch in IntersectOrExceptStep stream: different number of columns` that could happen when the filter split optimization (`query_plan_split_filter`) ran on a `WHERE` whose filter column name is also an input column name. The optimization left an internal `__split_filter` column in the branch output header, which then diverged from the sibling branch of a set operation such as `INTERSECT` or `UNION`. [#111930](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111930) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114781](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114781): Fixed a stack frame being displayed as `?` instead of its function name in fatal log messages and in the `trace_full` column of `system.crash_log`. It affected frames of ordinary functions that have code attributed to a libc++ `__functional` header, which is common in release builds. [#112152](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112152) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115196](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115196): Fixes cases where row policy was not used for MergeTree Projections during query execution. [#112329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112329) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#113875](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113875): Fix out-of-bounds read in SerializationReplicated on the native protocol on corrupted indexes data. [#112331](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112331) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#114441](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114441): Security related bugfix. [#112479](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112479) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#114575](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114575): Fixed a crash when reading a Parquet file with inconsistent bloom filter metadata. Such files could also silently return fewer rows than they should. [#112498](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112498) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#114618](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114618): Fix AsynchronousBoundedReadBuffer's readBigAt data race. Closes [#109678](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109678). [#112573](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112573) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#113260](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113260): Fix an out-of-bounds read (a crash in release builds) in insert deduplication when an `INSERT` flows through a materialized view whose inner query changes the number of rows and the deduplicating target table is partitioned. `DeduplicationInfo::filterToPartition` attributed each deduplication token to partitions by walking the token's source-row range over a partition selector sized to the (smaller) view-output block, reading past its bounds. It now keeps every token in every partition for any materialized-view target — where the source-row-to-partition mapping no longer exists after the row count changed — instead of the out-of-bounds walk (and instead of the `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` that a later guard raised for the same insert). [#112649](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112649) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#115210](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115210): Fix `DROP TABLE` and `SYSTEM STOP VIEW` hanging when a Refreshable Materialized View is blocked while planning its refresh query. [#113188](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113188) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#113792](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113792): Fixed a case where `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Distributed(...)` without a column list could reveal the structure of a local table the creating user is not allowed to see. For a `CREATE` the local server executes itself, the structure is now inferred under the user's own context, so `SHOW COLUMNS` on the target table is required, as it already is for the `Remote` engine. A `CREATE` replayed from the DDL queue (`ON CLUSTER`, or one inside a `Replicated` database) is not covered. [#113220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113220) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113882](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113882): Fixed reading the internal `_temporary_and_external_tables` database through the `merge` table function and the `Merge` table engine, which allowed one session to read the temporary tables of other sessions and other users, and caused an exception on the old analyzer path. A database regexp now skips that database, and naming it explicitly is denied, the same way as direct access to it is. [#113224](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113224) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114970](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114970): Fixed wrong results when a hash join has a single `LowCardinality` key of a type wider than 8 bytes (`UInt128`, `Int128`, `UInt256`, `Int256`, and their `Nullable` variants). Such a join silently returned rows whose key values are not equal. [#113230](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113230) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114476): Fixed a query plan optimization stall when a `WHERE` clause contains a large string constant with many dots and the table carries a `bloom_filter`, `tokenbf_v1`, `ngrambf_v1` or `text` skip index. Matching a filter column name against `JSONAllPaths(...)` index columns enumerated every dot split of the name, which made skip-index condition building quadratic in the constant's length. Closes [#113003](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113003). [#113289](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113289) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114220):. [#113291](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113291) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#113497](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113497): Fix a rare use-after-free bug that is triggered in a rare event of the async insert queue having different entries with identical deadlines. Now it's handled gracefully. [#113363](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113363) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#113803](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113803): Fixed a case where `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Buffer(...)` without a column list could reveal the structure of a destination table the creating user is not allowed to see. For a `CREATE` the local server executes itself, the structure is now inferred under the user's own context, so `SHOW COLUMNS` on the destination is required, as it already is for `Merge` and `Remote`. A `CREATE` replayed from the DDL queue (`ON CLUSTER`, or inside a `Replicated` database) is not covered. [#113372](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113372) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114334](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114334): Fixed `ATTACH` of a `Kafka` table when `kafka_num_consumers` exceeds the limit derived from the number of CPU cores. [#113390](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113390) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#114663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114663): Fixed reading Paimon tables that contain a nullable `ARRAY` or `MAP` column. Such a table could not be read at all, because the schema mapper wrapped the composite type in `Nullable`, which ClickHouse forbids, so both `DESC` and `SELECT` failed with `Nested type Array(Nullable(Int32)) cannot be inside Nullable type`. A nullable composite column is now mapped to a non-`Nullable` composite type and a `NULL` value is read as an empty one. Closes [#113337](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113337). [#113450](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113450) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114492](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114492): Fix part and granule pruning for a `JOIN ON` condition involving constant columns of the other side. [#113484](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113484) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#114310](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114310): Fixed a row policy containing a scalar subquery being evaluated only once and then reused forever after the table had been read through a `Merge` table. The parsed policy condition is cached and shared by all queries, and reading it through `Merge` rewrote the cached expression in place, which also caused a data race between concurrent queries using the same policy. [#113563](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113563) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113815](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113815): Fix a wrong value returned for a virtual column such as `_table` or `_database` selected from the right side of a JOIN served by `DirectKeyValueJoin` (a key-value storage such as `EmbeddedRocksDB`, `KeeperMap`, `Redis`, or a dictionary). The query returned the contents of a data column instead, or failed with `LOGICAL_ERROR`. [#113698](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113698) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114634](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114634): Fix `CANNOT_CONVERT_TYPE` and an exception in `GroupingAggregatedTransform` when reading a `Merge` table with one child being a `Distributed` table under custom-key parallel replicas (`parallel_replicas_mode = 'custom_key_sampling'` or `'custom_key_range'`). Closes [#113741](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113741). [#113742](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113742) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114719](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114719): Fixed `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` returning fewer rows than requested, possibly none, when a row policy was the only filter of the query and the sort column had a `minmax` skip index. The top-K optimization narrowed the read before the row policy was applied. [#114073](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114073) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115052](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115052): Fixed an exception when reading a `MergeTree` table by primary-key range layers when a layer produces an empty pipe. [#114177](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114177) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114683](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114683): Fixed `ATTACH PARTITION FROM`, `REPLACE PARTITION`, `MOVE PARTITION TO TABLE` and adding a `ReplicatedMergeTree` replica failing with `Tables have different ...`, `METADATA_MISMATCH` or `INCOMPATIBLE_COLUMNS` for tables whose definitions were written with redundant parentheses, such as `PARTITION BY (a)`, `ORDER BY (b)`, `INDEX ix (b * c) TYPE minmax`, `PROJECTION p (SELECT (b) ...)`, `CONSTRAINT c CHECK (a > 0)`, `TTL (d + INTERVAL 10 YEAR)` or `DEFAULT (a + 1)`. [#114188](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114188) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114877](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114877): Fixed heap memory corruption when reading Parquet through an input format that owns its read buffer, for example a dictionary with `SOURCE(FILE(... format 'Parquet'))`. Background prefetch and decode tasks could still read and write through the buffer after the pipeline released it, which could abort the server. [#114668](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114668) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115258](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115258): Fixed wrong results of the trivial `GROUP BY ... LIMIT` optimization (setting `optimize_trivial_group_by_limit_query`) for queries with `DISTINCT`, `QUALIFY`, window functions, or `arrayJoin` in the projection: these consume or filter the groups after the aggregation, so capping the aggregation at `LIMIT + OFFSET` keys could return too few rows or wrong values. The optimization no longer applies to such queries. [#114695](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114695) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#114702](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114702): Update `libssh` to 0.12.0. [#108329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108329) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113144](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113144): Update the vendored `libexpat` to 2.8.2. [#112593](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112593) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113132](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113132): Update `jwt-cpp` to v0.7.2. [#112595](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112595) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113127](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113127): Update `libcotp` to v4.2.1. [#112596](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112596) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113542](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113542): Update Apache Arrow to 25.0.0 and Apache ORC to 2.3.1. [#112604](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112604) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113538](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113538): Update Protocol Buffers to v35.1 and gRPC to v1.83.0. [#112614](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112614) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Use curl 8.21.0. [#115212](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115212) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#114226](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114226): Iterate ColumnObject subcolumns in sorted path order. [#112601](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112601) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backport [#108391](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108391) to 26.6: Fix data race on `MemoryReservation` release at query finish. [#112885](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112885) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113526](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113526): Fix `Field::operator<=` comparing a `Float64` with itself. [#113010](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113010) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113719](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113719): Keep the Map `bucket_indexes` stream in sync when rows are skipped. [#113047](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113047) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114972](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114972): Recover a dead py4j gateway in ResilientSparkSession. [#113430](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113430) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114298](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114298): Add a dedicated thread pool for lightweight snapshot creation. [#113509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113509) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backported in [#113831](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113831): Make the boolean case of `04308_arrow_oob_reads_value` corrupt only the declared row count, so it reaches the per-element bit-packed buffer guard it is meant to cover. [#113593](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113593) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115242](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115242): This patch: 1. Removes the global error screen (blue screen) and replaces it with a note above the dashboards. In this approach, on any error, already fetched graphs will not be hidden. 2. Dashboard now opens the graphs view immediately. 3. Reload button and any other button can be pressed during runtime refresh - this will cancel all in-flight queries and start a new refresh with the new configuration immediately. 4. Newly added graphs do not trigger a full page refresh; only new graphs will be fetched. [#115019](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115019) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
