# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.6.4.55-stable (27ca7c373d6) FIXME as compared to v26.6.3.62-stable (c40659002db)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#117027](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117027): Push a `WHERE` condition on a `USING` column through a `RIGHT JOIN` so the left `MergeTree` input can use it as a primary-key index condition, also when the two join keys have different types. Applies when `enable_analyzer = 1`. [#103478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103478) ([Manuel](https://github.com/raimannma)).
* Backported in [#116312](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116312): Bounded the cost of estimating the selectivity of `col IN (...)` from column statistics, which could add hundreds of milliseconds to the planning of a single query. The estimator no longer runs the subquery behind `col IN (subquery)` to fill a set it only needs one selectivity number from — an unbuilt set is skipped instead. For a set larger than the new `statistics_max_set_size_for_exact_selectivity_estimation` setting (default 10000), the selectivity is now derived from the size of the set and its bounding range. [#114389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114389) ([Nikita Taranov](https://github.com/nickitat)).
* Backported in [#116282](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116282): Fixed a CPU regression for queries that issue many independent small reads against the same `MergeTree` part when the table has `LowCardinality` columns. The check deciding whether a part has a single shared dictionary scanned every mark of the whole part on each read task; it now finds each run of equal marks by binary search instead. Queries of this shape on tables with a small `index_granularity` were up to several times slower since 26.6. [#116134](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116134) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117080](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117080): Fixed a performance regression since 26.6: a query filtering a `Nullable` column with `IN (subquery)` read the whole table instead of skipping the read when the subquery returned no rows. Closes [#116450](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116450). [#116538](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116538) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#117290](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117290): Sped up SQL function `formatDateTime` with non-const timezone arguments. [#116851](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116851) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#116507](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116507): A `bloom_filter` skip index on an `Array` column is now used for `arrayJoin(column) IN (set)`, `arrayJoin(column) GLOBAL IN (set)` and `arrayJoin(column) = const`, the same way it was already used for `hasAny(column, set)` and `has(column, const)`. Previously these `arrayJoin ...` forms fell back to a full scan. [#109536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109536) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116297](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116297): Use the `bloom_filter` skip index for `IN` predicates on a directly indexed column when `transform_null_in = 1` and the `IN`-set contains no `NULL` value. Previously the index was skipped for such queries, forcing a full scan. [#111329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111329) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115793](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115793): Added a new MergeTree setting `text_index_version` that controls the on-disk format version of text indexes: `v0_initial`, `v1_with_codec`, or `v2_with_positions`. During a rolling upgrade or before a downgrade, set it to an older version so that newer servers keep writing text index parts in a format older servers can still read; the compatibility setting automatically adjusts it. [#111803](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111803) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#113852](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113852): Added fs cache download wait timeout configured by `filesystem_cache_wait_for_concurrent_download_timeout_milliseconds`. This timeout defined only the wait for a single chunk (buffer bytes of ~1mb) of data, not the whole file segment. [#113322](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113322) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#117052](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117052): Fix a `LOGICAL_ERROR` ("Different order of columns in UNION subquery") when the old analyzer (`enable_analyzer = 0`) reads a subset of columns from a subquery whose `UNION` children are `INTERSECT`/`EXCEPT` set operations. [#107511](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107511) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116683](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116683): Fix an out-of-bounds write when reading a `Variant` column from a malformed Native block whose discriminators reference a variant index that does not exist. [#107991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107991) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#117051](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117051): Fix a `LOGICAL_ERROR` (`Different list of shards in child plans`) when running a query with `make_distributed_plan = 1` over a `MergeTree` table that has a normal/aggregate projection. [#108256](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108256) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115452](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115452): Fixed `CREATE OR REPLACE MATERIALIZED VIEW ... POPULATE` leaving the new view unsubscribed from its source table, which silently dropped every row inserted after the replace. [#108728](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108728) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116984](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116984): Fixed `parallel_view_processing` setting being ignored when inserting into a table with materialized views — since 25.10, views always ran in parallel regardless of the setting. [#109170](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109170) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#117049](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117049): Constant folding during query planning no longer executes a function whose argument type differs from the type the function was resolved for during analysis. Such a mismatch used to raise a `LOGICAL_ERROR` while the output header was being computed, which is an assertion failure in debug and sanitizer builds. Folding is now skipped instead, and a genuinely invalid query still reports a recoverable `ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT` error from the normal execution path. [#109747](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109747) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117305](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117305): Fixed partition pruning returning no rows for Iceberg tables partitioned by a timestamp (DateTime64) column. [#109764](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109764) ([Den Kalantaevskii](https://github.com/Diskein)).
* Backported in [#114799](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114799): Fixed a use-after-free when a `JOIN` with `join_algorithm = 'direct'` onto a dictionary was given a join key that is stored with sparse serialization. `getColumnVectorData` returned a reference to a temporary column, so the dictionary lookup read freed memory: release builds could return wrong results and debug or sanitizer builds aborted. [#112327](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112327) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116654](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116654): Fixed `Logical error: 'Files metadata is empty'` when reading from, altering, or flushing an `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` table whose metadata handle is gone: concurrently with a `DROP`/`DETACH`, after a failed `startup`, or after a failed `DROP`. Such a table now reports `TABLE_IS_DROPPED` instead. `SYSTEM FLUSH OBJECT STORAGE QUEUE` on such a table no longer crashes the server. [#113695](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113695) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115594](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115594): Fix `Logical error: No set is registered for key ...` when reading through a `Merge` table whose child declares an `ALIAS` column containing `IN`, and the children disagree about that column's default. [#113757](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113757) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115410](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115410): Reject corrupted/malicious dictionary where `lcp` exceeds the previous token or `lcp + data_size` overflows, before the buffer write. [#114155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114155) ([Elmi Ahmadov](https://github.com/ahmadov)).
* Backported in [#116961](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116961): Fixes `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` queries on `Tuple()` columns raising a `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` exception when top-K dynamic filtering is enabled. Direct empty tuples now skip the optimization, while supported nested composite types continue to use top-K filtering. [#114182](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114182) ([Langning Zhang](https://github.com/Boulea7)).
* Backported in [#116097](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116097): Register Iceberg namespace in the catalog before writing table files (needed for SeaweedFS). [#114285](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114285) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).
* Backported in [#114894](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114894): Fixes a bug where an access entity carrying a `Map`-valued setting, such as a settings profile with `http_response_headers` or `additional_table_filters`, is stored in a form that ClickHouse cannot read back, leaving the entity permanently unloadable after a restart. [#114620](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114620) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115712](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115712): Fixes `has`, `indexOf`, `countEqual`, `mapContainsKey`, `mapContainsValue` and `Map` subscript returning "not found" for a constant `LowCardinality` needle equal to the element type's default value, such as an empty `String` or a zero number. [#114624](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114624) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116864](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116864): Fixes a server abort (`Logical error: Part patch-... doesn't exist`) when a `DROP TABLE` runs concurrently with a lightweight `UPDATE` on a `ReplicatedMergeTree` table. The update now holds the table's shared lock until its patch part is committed, so the `DROP` waits instead of removing it. [#114826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114826) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116166](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116166): The AI-function quota settings (`ai_function_max_api_calls_per_query`, `ai_function_max_input_tokens_per_query`, `ai_function_max_output_tokens_per_query`) were enforced per block rather than per query, letting a query exceed the configured limit in proportion to the number of blocks and threads processed. They now bound the whole query per server: the API-call limit is an exact cap (atomic reservation), and the token limits are best-effort. A distributed query enforces the limits independently on each participating server / fragment. [#114885](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114885) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#115538](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115538): Fix propagation of query settings and NULL handling in `accurateCastOrDefault`. [#114912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114912) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115858](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115858): Fixed a hang when dropping a `TimeSeries` table whose name sorts lexicographically below its inner tables' names, for example `` DROP TABLE `-ts` `` or dropping a materialized view declared with `ENGINE = TimeSeries`. The drop self-deadlocked on the DDL guard and could not be cancelled with `KILL QUERY`. [#114953](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114953) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115369](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115369): Disable distributed index analysis with projections (wrong results). [#115132](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115132) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).
* Backported in [#116535](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116535): Fixed an out-of-bounds read while deserializing corrupted posting lists of a text index. [#115222](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115222) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#115471](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115471): Fixed wrong results for `SELECT count(arrayJoin(arr))` with the default `optimize_trivial_count_query = 1`. The stored row count was returned instead of the number of array elements, and on `file()` and `url()` the query returned `0`. Closes [#115123](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115123). [#115227](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115227) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115814](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115814): Fixed a row policy bypass where the mergeTreeIndex table function exposed primary key and minmax index values of the rows hidden by a SELECT row policy on the source table; reading mergeTreeIndex for a table with a row policy is now denied. [#115304](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115304) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#116265](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116265): Fixed a bypass of settings constraints: `SET <name> = DEFAULT` reset a setting without checking the constraints from the user's profile, so a `MIN`/`MAX`/`CONST` constraint could be escaped by resetting the setting instead of assigning to it, and a session could leave readonly mode with `SET readonly = DEFAULT`. [#115334](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115334) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117155): Fixed a settings-constraint bypass: a `SETTINGS` clause inside a subquery, a CTE or a view's inner query was applied without checking the settings constraints, so it could be used to leave readonly mode or to override a `CONST`, `MIN` or `MAX` constraint (for example `additional_table_filters`, breaking row-level isolation). The nested clause is now clamped to the constraints: violating changes are dropped, out-of-bounds values are clamped into their bounds, and the rest of the clause applies. Existing views whose inner query carries such a clause keep working, with the constraints enforced; a clause on the outer query still throws, as before. [#115397](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115397) ([Itamar Tempelhof](https://github.com/tempel-it)).
* Backported in [#116403](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116403): Validate Variant discriminator in ColumnVariant arena deserialization. [#115443](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115443) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).
* Backported in [#115601](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115601): Fixed `uniq`, `uniqExact`, `uniqHLL12` and `uniqTheta` returning a wrong result for an argument wrapped in an injective function that hides nullability, such as `uniqExact(tuple(x))` over a `Nullable` column. The `optimize_injective_functions_inside_uniq` optimization removed the wrapping function, after which NULL rows were skipped instead of counted. [#115466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115466) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#115753](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115753): Fix `read_rows`, `read_bytes`, `written_rows` and `written_bytes` in `system.query_thread_log` reporting a thread lifetime running total instead of the values for the logged query. Rows of long-lived pooled threads, in particular the query's initiating `HTTPHandler` thread, were affected. [#115596](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115596) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115844](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115844): Allow KeeperMap readers to accept shared metadata when equivalent primary keys differ only by redundant outer parentheses. [#115642](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115642) ([Sergey Kuznetsov](https://github.com/skuznetsov-clickhouse)).
* Backported in [#115730](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115730): Fixed a bug in the function `formatRowNoNewline` that could produce incorrect results or a logical error when a row is formatted to an empty result. [#115669](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115669) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115954](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115954): Fix server crashes on deeply nested input in `readWKB`, `JSONMergePatch`, the address parser of the `url`/`remote`/`cluster`/`mysql`/`postgresql` table functions, the `CURSOR` clause parser and the CapnProto schema parser. Fix a crash in the parser of the `EXECUTE` statement when an argument is not a literal. [#115700](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115700) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116352](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116352): Validate the states of the `stochasticLinearRegression`, `stochasticLogisticRegression`, `groupUniqArray`, `groupArrayIntersect` and `topK` aggregate functions and of the `Resample` combinator on deserialization: a malformed state could be read out of bounds. [#115701](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115701) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115929](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115929): Do not return uninitialized memory in the result of a binary string literal whose length is not a multiple of eight, and from the LZ4 decompressor when a compressed block has no body. [#115704](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115704) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116003](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116003): Bound the size of the startup message of the PostgreSQL wire protocol, which is read before authentication. [#115708](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115708) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116752](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116752): Reject unsupported and mixed read/write operations in ZooKeeper multi requests. [#115768](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115768) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#116862](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116862): Mask the `aws_external_id` setting of the `DataLakeCatalog` database engine in `SHOW CREATE DATABASE` and `system.databases.engine_full`. It was previously printed in plaintext, unlike the other AWS credential settings. Closes: [#114999](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114999). [#115791](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115791) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116116](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116116): Reject invalid names of projections and indexes. [#115824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115824) ([Alexander Tokmakov](https://github.com/tavplubix)).
* Backported in [#116112](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116112): Add Objects' paths to deduplication hashing, preventing incorrect deduplication. [#115866](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115866) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#116517](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116517): Fix a crash of the `showCertificate` function on a server that obtains its TLS certificate with ACME (Let's Encrypt). The function now reports the certificate that is actually served, also after a certificate reload. [#115976](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115976) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117055](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117055): Fixed a `WHERE _table = ...` or `WHERE _database = ...` condition over a `Merge` table silently returning no rows when the matching child table reads its data from other tables, for example a `Distributed`, `Merge`, `Buffer`, or `Alias` child. Such children are now always read, and the condition filters their rows. [#116371](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116371) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117150](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117150): Sizes declared by a server in the Native protocol no longer make the client allocate memory for data that has not arrived: exception strings are read as they arrive, the decompressed size of a block is bounded, and the maximum number of rows in a `Native` block is now a billion. [#117011](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117011) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#116068](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116068): Fix TSAN data race in executeASTFuzzerQueries clearing caller's transaction. [#103158](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103158) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117088](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117088): Fix flaky 03151_unload_index_race: guard count compare against empty read. [#110480](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110480) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#116741](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116741): Fix flaky test_kafka_formats_with_broken_message. [#111701](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111701) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Pin fuzzer and DROP behavior in the KeeperMap metadata test on 26.6. [#116730](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116730) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.6.5.120-stable (ec30b12c0a5) FIXME as compared to v26.6.4.55-stable (27ca7c373d6)

#### Backward Incompatible Change
* Backported in [#118547](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118547): Reading a `File` source with `rename_files_after_processing` set now requires the `WRITE ON FILE` grant on top of `READ ON FILE`, on the initiator for `fileCluster`: the setting renames the files a `SELECT` has read, which is a write to the source, and it used to happen for anyone who could read them. A query relying on it now needs `GRANT WRITE ON FILE`. A per-query renaming rule is also no longer cached by a `Filesystem` database, where it could make an unrelated later query rename files, or be dropped silently. [#117895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117895) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#119435](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119435): Jemalloc Fragmentation Profiler. [#115456](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115456) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#117333](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117333): SHOW TABLES and system.tables on DataLake catalogs (Iceberg REST, Glue, Unity, Hive, Paimon) now push namespace-bound predicates down to the catalog, avoiding a full-catalog scan. resolves #[#105022](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/105022). [#106029](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106029) ([Smita Kulkarni](https://github.com/SmitaRKulkarni)).
* Backported in [#117530](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117530): Avoid eager JSON serialization of Iceberg manifest entries when iceberg_metadata_log_level is below the call site's threshold. [#110437](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110437) ([Andy Bradshaw](https://github.com/andybradshaw)).
* Backported in [#116758](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116758): Fixed a performance regression where a query combining a text index filter with `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` stopped answering the filter from the index and read the whole text column instead. [#115586](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115586) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#117642](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117642): Fix performance regression introduced in 26.4 when writing `JSON` and `Dynamic` columns in text formats. [#115852](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115852) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#119277](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119277): Shard the serialization object pool to reduce lock contention and avoid a heap allocation on every serialization lookup. [#116869](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116869) ([Manuel](https://github.com/raimannma)).
* Backported in [#118453](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118453): The bound on the cost of estimating the selectivity of `col IN (...)` from column statistics, controlled by `statistics_max_set_size_for_exact_selectivity_estimation`, is now also applied when `compatibility` is set to 26.6 or an earlier version. [#118095](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118095) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#119288](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119288): Log when an object storage listing returns an empty page while reporting that more objects follow. This is legal and is handled correctly, but it has twice been the trigger for silently losing objects and nothing recorded that it occurred. [#119065](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119065) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#117558](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117558): Fix a server crash in predicate pushdown (`enable_optimize_predicate_expression`, legacy analyzer) when a `UNION` subquery appears inside a `JOIN ... ON` condition. [#107930](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107930) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118301](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118301): Fixed a server crash (`LOGICAL_ERROR: 'Unexpected exception in refresh scheduling'`) that could happen on startup when a coordinated refreshable materialized view in a `Replicated` database was attached on a Keeper that does not support the `MULTI_READ` feature flag (for example after a Keeper downgrade). The view is now stopped gracefully instead of aborting the server. [#108441](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108441) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118067](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118067): Fixed SQL injection in the PostgreSQL wire protocol emulation. Prepared-statement parameters — the `Parse`/`Bind`/`Execute` extended-query path used by `psycopg2`, JDBC, `node-postgres`, Npgsql and others, and the simple-query `EXECUTE` path — were substituted into the executed SQL by raw string splicing, so a crafted parameter could break out of its value position and inject SQL. Parameters are now bound as data. This also fixes string parameters that previously failed with `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` when a client sent them unquoted. [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108469) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116721](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116721): Fixed a credential leak where the legacy `storage_aws_access_key_id`, `storage_aws_secret_access_key`, `storage_catalog_credential`, and `storage_auth_header` settings of the `DataLakeCatalog` database engine were shown in plaintext in `system.databases.engine_full` and `SHOW CREATE DATABASE`. They are now redacted as `[HIDDEN]`. [#108470](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108470) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117669](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117669): Enforce the `http_forbid_headers` configuration during schema inference for the `url()` table function and `URL` storage engine. Previously a forbidden header was still sent over the network while inferring the schema (for example with the `Regexp` format or `DESCRIBE`), and its response body could be reflected back in a parse error, leaking secrets. The header filter is now checked before any network access on the inference path, matching the existing behavior of `urlCluster`. [#108476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108476) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118844](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118844): Fixed RabbitMQ table engine hanging indefinitely on `DROP TABLE` or server shutdown when the broker closes the AMQP connection due to missed heartbeats without sending a TCP RST. All blocking event loop calls now have a 30-second timeout so shutdown always completes. [#108497](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108497) ([Aly Ayman](https://github.com/alyelmorsy-dataengineer)).
* Backported in [#117538](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117538): The `ArrowFlight` table engine and the `arrowFlight` table function now honor the `<remote_url_allow_hosts>` allow-list. Previously the connection host and port were not validated, so a query could reach hosts not present in the allow-list. [#108507](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108507) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#109173](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109173): Fixes a null-pointer dereference segfault in `StreamingStorageRegistry` that occurs when `StreamingStorageRegistry::shutdown` and `StorageObjectStorageQueue::shutdown` are called concurrently. [#108810](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108810) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#117634](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117634): Fixed a server crash when the aggregate functions `cramersV`, `cramersVBiasCorrected`, `contingency` or `theilsU` states from a window context (`OVER ()`) and from a plain aggregation are combined through chained set operations (`EXCEPT`, `INTERSECT`) or nested `UNION ALL` and then read, for example via the `-Merge` combinator. [#109200](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109200) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118922](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118922): Rejects non-monotonic `Array` offsets on every read path that decodes them as absolute values, instead of only in the `Native` format. A corrupt `set` skip index granule previously passed unchecked and was then read out of bounds. [#109212](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109212) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117868](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117868): Fixed a privilege-escalation gap where the `executable` table function did not enforce the `TABLE ENGINE ON Executable` grant. With `table_engines_require_grant` enabled, a user denied `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Executable` could still run the same server-side script via `SELECT ... FROM executable(...)`. It now requires `GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON Executable`, matching `CREATE TABLE`. [#109331](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109331) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118614](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118614): Fix `ObjectStorageQueue`/`AzureQueue` (and the `azureBlobStorage` table function) silently skipping objects when the object storage returns an empty listing page together with a continuation token. Azure Blob Storage does this (e.g. when a listing crosses an internal partition boundary), and the async list iterator was treating the empty page as the end of the listing and dropping the token. It now follows the continuation token. [#109761](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109761) ([Gal Ben Moshe](https://github.com/GalBenMoshe)).
* Backported in [#116191](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116191): Fix a data race (and rare crash) when a parsing/analysis error is reported while reading a file/object storage table. A parse error raised during lazy `KeyCondition` initialization was shared as a single exception object across reader threads, and two threads could concurrently append `(in file/uri ...)` to its message, racing on the exception message string. [#109911](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109911) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113482](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113482): Fix server crashes and wrong `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` / `LOGICAL_ERROR` failures in a `direct` JOIN over a MergeTree right table. The plan is cloned and re-optimized per lookup across threads, but the clone shared two mutable objects with the original: the `PrewhereInfo`/`row_level_filter` DAG, corrupted in place by column pruning, and the `StorageSnapshot`, whose data parts are stripped in place. [#109932](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109932) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117418](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117418): Fix silently wrong query results when a projection part written before the projection's column set changed (for example, after upgrading across versions that materialize an `ALIAS` column's source differently, or after `ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN` re-points an `ALIAS` column used by a projection) was read through the projection or merged: the missing column was filled with default values instead of the real data. Such parts are now read from the base table, and merges rebuild the projection from the base data. [#110328](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110328) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#117743](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117743): Fixed reading a corrupted `Native`-format stream whose `Dynamic` type count or `JSON`/`Object` path count is close to `SIZE_MAX`: such malformed input is now rejected with a clear `INCORRECT_DATA` error instead of an uncaught `std::length_error`. [#110590](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110590) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118992](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118992): Fix `PREWHERE` (and row-level policies) on an Iceberg column that was renamed by schema evolution silently returning `0` rows for old data files. Such queries now return the correct rows, matching `WHERE`. [#110941](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110941) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119619](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119619): Fixed potential data loss when an `INSERT` into `ReplicatedMergeTree` was cancelled or timed out while ClickHouse was recovering an uncertain Keeper commit. [#111196](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111196) ([kakao-tars-case](https://github.com/kakao-tars-case)).
* Backported in [#118998](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118998): Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE` leaving the replaced object behind under an internal name when the caller lacks the drop privilege on it. [#111466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111466) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#118762](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118762): Fixed a SQL injection in the PostgreSQL metadata queries. The `schema` of the `PostgreSQL` database engine, the requested column names and the publication name were formatted into SQL literals without escaping, so a value containing a quote could execute arbitrary SQL on the connected PostgreSQL server as the role ClickHouse connects with. Reaching it through `schema` needed only `CREATE DATABASE` plus use of a named collection whose `schema` is overridable. [#111516](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111516) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#119206](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119206): Fix `count()` on Iceberg tables whose snapshot summary is inaccurate or corrupted: the trivial count optimization now derives exact row counts from the manifest files, and falls back to a real scan when row-level deletes make metadata counts inexact. Also fix Iceberg `OPTIMIZE TABLE` writing incorrect manifest-list counts and lineage, and make `totalBytes` metadata robust against corrupted summaries. [#111617](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111617) ([Melvyn Peignon](https://github.com/melvynator)).
* Backported in [#117506](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117506): Fix Iceberg tables written by ClickHouse being unreadable by external readers (PyIceberg, Spark). The Avro schemas embedded in the manifest-list and manifest files omitted the Iceberg `field-id` properties, so scan planning failed with `Cannot convert field, missing field-id`. [#111786](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111786) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114840](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114840): Fixed a server abort (`SIGABRT`) when a `BUFFERED_V1` WebAssembly UDF returns an empty result buffer; the query now fails with a catchable `WASM_ERROR` and the server stays up. [#112182](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112182) ([Nikolai Ovchinnikov](https://github.com/kolsha)).
* Backported in [#116389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116389): Fixes a `bloom_filter` skip index dropping granules that contain matching rows when a `String` or `FixedString` column is compared for equality against a constant that is wider than the indexed type, so that queries such as `SELECT count() FROM t WHERE s = toFixedString('abc', 5)` no longer silently return too few rows. [#112639](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112639) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115190](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115190): Fixed the logical error `SortingAggregatedTransform already got bucket with number N` that could occur in multi-layer distributed `GROUP BY` queries using two-level aggregation. [#112794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112794) ([Nikita Taranov](https://github.com/nickitat)).
* Backported in [#117499](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117499): Fix `allow_feature_tier` rejecting `merge_tree_`-prefixed settings in settings profiles as unknown, and rejecting `CREATE TABLE` because of `MergeTree` settings set by the server through `compatibility` or the `merge_tree` config section. Also fix constraints on a `merge_tree_`-prefixed setting being bypassed when the setting is written through its alias, and a statement that rewrites the value such a setting already has being refused by a `CONST` constraint. [#113156](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113156) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118727](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118727): Fixed `LOGICAL_ERROR` when reading a table with a `set` skip index defined on an expression and the query repeats that expression with a `Nullable` operand, for example `WHERE intDiv(id, (SELECT 1000)) = 3` over `INDEX b_set intDiv(id, 1000) TYPE set(100)`. A scalar subquery is enough to trigger it, since it is typed `Nullable`. [#113244](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113244) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#118594](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118594): Fixed a data race and a use-after-free on the metadata of a DeltaLake or Iceberg table. Two concurrent queries that read `total_rows` or `total_bytes` from `system.tables` for the same table could have one query replace the table's metadata while the other was still reading it, which could crash the server. Closes [#113265](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113265). [#113427](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113427) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117036](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117036): Fix wrong statistics part pruning for negated float predicates with NaN. [#113507](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113507) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backported in [#116765](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116765): Fix a crash for `ORDER BY ALL` in a `WINDOW VIEW`, and `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` errors for `INTERPOLATE`, `WINDOW` and `LIMIT BY` in a query over a `Merge` or `Distributed` table with a join, with the old analyzer. [#113759](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113759) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117692](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117692): Fixes memory leaks of abandoned nested aggregate states. [#113926](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113926) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115560](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115560): Fix `std::out_of_range: map::at: key not found` when a `MergeTree` key expression contains a `mortonEncode` or `hilbertEncode` call that is not itself a key column, for example `ORDER BY mortonEncode(hilbertEncode(x, y), x, y)` or `PARTITION BY mortonEncode(x, y) % 4`. [#114233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115137](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115137): Fixes a server crash that happens when aggregate states of the `-OrNull` or `-OrDefault` combinators are merged with `group_by_overflow_mode = 'any'` and a non-zero `max_rows_to_group_by`, for example when a query reads through an aggregate projection. [#114740](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114740) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119481): Fixed a `LOGICAL_ERROR: Context has expired` exception when a stored expression containing `accurateCastOrDefault` or a `to<Type>OrDefault` function is evaluated after the query that created it has finished, for example a `MATERIALIZED` column default on `INSERT` or a mutation expression. [#114769](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114769) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117933](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117933): Fix wrong results when a filter on a combined literal+sub-object `JSON` subcolumn (``json.@`a``) was analyzed against a `JSONAllPaths` skip index: the subcolumn was treated as a path literally named `` @`a` ``, so all granules were skipped and the query returned fewer rows than it should. [#114873](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114873) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#118252](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118252): Fixed incremental backups to Azure Blob Storage storing the beginning of each file instead of its tail. Restoring such a backup silently dropped all the data written after the base backup. [#114975](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114975) ([Smita Kulkarni](https://github.com/SmitaRKulkarni)).
* Backported in [#117689](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117689): Fixed an exception (`Block structure mismatch in Expression for FilterSortedStreamByRange`) for some `SELECT ... FINAL` queries with `PREWHERE` over a table whose sorting key is an expression. [#115113](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115113) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#117751](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117751): Fixed silently incorrect results and undefined behavior when reading a malformed `AggregateFunction(uniq, ...)` state. The `skip_degree` field of the serialized state was used as a shift exponent without validation, so an out-of-range value produced an arbitrary cardinality instead of an error. Such states are now rejected with `INCORRECT_DATA`. [#115276](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115276) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118105](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118105): Fixed wrong results from `if`, `multiIf` and `CASE` when one branch is a `Date` or `Date32` and the result type is `DateTime` or `DateTime64`. With `compile_expressions = 1` (the default) the compiled expression copied the date's day count into the timestamp column without converting days to seconds, so `if(cond, toDate32('1900-01-01'), toDateTime64('1970-01-01', 3))` returned `1969-12-31 23:59:34.433`. Closes [#115272](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115272). [#115325](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115325) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116410](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116410): Fixes asynchronous inserts into `JSON` columns ignoring the `max_dynamic_subcolumns_in_json_type_parsing` setting. Previously, an asynchronous insert (`async_insert = 1`) could store more dynamic paths than the setting allows, giving a different column layout than a synchronous insert with the same settings. The cap is now preserved when asynchronous inserts aggregate parsed data. [#115329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115329) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#117471](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117471): Fix a case where expensive ZooKeeper exception logging could delay session finalization and leave pending requests unresolved. [#115396](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115396) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#117377](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117377): Fix `GroupingAggregatedTransform` producing duplicate chunks for the same bucket. [#115487](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115487) ([Nikita Taranov](https://github.com/nickitat)).
* Backported in [#117663](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117663): Reject a bare carriage return (`\r`), in addition to a line feed (`\n`), in HTTP header names and values that pass through the HTTP header filter. This closes an HTTP header injection (request/response splitting) gap for features that pass user-provided headers, such as the `url` table function and engine, HTTP dictionaries, and data lake catalogs. [#115510](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115510) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#118200](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118200): Fix an integer overflow in the deserialization of `String` values in the binary formats, and bound the recursion of the binary deserialization of `Dynamic` and `JSON` values. [#115702](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115702) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116652](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116652): Fix crashes of the Parquet, ORC and Iceberg readers on malformed input: a `DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY` page with an empty length stream, a `DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY` page of a `Decimal` column read under a filter, an out-of-range enum in an Iceberg manifest file and an oversized allocation in the ORC library. [#115703](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115703) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117076](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117076): Fix a crash of a window function over a `Tuple` with a sparse element, for example `groupConcat(t) OVER ()`. [#115705](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115705) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118677](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118677): Fix a use-after-free in the gRPC server when a query with a streaming input finishes while a read of the next message is still in flight. [#115707](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115707) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119656): Fix `LOGICAL_ERROR: No available columns` when a query reads no columns from a table expression that has no columns at all, for example `SELECT count() FROM loop(db, tbl)` where `tbl` is an `Alias` table whose target was dropped, or a parameterized view. Such a query now fails with `UNSUPPORTED_METHOD` instead of aborting the server in debug and sanitizer builds. [#115716](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115716) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117639](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117639): Fixed `ILLEGAL_COLUMN` ("Cannot convert column ... because it is non constant in source stream but must be constant in result") for a query combining `ARRAY JOIN` with a filter on an empty `IN` set, whether the set is an empty list such as `SELECT count() FROM t ARRAY JOIN [b] AS x WHERE a IN ()` or an empty `ENGINE = Set` table. Closes [#116018](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116018). ### Description. [#116057](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116057) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116709](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116709): Fix wrong window function results for `PARTITION BY` over a floating-point key (also `JSON`, `Dynamic`, and these types nested in `Nullable`/`LowCardinality`/`Array`/`Tuple`/`Map`/`Variant`) with `max_threads > 1`: values that compare as equal, such as `-0.` and `0.`, could hash into different threads, and one logical partition got several window frames. [#116315](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116315) ([Alexander Gololobov](https://github.com/davenger)).
* Backported in [#116493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116493): KeeperMap now writes single-expression primary keys without redundant outer parentheses, so metadata created by newer servers remains readable by ClickHouse 26.4 during supported rolling upgrades and rollbacks. [#116369](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116369) ([Sergey Kuznetsov](https://github.com/skuznetsov-clickhouse)).
* Backported in [#117366](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117366): Fix a `bloom_filter` skip index returning fewer rows for `IN` on an `Array` column when the set contains an empty array, for example `WHERE x IN ([])`. [#116449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116449) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117929](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117929): Fixed the `Unexpected return type from materialize` logical error when reading a column that has a `text` index through the index after a metadata-only or not-yet-materialized `ALTER MODIFY COLUMN` (including lazy JSON type hints) that requires a read-time type conversion. [#116549](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116549) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#118566](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118566): Fixed `h3Line` returning uninitialized memory in the tail of the result array when a line between two valid H3 indices cannot be drawn because it crosses pentagon distortion. Such a call now throws `INCORRECT_DATA`. [#116583](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116583) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117657](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117657): Fixed wrong results from `sumKahan` when the aggregated batch does not start at the first row of the block. `sumKahanIf`, and `sumKahan` over a `Nullable` argument, tested each row against the wrong element of the condition or null map, returning silently incorrect sums inside window frames such as `ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`, in parallel `GROUP BY`, and under `optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1`. [#116990](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116990) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118248](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118248): Fixed reading uninitialized memory as literal data when decompressing a malformed `LZ4`-compressed block. [#116992](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116992) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118080](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118080): Fixed a stack overflow when reading hadoop-snappy data containing many blocks that decode to nothing. [#116994](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116994) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118652](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118652): The handshake response of the MySQL wire protocol is now bounded, so a client can no longer make the server grow memory during the handshake. The `mysql_require_secure_transport` server setting is now enforced from the actual state of the connection instead of a capability bit advertised by the client. [#117003](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117003) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118139](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118139): Fix background `Distributed` inserts that deleted unsent spool files after a split batch got a transient error. ClickHouse now keeps the files and retries the batch. [#117034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117034) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#117554](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117554): Fixed a 404 (`S3_ERROR`) when reading an Iceberg table through a path that is a parent of the table directory, with the metadata document named by the `iceberg_metadata_file_path` setting: every data and manifest key was resolved against the queried path, so the directories between it and the table were dropped from the key. Writes and maintenance operations on such a table are now refused instead of acting outside the table. [#117037](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117037) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117890](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117890): Check the overflow when allocating a block of aggregate function states on deserialization: a malformed `Native` block could make the server write out of bounds. [#117370](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117370) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118019](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118019): Fix a path traversal on `RESTORE`. A backup metadata entry whose `<name>` was not already in normal form, for example one containing `//` or fewer `..` than the depth of its own directory prefix, was validated in normalized form but stored verbatim, so restoring the part wrote the entry outside the part's directory while `RESTORE` reported success. Such names are now rejected with `INSECURE_PATH`. [#117371](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117371) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE` and `REPLACE TABLE` leaving a stranded `_tmp_replace_*` table on disk and replacing the original table with an empty one when the existing target exceeds `max_table_size_to_drop`. The size guard now runs before the swap, so a violation aborts cleanly with the user-visible table name in the error. [#117438](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117438) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118646](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118646): Fixes a case where GROUP BY emits a group from a zero-row block, returning a row with `count() = 0`. Closes [#116830](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116830). [#117503](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117503) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#118809](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118809): Hide the credentials that a setting value can carry, such as the password in `format_avro_schema_registry_url` or `url_base`, everywhere a setting value is displayed or logged. `system.query_log`, `system.processes`, `system.settings`, `system.settings_profile_elements`, `system.session_log`, `system.distributed_ddl_queue`, `SHOW CREATE USER` and `SHOW CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` previously showed them in plaintext to any user who could read them. [#117523](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117523) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118530](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118530): Several aggregate function deserializers allocated memory from a size declared in the serialized state before reading the payload, so a state of a few bytes could request gigabytes. They now read only what the buffer already holds. [#117536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117536) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118027](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118027): Fixed a bug where the `analyzer_inline_views` setting could bypass the `SELECT` access check on a view, letting a user without a grant on the view read its contents. [#117555](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117555) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#118064](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118064): `ENGINE = EmbeddedRocksDB(ttl, rocksdb_dir, read_only)` with an explicit `rocksdb_dir` now requires the `FILE` source grant that `file` requires for the same directory: `READ ON FILE` to create such a table, plus `WRITE ON FILE` when `read_only = 0`. Previously it required no source grant, so a user holding only `CREATE TABLE` in a database of their own could point a table at another table's directory and read its rows. `ON CLUSTER` and `Replicated`-database DDL are not covered: the replay runs with no user. The argument-less form is unaffected. Backward incompatible for anyone already using an explicit `rocksdb_dir` without them. [#117665](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117665) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#117847](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117847): Fixed `format_schema_source='query'` running the schema query with full privileges when used from a background task, such as a streaming engine consumer (`Kafka`, `NATS`, `RabbitMQ`, `ObjectStorageQueue`) or a `Buffer` background flush. The schema query is now rejected there; use `format_schema_source='file'` or `'string'` instead, or pre-populate the schema cache. [#117737](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117737) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#119111](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119111): Fixed OOM when reading parquet file with invalid `num_children` field in schema. [#117797](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117797) ([Michael Kolupaev](https://github.com/al13n321)).
* Fixes two cases where an AWS Glue `DataLakeCatalog` database reported a table as absent instead of reporting an error. `SHOW TABLES` and `system.tables` no longer fail with `DATALAKE_DATABASE_ERROR` ("Exception calling GetTables ... not found") when a Glue database is absent while its tables are listed, for example because an unrelated database in the same AWS account was dropped concurrently; such a database now contributes no tables instead of aborting the listing. `EXISTS TABLE` no longer answers `0` for a table that exists when the underlying `GetTable` call fails for a reason other than the table being absent, such as an authentication, DNS or 5xx failure. Every other Glue error still propagates in both paths. [#117800](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117800) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118034): Fixes a potential out-of-bounds write of function `formatDateTimeInJodaSyntax` when called with a time zone name longer than 32 characters. [#117925](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117925) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#118325](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118325): `CREATE USER OR REPLACE` and the `OR REPLACE` form of `CREATE ROLE`, `CREATE QUOTA`, `CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` and `CREATE ROW POLICY` now require the corresponding `DROP` privilege in addition to `CREATE`, because they overwrite an existing entity. Previously `CREATE USER` alone was enough to reset the password of any other user, including a privileged one. [#117960](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117960) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118169](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118169): Fix `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` and `EXPLAIN SYNTAX` exposing column names and types of tables the user has no privileges for: the analyzer now checks that the user may see at least one column of the table at the moment a table identifier is resolved. The check also makes the error kind independent of whether the queried column exists and stops recording column names the user may not see into `missing_privileges` of the query log. Closes [#78938](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/78938). [#117979](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117979) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119522](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119522): Expressions supplied through the `additional_table_filters` and `parallel_replicas_custom_key` settings are now subject to the column-level `SELECT` check, and are no longer injected into the body of `SQL SECURITY DEFINER` or `NONE` views. Previously a user could evaluate predicates over columns they were not granted. [#118063](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118063) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#118205](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118205): Fix complex types schema evolution typos. [#118127](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118127) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#118339](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118339): `TRUNCATE DATABASE ... ON CLUSTER` and `TRUNCATE [ALL] TABLES FROM ... ON CLUSTER` ran without checking any privilege: a user holding only `SELECT` and `CLUSTER` could destroy every table in a database, and `readonly = 1` did not prevent it. Both now require `DROP DATABASE`, the privilege the non-cluster spellings have always required. [#118155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118155) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118289](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118289): Fixed a privilege escalation in implicit access-rights computation: holding any single child privilege of the `ALTER TABLE` group (for example `ALTER MODIFY COMMENT`) on a view implicitly conferred the entire `ALTER VIEW` group, so such a user could run `ALTER TABLE <view> MODIFY QUERY` and rewrite the view's query. `ALTER VIEW` is now implied only by the complete `ALTER TABLE` grant. A deployment that relied on a partial `ALTER TABLE` grant to alter views must now grant `ALTER VIEW` (or one of its members) or the full `ALTER TABLE` explicitly. [#118194](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118194) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118744](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118744): A simple `Query` in the PostgreSQL wire protocol now destroys the unnamed prepared statement and the unnamed portal, as PostgreSQL does, so a later `Bind` or `Execute` on them is rejected instead of silently reusing stale extended-query state. A `Flush` or unimplemented message sent outside an extended-query cycle also no longer leaves the connection unable to answer further queries; that half only affects unreleased code from [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108469). [#118210](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118210) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118590](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118590): Fixed `SELECT count()` returning too many rows for a negated comparison (`!=`, `NOT IN`, `NOT LIKE`) over a `Nullable` primary key column: the exact-count optimization counted the NULL-key rows that the `WHERE` condition rejects. [#118214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118214) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119737](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119737): Fixed the server deserializing the payload of a `Data` packet that arrives on a connection before any query. In interserver mode the connection is not authenticated until the `Query` packet is processed, so such a packet was rejected only after its Native block had been read, which let an unauthenticated peer choose the column type the server constructed. The packet is now rejected before its payload is touched. [#118588](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118588) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118693](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118693): Fixed object storage listing silently skipping objects when S3 returns an empty page together with a continuation token. This could make a `plain_rewritable` disk appear empty and hide table parts, and could make data lake tables read a stale snapshot. [#118615](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118615) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#119021](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119021): Fix a crash and wrong results when reading the `DWARF` format with column types other than the ones the format produces, for example `SELECT * FROM file('a.elf', DWARF, 'tag String')`. Requesting a column that does not exist in the format now reports a proper error instead of `std::out_of_range`. [#118794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118794) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#119675](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119675): Fixed a server crash that could happen when a `WORKLOAD` setting limiting concurrency (e.g. `max_concurrent_queries` or `max_bytes_inflight`) was lowered below the number of currently in-flight resource requests while the workload was active. [#118836](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118836) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#119309](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119309): Fixed an out-of-bounds access that could happen with `getURLHostRFC` function. [#119026](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119026) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119484](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119484): Fixed a `Filesystem` database serving a table from its internal cache without the `READ ON FILE` grant. The grant was checked only while a table name was resolved for the first time, so once any user holding it had read a name, every user with `SELECT` on the database was served the contents of the file. `EXISTS TABLE`, which requires only `SHOW TABLES`, answered from that cache and probed the directory without the grant too. Both now require it, and a user without it is refused before the existence of the file is observed. [#119029](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119029) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119413](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119413): Fix statistics computation on top of azure storage. [#119369](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119369) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#119051](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119051): Update `libxml2` to 2.15.4. [#118649](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118649) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#119343](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119343): Update `openssl` to 3.5.8. [#118927](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118927) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#113950](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113950): Fix flaky `test_insert_select_from_cluster_with_partition_pruning`. [#105525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105525) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113975](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113975): Unflaky `test_kafka_engine_put_errors_to_stream`. [#107025](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107025) ([János Benjamin Antal](https://github.com/antaljanosbenjamin)).
* Backported in [#117796](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117796): Simplify access-change notifications: replace two-tier notifications. [#108414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108414) ([Vitaly Baranov](https://github.com/vitlibar)).
* Backported in [#118316](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118316): Lower severity for recomputing logs for quotas/roles/row policies/settings profiles (follow up for [#107672](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107672)). [#108789](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108789) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118735](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118735): Do not run 01516_drop_table_stress_long under MSan. [#109587](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109587) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117508): Fix flaky 03151_unload_index_race: fleet-wide reader starvation guard. [#110502](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110502) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117633](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117633): CI: size stateless per-test memory limit by sanitizer build, not `asan_ubsan` substring. [#111028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111028) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backport the `NonblockingBoundedQueue` TSAN suppression to 26.6. [#112912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112912) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118872](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118872): Make `04661_refreshable_mv_cancel_during_planning` robust on slow runners. [#113960](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113960) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119286](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119286): Keep the SeaweedFS mini admin gRPC port out of the ephemeral range. [#115512](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115512) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117361](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117361): This patch fixes `removePartAndCoveredParts` when it is being called for a part that is actually present in the active data part set. The problem was that part itself will always be in `parts_covered_by,` so the subsequent remove in the loop will not be able to remove it twice. [#115640](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115640) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#118860](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118860): Do not report "Server died" when the server is stalled but alive. [#115692](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115692) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119669](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119669): Do not let an unparsable KeeperMap metadata node stop the server from starting. [#115941](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115941) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116923](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116923): Refactor CollectSetsVisitor to use InDepthQueryTreeVisitorWithContext. [#116561](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116561) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#119637](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119637): CI: fix integration test session timeouts (shard balance and batch count). [#116591](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116591) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117863](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117863): Compute the `row_end` offsets index in signed arithmetic in `Aggregator`, fixing a pointer overflow reported by UBSan when an `-Array` combinator aggregate function is given an empty row range. [#116727](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116727) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117769](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117769): Internal follow-up correcting an implementation detail from an unreleased change; no user-visible behavior change beyond restoring the intended performance characteristics of https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115852 for `Dynamic(JSON)` text output. [#117655](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117655) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#118778](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118778): Make 05054_embedded_rocksdb_explicit_dir_file_grant stress-restart safe. [#118220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118220) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Fix the `ErrorCodes` style check on the `26.6` branch. [#118702](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118702) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119058](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119058): Update usearch to include the arena capacity limitation fix. [#118828](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118828) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119453](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119453): Do not let a setting masking rule throw. [#119028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119028) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
