# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.15.52-stable (2213c0b278e) FIXME as compared to v26.7.14.3-stable (4b5385ab5e3)

#### Backward Incompatible Change
* Backported in [#122175](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122175): A MySQL dictionary source created with a `CREATE DICTIONARY` query can no longer enable `enable_local_infile`, at the source or at one of its `REPLICA` entries; loading such a dictionary fails with `BAD_ARGUMENTS`, which with the default `dictionaries_lazy_load` is on first use rather than at `CREATE`. A `REPLICA` that does not set the key inherits the source's value, as the connection pool does. To keep the option, define the dictionary in a server configuration file; `enable_local_infile 0`, and a `SOURCE(MYSQL(NAME ...))` reference to a named collection where the key was never read, are unaffected. [#120972](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120972) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#121587](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121587): You can now disable reading through the `executable` table function and from `Executable`/`ExecutablePool` tables with the new `allow_executable_tables` setting, for a deployment that must not run arbitrary server-side scripts. It defaults to `true`, so existing behavior is unchanged. [#120713](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120713) ([Hanzi Jiang](https://github.com/HanziJiang)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#121229](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121229): Added a `flat_namespaces` setting for the `DataLakeCatalog` database engine. Set it for Iceberg REST catalogs that have only single-level namespaces and reject the `parent` query parameter of the list-namespaces endpoint, such as Apache Polaris federated to AWS Glue: only top-level namespaces are then listed and sub-namespaces are not requested. [#117329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117329) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#122374](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122374): Iceberg partition pruning now uses the partition value of a `day`, `month`, `year` or `hour` transform for a filter that wraps the partition source column in a monotonic function, such as `WHERE toDate(ts) = '2024-01-20'`, including for partition values from before 1970. [#119302](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119302) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121917](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121917): Add column size statistics in Avro files. [#121392](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121392) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#122095](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122095): The AI function per-query quotas are now disabled by default: `ai_function_max_input_tokens_per_query` (previously `1000000`), `ai_function_max_output_tokens_per_query` (previously `500000`) and `ai_function_max_api_calls_per_query` (previously `1000`) default to `0`, meaning no limit. To keep the previous caps, set the three settings explicitly or use `compatibility = '26.9'`. [#121424](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121424) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#121763](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121763): Do not drop the ClickHouse Keeper session when the client's outgoing request queue stays full for longer than `operation_timeout_ms`. The enqueue wait is now three times `session_timeout_ms`, so a short burst of backpressure no longer terminates the session and invalidates all its ephemeral nodes and watches. [#121559](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121559) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#121356](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121356): Fixed an out-of-bounds read when finalizing a crafted `analysisOfVariance` aggregate state whose internal arrays have mismatched lengths. [#107860](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107860) ([uwezkhan](https://github.com/uwezkhan)).
* Backported in [#121884](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121884): Fixed dropping whole parts with TTL (`ttl_only_drop_parts = 1`) still reading all data from large, fully-expired parts. [#108626](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108626) ([Michael Jarrett](https://github.com/EmeraldShift)).
* Backported in [#121846](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121846): Fix an accounting leak in memory tracking: when an allocation was rejected by a parent memory tracker (for example, the server-wide memory limit), the thread, query, and user level trackers kept the rejected amount. The error accumulated over time, inflating `MemoryTracking` and per-query/per-user memory usage, and could lead to spurious `MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` errors. [#110784](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110784) ([Seva Potapov](https://github.com/seva-potapov)).
* Backported in [#122242](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122242): Fixes a server crash (double free) when finalizing an aggregate function with the `-State` combinator nested under a combinator that transfers several sub-states in one call (`-Resample`, `-ForEach`, `-Map`, `-Tuple`), for example `groupArrayStateResample`, if an exception such as a memory limit is thrown part-way through the transfer. [#111287](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111287) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121551](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121551): Fix `Bad cast from type DB::ColumnNullable to DB::ColumnString` when a mutation that rewrites the whole part runs on a part whose column type is older than the one in the table metadata, for example after `ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN` followed by `ALTER TABLE ... MATERIALIZE PROJECTION`. [#112501](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112501) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121533](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121533): Fixed Iceberg `INSERT` writing no `lower_bounds`/`upper_bounds` at all into the manifest entry when the table has a column whose type cannot be serialized into a statistics bound (for example `Array(Int32)`), or a column that is entirely `NULL`. Such a field is now omitted individually and the bounds of every other column are still written, so min/max file pruning keeps working. Closes [#112706](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112706). [#112934](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112934) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121290](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121290): A table or database whose name is substituted into a `ReplicatedMergeTree` ZooKeeper path through the `{database}` or `{table}` macro is now rejected if the name would not be a single safe path component. Previously a name containing `/` was spliced in unescaped, so the table registered its znodes inside another table's keeper subtree and permanently broke `ALTER` and `OPTIMIZE` there. A `.` or `..` component, a control character and macro syntax are rejected too. Existing tables keep loading and attaching. [#114006](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114006) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121323](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121323): Fixed `ATTACH TABLE ... AS REPLICATED` and the `convert_to_replicated` flag file accepting a conversion whose ZooKeeper path is not a safe path. On a server whose `default_replica_path` substitutes `{database}` or `{table}`, a name containing `/` used to resolve to a path inside another table's subtree, letting the converted table register a replica under a table it has no privileges on. Such a conversion is now rejected with `BAD_ARGUMENTS`, the same way an equivalent `CREATE` already was. Closes [#115967](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115967). [#115991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115991) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121556](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121556): Fixes a case where `date_time_overflow_behavior` was ignored on parsing Date and DateTime. Closes [#113151](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113151). [#116099](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116099) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#121686](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121686): Functions `h3PolygonToCells` and `h3PolygonToCellsWithContainment` now check for query timeouts and `KILL QUERY` while covering a polygon, and reject vertices whose longitude is outside -180..180 or latitude outside -90..90 degrees. Previously a polygon with such a vertex could keep a thread busy for tens of minutes, ignoring both. [#116335](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116335) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#121934](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121934): Fix out of bound in `timeSeriesGroupArray()`. [#117404](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117404) ([Vitaly Baranov](https://github.com/vitlibar)).
* Backported in [#122002](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122002): Fixed SQL injection through identifiers when inserting into a table with the `SQLite` engine. The remote table name and the column names were escaped with backslashes, which SQLite does not honour inside a quoted identifier, so a name containing a double quote could close its own identifier and have the rest of it executed as SQL. It is now also possible to insert into a SQLite table whose name, or column name, legitimately contains a double quote or a backslash. [#117421](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117421) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121379](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121379): Fix a crash when a client sends a block over the Native TCP protocol that selects the internal `Detached` serialization kind for a column. [#117699](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117699) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#122039](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122039): `KILL TRANSACTION ... ON CLUSTER`, `KILL PART_MOVE_TO_SHARD ... ON CLUSTER`, `SYSTEM STOP THREAD FUZZER ON CLUSTER`, `SYSTEM START THREAD FUZZER ON CLUSTER` and `SYSTEM RESET COVERAGE ON CLUSTER` ran without checking any privilege, so a user holding only `CLUSTER` could roll back other users' transactions, cancel part moves between shards, and flip the thread fuzzer and the coverage counters on every host. Each now requires what its non-`ON CLUSTER` spelling has always required: `KILL TRANSACTION` and `SELECT` on `system.transactions`; `SELECT` on `system.part_moves_between_shards`, `ALTER MOVE PARTITION` and `MOVE PARTITION BETWEEN SHARDS`; `SYSTEM THREAD FUZZER`; and `SYSTEM`. [#118360](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118360) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121635](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121635): Fixed a `SELECT` from a table with `paimon_incremental_read = 1` failing with `REPLICA_IS_ALREADY_ACTIVE` ("Failed to activate Paimon replica after Keeper reconnection") on the first read after the server's Keeper session was lost and re-established. Reclaiming the replica's own stale `is_active` marker now treats Keeper having already reaped that ephemeral node as success, instead of reporting a `replica_name` collision that did not happen. [#118457](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118457) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122200](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122200): Fix a patch part whose `source_parts.dat` lost its content to a zeroed block loading as an empty index, which silently unapplied an acknowledged lightweight `UPDATE` and then let background cleanup delete the only copy of it. Such a part is now detached as broken. [#119585](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119585) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#122193](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122193): Fixed `http_max_multipart_form_data_size` silently truncating oversized multipart data instead of failing the query, and made it span a form's external-table parts instead of resetting per part. [#120036](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120036) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#121571](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121571): Fixed two ways a table with the `Redis` engine mishandled an `MGET` reply. Reading the whole table stopped at the first key without a string value and silently dropped every key scanned after it, so one key of another Redis type was enough to truncate the result. A reply carrying a different number of elements than keys requested made the engine read and write past the end of an array sized from the request, which could crash the server; such a reply is now rejected with `INTERNAL_REDIS_ERROR`. [#120230](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120230) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121328](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121328): Fix `count()` returning the number of default values instead of the number of NULLs when `optimize_trivial_count_with_sparsity_filter` is used on a column widened to `Nullable` by a metadata-only `ALTER TABLE ... MODIFY COLUMN`. [#120245](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120245) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#122089](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122089): Bound the header column count in `RowBinary` formats to avoid excessive memory allocation from a crafted header. [#120282](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120282) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#121827](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121827): Fix `INSERT INTO <replicated table> SELECT ... FROM url(...)` (and `s3`, `azureBlobStorage`, ... ) with parallel replicas enabled inserting the data once per replica: the query forwarded to the replicas now names the `*Cluster` table function, so every replica reads only its share of the files. Closes [#120485](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120485). [#120488](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120488) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121450](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121450): Fix a server crash (`std::terminate` with `write failed`) in the embedded SSH client when the client's terminal was closed before the line reader was destroyed. [#120764](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120764) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121238](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121238): Fixed repeated reading of text index posting lists in multi-threaded queries when the global text index caches are disabled. [#120844](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120844) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#121833](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121833): Fixes a segmentation fault that happens when a refreshable materialized view is started up and shut down at the same time, for example when a failed `ATTACH DATABASE` rolls the database back, or when the server shuts down while tables are still loading asynchronously. [#121037](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121037) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121607](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121607): `TRUNCATE ALL TABLES FROM` and `TRUNCATE TABLES FROM ... LIKE ...` now skip `Alias` tables, which hold no data of their own. Previously such a statement could fail with `LOGICAL_ERROR: RWLock is already locked in exclusive mode`, truncate a target in another database, or fail when the alias target was missing. An explicit `TRUNCATE TABLE <alias>` still truncates the target. [#121134](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121134) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122237](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122237): The `text`, `tokenbf_v1`, `ngrambf_v1` and `sparse_grams` skip indexes are now used for `IN` when `transform_null_in = 1` and the set contains no NULL. Previously such a query read every granule, and one using `force_data_skipping_indices` failed with `INDEX_NOT_USED`. [#121375](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121375) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#121626](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121626): Fixed an out-of-bounds heap write in `stem`. The output buffer was sized from the input, but some stemmers lengthen a word (Turkish `uag` → `uagı`, Estonian `keeb` → `keesi`), so a block overran its allocation and returned uninitialized heap as result values. The buffer now grows when the output exceeds the estimate. [#121402](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121402) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#121603](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121603): `remote(<cluster name>, 'db', 'table', 'user', 'password')`, and the same form of `remoteSecure` and of the `Remote` and `RemoteSecure` table engines, wrote the password into `system.query_log`, `system.text_log` and the server log in cleartext, while the `remote('addresses_expr', ...)` form hid it. The password is now replaced with `[HIDDEN]` for the cluster-name form too. [#121474](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121474) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121683](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121683): Fix wrong values and a `LOGICAL_ERROR` when reading a partitioned Delta Lake table with `allow_delta_kernel_rs = 0` and column types that differ from the ones in `_delta_log`. [#121544](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121544) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#122254](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122254): Fixed a server crash when the `flameGraph` aggregate function was constructed on a thread without a query context, for example while attaching a stored table whose column type names `AggregateFunction(flameGraph, ...)`. [#121894](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121894) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Fixes a problem that MySQL/Postgres queries may run in an expired session. [#122075](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/122075) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#121920](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121920): Bump `croaring` from v4.5.1 to v5.1.1. Serialized bitmaps are unchanged on little-endian platforms; on big-endian platforms the on-disk layout of `groupBitmap` states changes to the portable little-endian format. [#118917](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118917) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#121344](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121344): Update `mongo-c-driver` to 2.5.4 and `mongo-cxx-driver` to r4.6.0. [#119346](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119346) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#121428](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121428): Fix spurious `NATS` connection failures when the vendored `nats-io` client gets `EINTR` while waiting for a socket, and include the upstream JetStream pull-subscription deadlock fix in the vendored client. [#120202](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120202) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#121789](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121789): Update `cctz` to 2026d. Time zone names with the `file:` prefix are now rejected. [#121325](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121325) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#122186](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122186): Fix the flaky pre-PAUSE checkpoint in test_pause_stops_after_current_batch. [#111953](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111953) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121543](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121543): Route old-leader reads through Raft in the Keeper compat snapshot test. [#113992](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113992) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122080](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122080): Reject a compressed block whose codec stores data verbatim (`NONE`, `Quantized`) when its declared uncompressed size does not match the body length. Previously the passthrough read path accepted such a block while every other decompression path rejected it. [#114344](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114344) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#121922](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/121922): Split 03469_json_read_subcolumns_combined_2_wide_merge_tree into four smaller tests. [#114732](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114732) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122176](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122176): Do not assert scan-progress values decided by an async race in test_early_return_limit. [#115693](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115693) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122181](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122181): Fix flaky `01780_column_sparse`: order the `arrayFilter` result before limiting it. [#119686](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119686) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backport text index like affix optimization into 26.7. [#121784](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121784) ([Elmi Ahmadov](https://github.com/ahmadov)).
* Fix 05237_delta_lake_legacy_partition_column_type in 26.7. [#121808](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121808) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* [26.7] Disable croaring AVX-512 kernels in MSan builds (clang-21 false positive). [#121980](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121980) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.16.2-stable (92c4ed09b4b) FIXME as compared to v26.7.15.52-stable (2213c0b278e)

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#122539](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122539): TLS CA certificates configured with `openSSL.server.caConfig` / `openSSL.client.caConfig` (and `caConfig` of composable `protocols`) are now reloaded without a restart when the file changes or on `SYSTEM RELOAD CONFIG`, in the same way as `certificateFile` and `privateKeyFile`. This makes it possible to rotate the CA that is used to verify clients, other servers and Keeper nodes (including Raft connections between Keepers) without restarting anything. [#117387](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117387) ([James](https://github.com/sanjams2)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.17.7-stable (7abaef160ce) FIXME as compared to v26.7.16.2-stable (92c4ed09b4b)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#122649](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122649): Chained `ARRAY JOIN`s no longer materialize the whole block of a lazily replicated array column before expanding it, which cuts their peak memory by several times. [#121397](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/121397) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#122732](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122732): Fixed silently empty tables when more than one `ENGINE = Backup` database is created from the same backup, or when such a database is recreated under a different name. The storage policy that backs a `Backup` database is now identified by a name that also covers the local database name, so each database gets the disk built for its own data path. [#113378](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113378) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#122641](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122641): `ALTER DATABASE ... MODIFY COMMENT` on a database with `ENGINE = Backup` no longer writes a definition the server cannot read back, which made it refuse to start; metadata already written in that form now loads too. Backward incompatibility: a backup taken by an older server of a database with `ENGINE = Backup` stores the locator quoted into a string literal, and such a definition is no longer accepted from a `RESTORE`. Restoring it onto a missing database fails with `Expected function`, and onto an existing one with `CANNOT_RESTORE_DATABASE` because the live definition now spells the locator as a function; use `SETTINGS allow_different_database_def = 1` for the latter, or recreate the database with the function form. [#118674](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118674) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#122639](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122639): Fixed settings constraints from a settings profile not being enforced against the other setting assignments in the same statement. `SET profile = 'p', <setting> = <value>` could override a `CONST`, `MIN`/`MAX` or `readonly` constraint that profile `p` installs. The same escape existed through an in-query `SETTINGS` clause, HTTP URL parameters and Arrow Flight session options. [#120376](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/120376) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#122581](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122581): Fix a segmentation fault in Keeper when preallocating space for a changelog file fails because the disk is full. [#122337](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/122337) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#122734](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/122734): Link with `--icf=safe` instead of `--icf=all`, so the linker keeps functions whose address is taken distinct. gRPC queries with transport compression (`gzip`, `deflate`) no longer crash the server, as they could in official builds since 26.4. Closes [#115121](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115121). [#122668](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/122668) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.19.5-stable (3c6a75666fc) FIXME as compared to v26.7.18.2-stable (20f346fdef3)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#123100](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/123100): Fixed a `LOGICAL_ERROR` ("Unexpected number of kept output positions after removing unused columns from `ReadFromMergeTree`") raised by a `SELECT ... FINAL` whose `PREWHERE` uses a column that `FINAL` needs for merging (`ver`, `is_deleted`, `sign`) and which does not select that column. [#114746](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114746) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#123052](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/123052): Kafka producer and consumer trace logs now show the value of secret librdkafka properties, such as sasl.password, as [HIDDEN] instead of the cleartext value. [#119244](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119244) ([János Benjamin Antal](https://github.com/antaljanosbenjamin)).
* Backported in [#123148](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/123148): S3 client check initial url in backup client. [#123114](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/123114) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#123048](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/123048): Remove `--icf=safe` linker warnings about `SHT_LLVM_ADDRSIG` in the stripped Rust libraries. [#122904](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/122904) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.2.59-stable (1399e12824d) FIXME as compared to v26.7.1.1315-stable (a6156303df6)

#### Experimental Feature
* Backported in [#112519](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112519): Tag OpenAI-format HTTP requests with the SQL name of the calling AI function for upstream endpoint identification. [#110449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110449) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#111638](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111638): Lazy materialization is now applied to queries with `FINAL`, a filter, and a small `LIMIT`, even without `ORDER BY` (for `ReplacingMergeTree`). [#110722](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110722) ([Nikolai Kochetov](https://github.com/KochetovNicolai)).
* Backported in [#111455](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111455): Fixed O(P×N) deduplication hash recomputation in async insert flushes that split across P partitions. `DeduplicationInfo::prewarmDataHashes` is now called once before the partition loop in `MergeTreeSink` and `ReplicatedMergeTreeSink`, so all per-partition clones inherit pre-computed `data_hash_batch` values instead of recomputing them P times. This reduces `DuplicationElapsedMicroseconds` proportionally to the number of partitions. [#111150](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111150) ([Valery Petrov](https://github.com/valerypetrov)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#112325](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112325): This patch fixes the remaining problems needed for part-level min-max index for `_block_number` and `_block_offset` columns. [#109281](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109281) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#111669](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111669): Added the `jemalloc_merge_tree_arenas` server setting controlling the dedicated jemalloc arena(s) used for `MergeTree` part and table metadata: `0` disables it, `1` uses a single arena (default), and `N` creates a per-CPU pool. On many-core servers a pool reduces memory-allocator lock contention between concurrent merges. The dedicated arena was also narrowed to hold only long-lived metadata. [#109490](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109490) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112074](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112074): Web UI: fix the "+" (new tab) button rendering taller than the tabs in Firefox. [#109524](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109524) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#112914](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112914): Added the setting `use_query_condition_cache_for_top_k` (default disabled) which gates the query condition cache for `ORDER BY ... LIMIT n` (TopK) queries. This turns the feature off by default as a precaution until the soundness of its cache entries is fully established, while keeping it available behind the setting. [#111492](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111492) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#111978](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111978): Added setting `analyzer_compatibility_apply_final_to_all_joined_tables` that restores the old behavior, where the `FINAL` modifier on the left-most table of a JOIN was also applied to the other joined tables. The setting is registered in the settings changes history, so `compatibility` with versions before 26.6 restores the old semantics automatically. [#111589](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111589) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#112369](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112369): The effective named collections storage type is now available as `named_collections_storage.type` in `system.server_settings` and through `getServerSetting('named_collections_storage_type')`. [#111806](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111806) ([Pablo Marcos](https://github.com/pamarcos)).
* Backported in [#112476](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112476): Reduce CPU usage when making snapshot for huge amout of files. [#112297](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112297) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backported in [#112635](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112635): Iceberg v2 spec requires sequence_number in manifest files. However, other engines such as BigQuery could write those files without this field. This PR allow to read those non-spec tables. [#112431](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112431) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#112678](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112678): Fix a `LOGICAL_ERROR` (`Invalid number of rows in Chunk`) in `JoiningTransform` for a `LEFT JOIN` with unique right keys, a mixed `ON` condition, and a small `max_joined_block_size_rows`. [#106928](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/106928) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111914](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111914): Fix server crash (SIGSEGV) when reading Protobuf data with `input_format_allow_errors_num > 0` and a valid message precedes a bad (skippable) message in the same block. [#107739](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107739) ([Andrey Tsarevskiy | Андрей Царевский ](https://github.com/atsarevskiy)).
* Backported in [#111603](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111603): Fix `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` error for queries that use the `_part_starting_offset/_part_offset` virtual columns in WHERE together with lazy materialization. [#108287](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108287) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#112838](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112838): Fix a server crash (out-of-bounds access) in `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` with `enable_hash_ring_filtering = 1` when a batch contained a non-processable file and the Keeper request to set the batch as processing failed at the same time. [#108977](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108977) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112963](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112963): Preserve original key order in bucketed Map serialization to fix comparison operations that depend on it. [#109178](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109178) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#112626](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112626): Fix data loss of a column with no default expression when a merge runs concurrently with `ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN`, or when the column's only values come from a lightweight `UPDATE`. The column could be dropped from the merged part, so all of its values read back as NULL. [#109356](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109356) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111566](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111566): Fixed a false `ICEBERG_SPECIFICATION_VIOLATION` error when reading an Iceberg table whose decimal (or other parameterized primitive) type is serialized with different whitespace across metadata files, e.g. `decimal(20,0)` in the table metadata and `decimal(20, 0)` in the manifest. Such spec-equivalent type strings are now compared ignoring whitespace. [#109676](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109676) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112293](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112293): Fix credential leaks in `SHOW CREATE`, `system.query_log`, server logs and `EXPLAIN` output. Every `S3` locator form now masks `session_token` and Google ADC secrets, `extra_credentials`/`headers` values at any argument position, duplicated or expression secret keys, invalid positional forms (fail closed), and credentials embedded in S3 URLs; this covers the explicit-url and named-collection `s3`/`s3Cluster` table functions, the S3-backed table engines (`S3`, `GCS`, the data-lake engines, `S3Queue`), the `S3` database engine, `BACKUP ... TO S3` and the `Backup` database engine. In addition, secret arguments of `encrypt`/`decrypt`/HMAC that are built by an expression (including ones inlined from a SQL UDF) are now hidden in projection names, `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` and `EXPLAIN actions`. [#109768](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109768) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#111544](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111544): Fixed wrong results for functions `has`, `mapContainsKey` and `mapContainsValue` with an empty needle when a text index is present. [#110246](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110246) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#112062](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112062): Fix `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` ordered mode with persistent processing nodes: bucket locks are now refreshed during streaming, so that the TTL cleanup (`persistent_processing_node_ttl_seconds`) does not remove locks of a live processor. If lock ownership is nevertheless lost, it is detected and reported (a logical error and the `ObjectStorageQueueBucketLockLostOwnership` profile event), and streaming recovers with a fresh file iterator. [#110292](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110292) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#111560](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111560): Fix `411 Length Required` errors from Azure services: the Poco-based Azure HTTP transport now sets `Content-Length` from the request body for SDK clients that do not set the header themselves (e.g. Azure Key Vault). [#110299](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110299) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#111682](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111682): Fixed a read-only object-storage replica (a disk configured with `read_only = true`) not discovering new parts via `refresh_parts_interval`, and `table_disk = true` being rejected on such a disk with "table_disk is not supported for non-ObjectStorage disks". [#110460](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110460) ([Julia Kartseva](https://github.com/jkartseva)).
* Backported in [#112450](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112450): Fix wrong `IS NULL` / `IS NOT NULL` / `count()` results with `optimize_functions_to_subcolumns` on a column that was made `Nullable` by a metadata-only `ALTER MODIFY COLUMN T` to `Nullable(T)`. For parts written before the conversion, the `.null` subcolumn was filled from the storage-type default (NULL) instead of being derived from the physically-present parent column, so existing not-null rows were wrongly reported as NULL. [#110584](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110584) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111744](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111744): Fix incorrect pruning from primary key index analysis on tables with a reverse (descending) sorting key (`ORDER BY (g, r DESC)`). A granule spanning a change of a leading key column followed by a descending key column could be pruned incorrectly, dropping matching rows. [#111059](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111059) ([Nihal Z. Miaji](https://github.com/nihalzp)).
* Backported in [#112585](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112585): Fix a logical error `block.rows() == getRows()` (an out-of-bounds read and broken insert deduplication in release builds) when an `INSERT` flows through a dependent materialized view whose target is an `Alias` and whose inner query changes the number of rows, with a deduplicating table reachable behind the alias hop. [#111103](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111103) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#111473](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111473): Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE` of a dictionary with an object of another kind: it failed with `CANNOT_DETACH_DICTIONARY_AS_TABLE` after the replace was already committed, leaving an orphan `_tmp_replace_*` table. [#111142](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111142) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#111903](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111903): A `{_partition_id}` placeholder in the path of a file-like engine (`S3`, `AzureBlobStorage`, `URL`, etc.) with no explicit `partition_strategy` implies the `wildcard` strategy again, regardless of `file_like_engine_default_partition_strategy`. This restores backward compatibility for pre-26.6 DDL that started failing with `BAD_ARGUMENTS` ("Partition strategy hive can not be used with a '_partition_id' wildcard in the path") after [#107437](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/107437). [#111279](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111279) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#111479](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111479): Fixed `INCOMPATIBLE_TYPE_OF_JOIN` error for an `ANY` join on a `Join` engine table when a `WHERE` filter on a right-side column allowed the query planner to rewrite the join to `SEMI` or `ANTI`. A `Join` engine table has a fixed declared strictness that cannot be changed, so the conversion is now declined for such tables. [#111362](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111362) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#111490](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111490): Fix `OPTIMIZE TABLE ... MANIFEST` for `Iceberg` tables when manifest partition tuples do not match their partition spec. [#111368](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111368) ([Smita Kulkarni](https://github.com/SmitaRKulkarni)).
* Backported in [#112726](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112726): Fix `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` error for columns qualified by CTE name (`cte_name.column`) in queries stored in views when the analyzer is enabled. [#111386](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111386) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#111815](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111815): Fix a memory leak of the peer certificate on every TLS handshake with certificate verification enabled: `SecureSocketImpl::verifyPeerCertificateImpl` did not free the certificate returned by `SSL_get1_peer_certificate`. [#111425](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111425) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#112278](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112278): Fix checking paths against `user_files`. [#111442](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111442) ([Alexander Tokmakov](https://github.com/tavplubix)).
* Backported in [#112258](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112258): Restrict local object access only for user files path. Continuation of https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/99405. [#111483](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111483) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#111588](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111588): Fix typo in complex schema evolution. [#111489](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111489) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#111769](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111769): Fix mutations with a query parameter as the partition (`ALTER TABLE ... UPDATE/DELETE ... IN PARTITION {param:Type}`): the substituted partition value was serialized into the mutation entry in a form that could not be parsed back, which broke loading of the table (for replicated tables, on every replica). Mutation commands are now also verified to be parseable back before they are written to ZooKeeper or disk, so that a similar mismatch would fail the `ALTER` query instead of breaking the table. [#111518](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111518) ([Michael Kolupaev](https://github.com/al13n321)).
* Backported in [#112285](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112285): Fix a segfault due to out-of-bounds memory access when deserializing a malformed aggregate function state containing a `String` value. Such states are now validated and rejected instead of leading to segfaults. [#111606](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111606) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#112621](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112621): Fix overflow while parsing in system.zookeeper_info. [#111629](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111629) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#111828](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111828): Fixed a server crash on macOS (aarch64) when a stack trace was captured (for example by the memory profiler) while running on a coroutine/fiber stack. [#111656](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111656) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112372](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112372): Fixes `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` when a `FINAL` query filters on a sorting-key column that is not in the `SELECT` list and the filter is moved to `PREWHERE` (for example `SELECT s FROM t FINAL WHERE k GROUP BY s` with `optimize_move_to_prewhere_if_final = 1`). [#111721](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111721) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112165](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112165): ... [#111785](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111785) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backported in [#111962](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111962): Fix `TYPE_MISMATCH` ("Key type for complex key ... does not match") when a `JOIN` onto a dictionary uses a `Nullable`, `LowCardinality`, or `LowCardinality(Nullable)` join key while the dictionary key is not wrapped. The direct-join dictionary lookup now normalizes the key to the dictionary's declared key type (as `dictGet`/`dictHas` already do), and a `NULL` key never matches. [#111857](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111857) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112176](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112176): Fixes `AMBIGUOUS_COLUMN_NAME` (`Block structure mismatch in (columns with identical name must have identical structure)`) for a query that repeats a `JOIN ON` condition in `WHERE` with `join_use_nulls = 1`. Such a query now returns its result instead of failing. [#112007](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112007) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112365](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112365): Fixed Paimon table reads that could fail while the mutable `snapshot/LATEST` hint was being replaced concurrently. Invalid or stale hints now safely fall back to snapshot listing. [#112010](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112010) ([JIaQi Tang](https://github.com/JiaQiTang98)).
* Backported in [#112608](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112608): Fixed a permanent server hang on macOS caused by `pthread_rwlock` losing wakeups when the sampling query profiler is enabled (Apple bug FB24027930): `pthread_rwlock` is now replaced with a signal-robust implementation on Darwin. [#112267](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112267) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112731](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112731): Fix `ATTEMPT_TO_READ_AFTER_EOF` error when merging parts with a text index if one of the merged parts was empty, for example after a mutation that deleted all rows of the part. [#112490](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112490) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#112830](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112830): Fixed `s3_allow_server_credentials_in_user_queries` incorrectly rejecting a query-supplied `extra_credentials(role_arn = '...')`. STS assume-role with an explicit role is now always allowed: it does not expose the server's own credentials to the query, and it is the documented way to grant access to a private S3 bucket. [#112603](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112603) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#112926](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112926): Fixes a segfault and silent data corruption when an `INSERT` into the `File` engine or the `file` table function appends to a non-empty file in a format that does not support appending, such as `Avro`. Writing through a file descriptor or a partitioned path bypassed the existing check, so the format prefix was suppressed and a second header was written after the existing bytes, leaving the file unreadable. Such an `INSERT` is now rejected with `CANNOT_APPEND_TO_FILE`, as it already is for a plain path. [#112839](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112839) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113018](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113018): Fix `ReadBufferFromEncryptedFile: Wrong file position` logical error when reading a `Compact` part from an `encrypted` disk with direct I/O, which made merges get stuck in `system.replication_queue`. [#112943](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112943) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#112613](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112613): Updated the bundled Apache Thrift library to version 0.24.0. [#111278](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111278) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#112686](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112686): Update the bundled SQLite amalgamation from 3.41.2 to 3.53.4. [#112599](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112599) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

#### NO CL ENTRY

* NO CL ENTRY:  'Update autogenerated version to 26.7.1.1315 on 26.7'. [#111491](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111491) ([robot-clickhouse](https://github.com/robot-clickhouse)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#111481](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111481): Mark the ZXC codec as experimental. [#111007](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111007) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#111574](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111574): This patch removes preconditions from metadata-only transactions. These transactions will be validated during commit. [#111353](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111353) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#112138](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112138): Lower max_snapshot_commit_thread_pool_size to 16. [#111417](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111417) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backport [#111029](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111029) to 26.7: Fix flaky test_replicated_table_structure_alter. [#111884](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111884) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#112430](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112430): Fix test 04627_analyzer_compatibility_final_all_joined_tables with old analyzer. [#111991](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111991) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backport [#111506](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/111506) to 26.7: Fix flaky test_s3_table_functions_timeouts. [#112589](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112589) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backport the runtime TSan suppression for `NonblockingBoundedQueue` to 26.7. [#112916](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112916) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.3.19-stable (c3c4a420478) FIXME as compared to v26.7.2.59-stable (1399e12824d)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#113467](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113467): Fixed a performance regression where a single lightweight `DELETE` disabled the query condition cache for the whole table. Repeated selective queries over a table that had ever been touched by a lightweight delete stopped pruning granules and fell back to reading every mark. [#112947](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112947) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#113483](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113483): Fix server crashes and wrong `NOT_FOUND_COLUMN_IN_BLOCK` / `LOGICAL_ERROR` failures in a `direct` JOIN over a MergeTree right table. The plan is cloned and re-optimized per lookup across threads, but the clone shared two mutable objects with the original: the `PrewhereInfo`/`row_level_filter` DAG, corrupted in place by column pruning, and the `StorageSnapshot`, whose data parts are stripped in place. [#109932](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109932) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113092](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113092): With `analyzer_compatibility_join_using_top_level_identifier = 1`, an identifier in `JOIN ... USING` can now be resolved from an alias defined on a subexpression inside the SELECT list (for example, `SELECT uniqExact(lower(x) AS id) FROM t1 JOIN t2 USING (id)`), matching the old analyzer behavior. Previously only top-level projection aliases were considered, and such queries failed with an `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` exception even with the setting enabled. The error hint suggesting the setting is now also produced when the matching alias is nested. [#110739](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110739) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#113568](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113568): Fixed a logical error `Block structure mismatch` (in debug and sanitizer builds) and an `Illegal types of arguments` error for set operations over compatible aggregate-state columns (e.g. `quantileState` and `quantilesState(0.9)`) nested inside container columns such as `Tuple`, `Array`, `Map`, `Nullable`, or `Variant`. [#111191](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111191) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#112545](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112545): Now RestCatalog throw proper exception instead of silence or "UNKNOWN_TABLE" in case of stale credentials. [#111379](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111379) ([alesapin](https://github.com/alesapin)).
* Backported in [#113261](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113261): Fix an out-of-bounds read (a crash in release builds) in insert deduplication when an `INSERT` flows through a materialized view whose inner query changes the number of rows and the deduplicating target table is partitioned. `DeduplicationInfo::filterToPartition` attributed each deduplication token to partitions by walking the token's source-row range over a partition selector sized to the (smaller) view-output block, reading past its bounds. It now keeps every token in every partition for any materialized-view target — where the source-row-to-partition mapping no longer exists after the row count changed — instead of the out-of-bounds walk (and instead of the `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` that a later guard raised for the same insert). [#112649](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112649) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#113356](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113356): Fixed server startup and `ATTACH` failing with `WITH RECURSIVE is not supported with the old analyzer` for a view with a recursive CTE when `enable_analyzer = 0` is the server default. [#112784](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112784) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#113257](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113257): Fixed an out-of-bounds write when reading a `Parquet` `DECIMAL` column whose physical type is wider than the type its declared precision maps to, for example `DECIMAL(9, 2)` stored as physical `INT64`. Such files are valid `Parquet` and other writers produce them, but the reader sized the destination column from the declared precision while the decoder wrote the physical width, corrupting memory. Reading such a file now also raises `DECIMAL_OVERFLOW` when a value does not fit the declared precision, instead of returning corrupted data, and reads losslessly with a type hint at least as wide as the physical type. [#113046](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113046) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113498](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113498): Fix a rare use-after-free bug that is triggered in a rare event of the async insert queue having different entries with identical deadlines. Now it's handled gracefully. [#113363](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113363) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#113069](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113069): This PR bumps aws-c-http v0.11.0. [#112413](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112413) ([Govind R Nair](https://github.com/Revertionist)).
* Backported in [#113145](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113145): Update the vendored `libexpat` to 2.8.2. [#112593](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112593) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113139](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113139): Update `simdjson` to v4.6.5. [#112594](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112594) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113133](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113133): Update `jwt-cpp` to v0.7.2. [#112595](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112595) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113128](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113128): Update `libcotp` to v4.2.1. [#112596](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112596) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113543](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113543): Update Apache Arrow to 25.0.0 and Apache ORC to 2.3.1. [#112604](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112604) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backported in [#113219](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113219): Update Protocol Buffers to v35.1 and gRPC to v1.83.0. [#112614](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112614) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#113527](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113527): Fix `Field::operator<=` comparing a `Float64` with itself. [#113010](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113010) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113277](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113277): I created several PRs to backport the groene-ai's fix: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109616 However, I need to create dummy PR to create another version patch. [#113089](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113089) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
