# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.4.58-stable (9c16c358cd7) FIXME as compared to v26.7.3.19-stable (c3c4a420478)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#113823](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113823): Fix a ~1.5x performance regression introduced in 26.5 in `GROUP BY` over `Dynamic` keys and over `JSON` path subcolumns. [#112316](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112316) ([Utkal Singh](https://github.com/Utkal059)).
* Backported in [#114564](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114564): `randomHadamardTransform` of a constant vector is now evaluated once instead of once per row. This speeds up vector search queries that rotate the query vector with `randomHadamardTransform` before comparing it against a `QBit` column. [#112921](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112921) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#113659](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113659): Added the setting `analyzer_compatibility_multiple_joins_qualify_column_names` (default `false`). When enabled and the `FROM` clause of a query contains two or more `JOIN`s, result column names produced by the analyzer mimic the old analyzer's multiple-joins rewrite: columns expanded from `*` are named `<alias-or-table>.<column>`, and an unaliased column reference in the `SELECT` list keeps its name exactly as written. This makes outer queries that reference such qualified names, like `SELECT ll.Date FROM (SELECT * FROM t AS ll JOIN t1 ON ... JOIN t2 ON ...)`, work as they did with the old analyzer. Also fixed the analyzer losing qualified result column names for columns expanded from `*` when `group_by_use_nulls` is combined with `ROLLUP`, `CUBE` or `GROUPING SETS`, which produced duplicate result column names and broke outer references to those columns. [#110746](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110746) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#115184](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115184): The hive partitioning sample path for object storage tables (e.g. `S3`) is resolved on the first use of the table instead of `CREATE`/`ATTACH`, so an unreachable endpoint no longer blocks table creation and server startup. [#111842](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111842) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#115029](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115029): Improve reduced-precision `L2DistanceTransposedQuantized`, `cosineDistanceTransposedQuantized`, and `dotProductTransposedQuantized` by reconstructing `p < 8` `QBit(Int8)` codes with Gaussian conditional-mean prefix centroids. Full precision (`p = 8`) remains bit-exact; reduced-precision approximate distances may change, and recall/latency gains are workload-dependent. [#111867](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111867) ([Sergey Kuznetsov](https://github.com/skuznetsov)).
* Backported in [#114888](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114888): Support distributed query plans (`make_distributed_plan`) for queries whose source provably produces no rows at planning time, such as a read from an empty `MergeTree` table. Such queries previously failed with `SUPPORT_IS_DISABLED`. [#111941](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111941) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#114159](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114159): Reject unsupported uses of `AggregateFunction` columns in TTL expressions at `CREATE TABLE` time (e.g. `TTL toDateTime(state)`) instead of failing later during TTL execution with `ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT`. This also covers states carried inside `Variant` alternatives and `Dynamic` values. Valid state-aware consumers such as `finalizeAggregation` are still accepted. [#107366](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/107366) ([Ria Khatoniar](https://github.com/Ria-K912)).
* Backported in [#114715](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114715): Fix possible logical error "Unexpected substream ... for column ..." during bump of compatibility setting. [#109496](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109496) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#114689](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114689): Fix propagation of settings in `accurateCastOrDefault`. Closes [#109943](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109943). [#109946](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109946) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#113570](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113570): Fixed a `LOGICAL_ERROR` ("Bad cast from ColumnString to ColumnLowCardinality") during primary-key index analysis when a `LowCardinality` key column is wrapped in a nested `CAST` chain that re-introduces `LowCardinality`, e.g. `WHERE CAST(CAST(s, 'LowCardinality(String)'), 'String') < '5'`. In debug and sanitizer builds this aborted the server; in release it failed the query. [#111050](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111050) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115092](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115092): `RESTORE` now fsyncs the restored part files when the destination table has `fsync_after_insert` enabled, so a restored part is as durable against power loss as an inserted one. Previously restored files were only written and closed (never fsynced), so a power loss right after `RESTORE` returned `RESTORED` could leave the parts torn and the table empty. [#111378](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111378) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113778](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113778): Fixed `made_current_at` in `system.iceberg_history` becoming `1970-01-01` for a retained snapshot after `ALTER TABLE ... EXECUTE expire_snapshots` on an Iceberg table. Also fixed `system.iceberg_history` returning no rows for a table whose metadata has no `snapshot-log`. [#111781](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111781) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114393](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114393): Fix a logical error `Block structure mismatch in IntersectOrExceptStep stream: different number of columns` that could happen when the filter split optimization (`query_plan_split_filter`) ran on a `WHERE` whose filter column name is also an input column name. The optimization left an internal `__split_filter` column in the branch output header, which then diverged from the sibling branch of a set operation such as `INTERSECT` or `UNION`. [#111930](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111930) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114782](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114782): Fixed a stack frame being displayed as `?` instead of its function name in fatal log messages and in the `trace_full` column of `system.crash_log`. It affected frames of ordinary functions that have code attributed to a libc++ `__functional` header, which is common in release builds. [#112152](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112152) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114841](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114841): Fixed a server abort (`SIGABRT`) when a `BUFFERED_V1` WebAssembly UDF returns an empty result buffer; the query now fails with a catchable `WASM_ERROR` and the server stays up. [#112182](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112182) ([Nikolai Ovchinnikov](https://github.com/kolsha)).
* Backported in [#114800](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114800): Fixed a use-after-free when a `JOIN` with `join_algorithm = 'direct'` onto a dictionary was given a join key that is stored with sparse serialization. `getColumnVectorData` returned a reference to a temporary column, so the dictionary lookup read freed memory: release builds could return wrong results and debug or sanitizer builds aborted. [#112327](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112327) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115197](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115197): Fixes cases where row policy was not used for MergeTree Projections during query execution. [#112329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112329) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#113876](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113876): Fix out-of-bounds read in SerializationReplicated on the native protocol on corrupted indexes data. [#112331](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112331) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#114519](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114519): Fix data races in profile events and memory tracker. [#112466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112466) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#114442](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114442): Security related bugfix. [#112479](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112479) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#114576](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114576): Fixed a crash when reading a Parquet file with inconsistent bloom filter metadata. Such files could also silently return fewer rows than they should. [#112498](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112498) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#114619](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114619): Fix AsynchronousBoundedReadBuffer's readBigAt data race. Closes [#109678](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/109678). [#112573](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112573) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).
* Backported in [#115191](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115191): Fixed the logical error `SortingAggregatedTransform already got bucket with number N` that could occur in multi-layer distributed `GROUP BY` queries using two-level aggregation. [#112794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112794) ([Nikita Taranov](https://github.com/nickitat)).
* Backported in [#114173](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114173): Fixes wrong results for a `JOIN` whose `ON` clause carries a mixed condition, that is a cross-side non-equi residual such as `ON (t1.key = t2.key) AND (t1.a * 10 < t2.a)`. Only the hash family evaluates such a condition, but `full_sorting_merge`, `partial_merge` and the direct key-value join claimed they could run these joins and then silently ignored the residual, returning extra rows. They now decline, so a hash algorithm is used instead. [#112831](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112831) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114835](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114835): Fix `DROP TABLE` and `SYSTEM STOP VIEW` hanging when a Refreshable Materialized View is blocked while planning its refresh query. [#113188](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113188) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#113793](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113793): Fixed a case where `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Distributed(...)` without a column list could reveal the structure of a local table the creating user is not allowed to see. For a `CREATE` the local server executes itself, the structure is now inferred under the user's own context, so `SHOW COLUMNS` on the target table is required, as it already is for the `Remote` engine. A `CREATE` replayed from the DDL queue (`ON CLUSTER`, or one inside a `Replicated` database) is not covered. [#113220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113220) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113883](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113883): Fixed reading the internal `_temporary_and_external_tables` database through the `merge` table function and the `Merge` table engine, which allowed one session to read the temporary tables of other sessions and other users, and caused an exception on the old analyzer path. A database regexp now skips that database, and naming it explicitly is denied, the same way as direct access to it is. [#113224](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113224) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114971](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114971): Fixed wrong results when a hash join has a single `LowCardinality` key of a type wider than 8 bytes (`UInt128`, `Int128`, `UInt256`, `Int256`, and their `Nullable` variants). Such a join silently returned rows whose key values are not equal. [#113230](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113230) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114478): Fixed a query plan optimization stall when a `WHERE` clause contains a large string constant with many dots and the table carries a `bloom_filter`, `tokenbf_v1`, `ngrambf_v1` or `text` skip index. Matching a filter column name against `JSONAllPaths(...)` index columns enumerated every dot split of the name, which made skip-index condition building quadratic in the constant's length. Closes [#113003](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113003). [#113289](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113289) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114221](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114221):. [#113291](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113291) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#113804](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113804): Fixed a case where `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Buffer(...)` without a column list could reveal the structure of a destination table the creating user is not allowed to see. For a `CREATE` the local server executes itself, the structure is now inferred under the user's own context, so `SHOW COLUMNS` on the destination is required, as it already is for `Merge` and `Remote`. A `CREATE` replayed from the DDL queue (`ON CLUSTER`, or inside a `Replicated` database) is not covered. [#113372](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113372) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114336](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114336): Fixed `ATTACH` of a `Kafka` table when `kafka_num_consumers` exceeds the limit derived from the number of CPU cores. [#113390](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113390) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#114664](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114664): Fixed reading Paimon tables that contain a nullable `ARRAY` or `MAP` column. Such a table could not be read at all, because the schema mapper wrapped the composite type in `Nullable`, which ClickHouse forbids, so both `DESC` and `SELECT` failed with `Nested type Array(Nullable(Int32)) cannot be inside Nullable type`. A nullable composite column is now mapped to a non-`Nullable` composite type and a `NULL` value is read as an empty one. Closes [#113337](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113337). [#113450](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113450) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114493](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114493): Fix part and granule pruning for a `JOIN ON` condition involving constant columns of the other side. [#113484](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113484) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).
* Backported in [#114560](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114560): Fix wrong results and, in a build with assertions enabled, an aborted assertion for a `JOIN` onto a dictionary whose `ON` clause has a non-equi condition over both tables, such as `ON (t.key = d.key) AND (t.a * 10 < d.a)`, when `join_use_nulls` is enabled. The condition was evaluated over a column read through a mismatched type, so rows could match arbitrarily. [#113534](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113534) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114311](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114311): Fixed a row policy containing a scalar subquery being evaluated only once and then reused forever after the table had been read through a `Merge` table. The parsed policy condition is cached and shared by all queries, and reading it through `Merge` rewrote the cached expression in place, which also caused a data race between concurrent queries using the same policy. [#113563](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113563) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#113812](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113812): Fixed `made_current_at` in `system.iceberg_history` reporting the earliest time a snapshot became current instead of the latest one, when the same `snapshot-id` appears more than once in the Iceberg `snapshot-log` (as a rollback leaves it). [#113598](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113598) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#113816](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113816): Fix a wrong value returned for a virtual column such as `_table` or `_database` selected from the right side of a JOIN served by `DirectKeyValueJoin` (a key-value storage such as `EmbeddedRocksDB`, `KeeperMap`, `Redis`, or a dictionary). The query returned the contents of a data column instead, or failed with `LOGICAL_ERROR`. [#113698](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113698) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114635](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114635): Fix `CANNOT_CONVERT_TYPE` and an exception in `GroupingAggregatedTransform` when reading a `Merge` table with one child being a `Distributed` table under custom-key parallel replicas (`parallel_replicas_mode = 'custom_key_sampling'` or `'custom_key_range'`). Closes [#113741](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113741). [#113742](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113742) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114199](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114199): Fixed `OPTIMIZE TABLE` on an Iceberg table failing with `Unsupported snapshot's operation type OVERWRITE` when the table's history contained a row delete that removed more than one row per position delete file. Closes [#113745](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113745). [#113964](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113964) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114720](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114720): Fixed `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` returning fewer rows than requested, possibly none, when a row policy was the only filter of the query and the sort column had a `minmax` skip index. The top-K optimization narrowed the read before the row policy was applied. [#114073](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114073) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114979](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114979): Fixed an exception when reading a `MergeTree` table by primary-key range layers when a layer produces an empty pipe. [#114177](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114177) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114684](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114684): Fixed `ATTACH PARTITION FROM`, `REPLACE PARTITION`, `MOVE PARTITION TO TABLE` and adding a `ReplicatedMergeTree` replica failing with `Tables have different ...`, `METADATA_MISMATCH` or `INCOMPATIBLE_COLUMNS` for tables whose definitions were written with redundant parentheses, such as `PARTITION BY (a)`, `ORDER BY (b)`, `INDEX ix (b * c) TYPE minmax`, `PROJECTION p (SELECT (b) ...)`, `CONSTRAINT c CHECK (a > 0)`, `TTL (d + INTERVAL 10 YEAR)` or `DEFAULT (a + 1)`. [#114188](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114188) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114878](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114878): Fixed heap memory corruption when reading Parquet through an input format that owns its read buffer, for example a dictionary with `SOURCE(FILE(... format 'Parquet'))`. Background prefetch and decode tasks could still read and write through the buffer after the pipeline released it, which could abort the server. [#114668](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114668) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115260](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115260): Fixed wrong results of the trivial `GROUP BY ... LIMIT` optimization (setting `optimize_trivial_group_by_limit_query`) for queries with `DISTINCT`, `QUALIFY`, window functions, or `arrayJoin` in the projection: these consume or filter the groups after the aggregation, so capping the aggregation at `LIMIT + OFFSET` keys could return too few rows or wrong values. The optimization no longer applies to such queries. [#114695](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114695) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115138](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115138): Fixes a server crash that happens when aggregate states of the `-OrNull` or `-OrDefault` combinators are merged with `group_by_overflow_mode = 'any'` and a non-zero `max_rows_to_group_by`, for example when a query reads through an aggregate projection. [#114740](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114740) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115205](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115205): Fixes a server abort that happens when the global thread pool is momentarily saturated while tables are still loading. `AsyncLoader` now keeps running if it cannot spawn an extra loader worker and some worker will still drain the queued jobs, instead of calling `std::terminate`. [#114897](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114897) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115370](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115370): Disable distributed index analysis with projections (wrong results). [#115132](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115132) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#115315](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115315): Provide signed artifacts for macOS. [#115169](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115169) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#113951](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113951): Fix flaky `test_insert_select_from_cluster_with_partition_pruning`. [#105525](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/105525) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114227](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114227): Iterate ColumnObject subcolumns in sorted path order. [#112601](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112601) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#113720](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113720): Keep the Map `bucket_indexes` stream in sync when rows are skipped. [#113047](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113047) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#114973](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114973): Recover a dead py4j gateway in ResilientSparkSession. [#113430](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113430) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#114241](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114241): Add a dedicated thread pool for lightweight snapshot creation. [#113509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113509) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backported in [#113832](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113832): Make the boolean case of `04308_arrow_oob_reads_value` corrupt only the declared row count, so it reaches the per-element bit-packed buffer guard it is meant to cover. [#113593](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113593) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115295](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115295): Add `clickhouse/utils` container image with macOS binary signing tools. [#113813](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113813) ([Konstantin Bogdanov](https://github.com/thevar1able)).
* Backport [#112217](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/112217) to 26.7: Measure cancellation server-side in test_cancel_backup.py. [#114627](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114627) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Remove bad tests on 26.7. [#114760](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114760) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.5.10-stable (c7d5ecce0dd) FIXME as compared to v26.7.4.58-stable (9c16c358cd7)

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#115566](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115566): Serialize a `Nullable(Tuple(...))` column as a single CSV field instead of flattening it into separate columns. Previously a non-null value was written as several CSV fields while a `NULL` was a single `\N`, giving a row-dependent column count that broke `CSVWithNames`/`CSVWithNamesAndTypes` headers and round-trips. [#108959](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108959) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115500](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115500): Fix a theoretical data race in profile events when using the `trace_profile_events_list` setting to write stack traces of certain profile events to `system.trace_log`. [#113553](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113553) ([Miсhael Stetsyuk](https://github.com/mstetsyuk)).
* Backported in [#115595](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115595): Fix `Logical error: No set is registered for key ...` when reading through a `Merge` table whose child declares an `ALIAS` column containing `IN`, and the children disagree about that column's default. [#113757](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113757) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115411](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115411): Reject corrupted/malicious dictionary where `lcp` exceeds the previous token or `lcp + data_size` overflows, before the buffer write. [#114155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114155) ([Elmi Ahmadov](https://github.com/ahmadov)).
* Backported in [#114895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114895): Fixes a bug where an access entity carrying a `Map`-valued setting, such as a settings profile with `http_response_headers` or `additional_table_filters`, is stored in a form that ClickHouse cannot read back, leaving the entity permanently unloadable after a restart. [#114620](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114620) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115713](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115713): Fixes `has`, `indexOf`, `countEqual`, `mapContainsKey`, `mapContainsValue` and `Map` subscript returning "not found" for a constant `LowCardinality` needle equal to the element type's default value, such as an empty `String` or a zero number. [#114624](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114624) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115628](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115628): Fix propagation of query settings and NULL handling in `accurateCastOrDefault`. [#114912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114912) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115472](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115472): Fixed wrong results for `SELECT count(arrayJoin(arr))` with the default `optimize_trivial_count_query = 1`. The stored row count was returned instead of the number of array elements, and on `file()` and `url()` the query returned `0`. Closes [#115123](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115123). [#115227](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115227) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115602](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115602): Fixed `uniq`, `uniqExact`, `uniqHLL12` and `uniqTheta` returning a wrong result for an argument wrapped in an injective function that hides nullability, such as `uniqExact(tuple(x))` over a `Nullable` column. The `optimize_injective_functions_inside_uniq` optimization removed the wrapping function, after which NULL rows were skipped instead of counted. [#115466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115466) ([Vladimir Cherkasov](https://github.com/vdimir)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.6.57-stable (bf82ad6cfcb) FIXME as compared to v26.7.5.10-stable (c7d5ecce0dd)

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#117028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117028): Push a `WHERE` condition on a `USING` column through a `RIGHT JOIN` so the left `MergeTree` input can use it as a primary-key index condition, also when the two join keys have different types. Applies when `enable_analyzer = 1`. [#103478](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/103478) ([Manuel](https://github.com/raimannma)).
* Backported in [#115792](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115792): Speed up query planning when `uniq_v2` column statistics are used. The estimated number of distinct values is now cached instead of being recomputed on every request, which query planning issues many times per query. (issue [#113038](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113038)). [#113357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113357) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116313](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116313): Bounded the cost of estimating the selectivity of `col IN (...)` from column statistics, which could add hundreds of milliseconds to the planning of a single query. The estimator no longer runs the subquery behind `col IN (subquery)` to fill a set it only needs one selectivity number from — an unbuilt set is skipped instead. For a set larger than the new `statistics_max_set_size_for_exact_selectivity_estimation` setting (default 10000), the selectivity is now derived from the size of the set and its bounding range. [#114389](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114389) ([Nikita Taranov](https://github.com/nickitat)).
* Backported in [#116759](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116759): Fixed a performance regression where a query combining a text index filter with `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` stopped answering the filter from the index and read the whole text column instead. [#115586](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115586) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#117083](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117083): Fixed a performance regression since 26.6: a query filtering a `Nullable` column with `IN (subquery)` read the whole table instead of skipping the read when the subquery returned no rows. Closes [#116450](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116450). [#116538](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116538) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#117291](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117291): Sped up SQL function `formatDateTime` with non-const timezone arguments. [#116851](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116851) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#116509](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116509): A `bloom_filter` skip index on an `Array` column is now used for `arrayJoin(column) IN (set)`, `arrayJoin(column) GLOBAL IN (set)` and `arrayJoin(column) = const`, the same way it was already used for `hasAny(column, set)` and `has(column, const)`. Previously these `arrayJoin ...` forms fell back to a full scan. [#109536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109536) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116298](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116298): Use the `bloom_filter` skip index for `IN` predicates on a directly indexed column when `transform_null_in = 1` and the `IN`-set contains no `NULL` value. Previously the index was skipped for such queries, forcing a full scan. [#111329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111329) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115794): Added a new MergeTree setting `text_index_version` that controls the on-disk format version of text indexes: `v0_initial`, `v1_with_codec`, or `v2_with_positions`. During a rolling upgrade or before a downgrade, set it to an older version so that newer servers keep writing text index parts in a format older servers can still read; the compatibility setting automatically adjusts it. [#111803](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111803) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#113821](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113821): Added fs cache download wait timeout configured by `filesystem_cache_wait_for_concurrent_download_timeout_milliseconds`. This timeout defined only the wait for a single chunk (buffer bytes of ~1mb) of data, not the whole file segment. [#113322](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113322) ([Kseniia Sumarokova](https://github.com/kssenii)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#116680](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116680): Fixed Kafka tables using `kafka_sasl_mechanism = 'AWS_MSK_IAM'` failing authentication once an hour with `SASL authentication error: Access denied`. The OAUTHBEARER token lifetime advertised to librdkafka is now capped by the remaining validity of the AWS credentials that signed the token, so the next token refresh is always scheduled before those credentials expire. Successful token refreshes are now logged, and unhelpful ClickHouse-side stack traces are omitted from broker-originated SASL errors in `system.kafka_consumers`. [#109125](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109125) ([kalavt](https://github.com/kalavt)).
* Backported in [#117050](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117050): Constant folding during query planning no longer executes a function whose argument type differs from the type the function was resolved for during analysis. Such a mismatch used to raise a `LOGICAL_ERROR` while the output header was being computed, which is an assertion failure in debug and sanitizer builds. Folding is now skipped instead, and a genuinely invalid query still reports a recoverable `ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT` error from the normal execution path. [#109747](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109747) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116192](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116192): Fix a data race (and rare crash) when a parsing/analysis error is reported while reading a file/object storage table. A parse error raised during lazy `KeyCondition` initialization was shared as a single exception object across reader threads, and two threads could concurrently append `(in file/uri ...)` to its message, racing on the exception message string. [#109911](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109911) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117392](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117392): Fix `CREATE OR REPLACE` leaving the replaced object behind under an internal name when the caller lacks the drop privilege on it. [#111466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111466) ([Nikolay Degterinsky](https://github.com/evillique)).
* Backported in [#116390](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116390): Fixes a `bloom_filter` skip index dropping granules that contain matching rows when a `String` or `FixedString` column is compared for equality against a constant that is wider than the indexed type, so that queries such as `SELECT count() FROM t WHERE s = toFixedString('abc', 5)` no longer silently return too few rows. [#112639](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112639) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117196](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117196): Fixes two cases where an AWS Glue `DataLakeCatalog` database reported a table as absent instead of reporting an error. `SHOW TABLES` and `system.tables` no longer fail with `DATALAKE_DATABASE_ERROR` ("Exception calling GetTables ... not found") when a Glue database is absent while its tables are listed, for example because an unrelated database in the same AWS account was dropped concurrently; such a database now contributes no tables instead of aborting the listing. `EXISTS TABLE` no longer answers `0` for a table that exists when the underlying `GetTable` call fails for a reason other than the table being absent, such as an authentication, DNS or 5xx failure. Every other Glue error still propagates in both paths. [#113591](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113591) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116219](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116219): Fixed `Logical error: 'Files metadata is empty'` when reading from, altering, or flushing an `S3Queue`/`AzureQueue` table whose metadata handle is gone: concurrently with a `DROP`/`DETACH`, after a failed `startup`, or after a failed `DROP`. Such a table now reports `TABLE_IS_DROPPED` instead. `SYSTEM FLUSH OBJECT STORAGE QUEUE` on such a table no longer crashes the server. [#113695](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113695) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116766](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116766): Fix a crash for `ORDER BY ALL` in a `WINDOW VIEW`, and `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` errors for `INTERPOLATE`, `WINDOW` and `LIMIT BY` in a query over a `Merge` or `Distributed` table with a join, with the old analyzer. [#113759](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113759) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116962](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116962): Fixes `ORDER BY ... LIMIT` queries on `Tuple()` columns raising a `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` exception when top-K dynamic filtering is enabled. Direct empty tuples now skip the optimization, while supported nested composite types continue to use top-K filtering. [#114182](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114182) ([Langning Zhang](https://github.com/Boulea7)).
* Backported in [#115561](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115561): Fix `std::out_of_range: map::at: key not found` when a `MergeTree` key expression contains a `mortonEncode` or `hilbertEncode` call that is not itself a key column, for example `ORDER BY mortonEncode(hilbertEncode(x, y), x, y)` or `PARTITION BY mortonEncode(x, y) % 4`. [#114233](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114233) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116098](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116098): Register Iceberg namespace in the catalog before writing table files (needed for SeaweedFS). [#114285](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114285) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).
* Backported in [#116466](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116466): Fixes a server abort (`Logical error: Part patch-... doesn't exist`) when a `DROP TABLE` runs concurrently with a lightweight `UPDATE` on a `ReplicatedMergeTree` table. The update now holds the table's shared lock until its patch part is committed, so the `DROP` waits instead of removing it. [#114826](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114826) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116194](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116194): The AI-function quota settings (`ai_function_max_api_calls_per_query`, `ai_function_max_input_tokens_per_query`, `ai_function_max_output_tokens_per_query`) were enforced per block rather than per query, letting a query exceed the configured limit in proportion to the number of blocks and threads processed. They now bound the whole query per server: the API-call limit is an exact cap (atomic reservation), and the token limits are best-effort. A distributed query enforces the limits independently on each participating server / fragment. [#114885](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114885) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#115859](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115859): Fixed a hang when dropping a `TimeSeries` table whose name sorts lexicographically below its inner tables' names, for example `` DROP TABLE `-ts` `` or dropping a materialized view declared with `ENGINE = TimeSeries`. The drop self-deadlocked on the DDL guard and could not be cancelled with `KILL QUERY`. [#114953](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114953) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116536): Fixed an out-of-bounds read while deserializing corrupted posting lists of a text index. [#115222](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115222) ([Anton Popov](https://github.com/CurtizJ)).
* Backported in [#115815](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115815): Fixed a row policy bypass where the mergeTreeIndex table function exposed primary key and minmax index values of the rows hidden by a SELECT row policy on the source table; reading mergeTreeIndex for a table with a row policy is now denied. [#115304](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115304) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#116411](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116411): Fixes asynchronous inserts into `JSON` columns ignoring the `max_dynamic_subcolumns_in_json_type_parsing` setting. Previously, an asynchronous insert (`async_insert = 1`) could store more dynamic paths than the setting allows, giving a different column layout than a synchronous insert with the same settings. The cap is now preserved when asynchronous inserts aggregate parsed data. [#115329](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115329) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Backported in [#116266](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116266): Fixed a bypass of settings constraints: `SET <name> = DEFAULT` reset a setting without checking the constraints from the user's profile, so a `MIN`/`MAX`/`CONST` constraint could be escaped by resetting the setting instead of assigning to it, and a session could leave readonly mode with `SET readonly = DEFAULT`. [#115334](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115334) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117156](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117156): Fixed a settings-constraint bypass: a `SETTINGS` clause inside a subquery, a CTE or a view's inner query was applied without checking the settings constraints, so it could be used to leave readonly mode or to override a `CONST`, `MIN` or `MAX` constraint (for example `additional_table_filters`, breaking row-level isolation). The nested clause is now clamped to the constraints: violating changes are dropped, out-of-bounds values are clamped into their bounds, and the rest of the clause applies. Existing views whose inner query carries such a clause keep working, with the constraints enforced; a clause on the outer query still throws, as before. [#115397](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115397) ([Itamar Tempelhof](https://github.com/tempel-it)).
* Backported in [#116404](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116404): Validate Variant discriminator in ColumnVariant arena deserialization. [#115443](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115443) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).
* Backported in [#115754](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115754): Fix `read_rows`, `read_bytes`, `written_rows` and `written_bytes` in `system.query_thread_log` reporting a thread lifetime running total instead of the values for the logged query. Rows of long-lived pooled threads, in particular the query's initiating `HTTPHandler` thread, were affected. [#115596](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115596) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115845](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115845): Allow KeeperMap readers to accept shared metadata when equivalent primary keys differ only by redundant outer parentheses. [#115642](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115642) ([Sergey Kuznetsov](https://github.com/skuznetsov-clickhouse)).
* Backported in [#115731](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115731): Fixed a bug in the function `formatRowNoNewline` that could produce incorrect results or a logical error when a row is formatted to an empty result. [#115669](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115669) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115955](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115955): Fix server crashes on deeply nested input in `readWKB`, `JSONMergePatch`, the address parser of the `url`/`remote`/`cluster`/`mysql`/`postgresql` table functions, the `CURSOR` clause parser and the CapnProto schema parser. Fix a crash in the parser of the `EXECUTE` statement when an argument is not a literal. [#115700](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115700) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116353](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116353): Validate the states of the `stochasticLinearRegression`, `stochasticLogisticRegression`, `groupUniqArray`, `groupArrayIntersect` and `topK` aggregate functions and of the `Resample` combinator on deserialization: a malformed state could be read out of bounds. [#115701](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115701) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116653](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116653): Fix crashes of the Parquet, ORC and Iceberg readers on malformed input: a `DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY` page with an empty length stream, a `DELTA_BYTE_ARRAY` page of a `Decimal` column read under a filter, an out-of-range enum in an Iceberg manifest file and an oversized allocation in the ORC library. [#115703](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115703) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#115930](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115930): Do not return uninitialized memory in the result of a binary string literal whose length is not a multiple of eight, and from the LZ4 decompressor when a compressed block has no body. [#115704](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115704) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117060](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117060): Fix a crash of a window function over a `Tuple` with a sparse element, for example `groupConcat(t) OVER ()`. [#115705](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115705) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116004](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116004): Bound the size of the startup message of the PostgreSQL wire protocol, which is read before authentication. [#115708](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115708) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116715](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116715): Reject unsupported and mixed read/write operations in ZooKeeper multi requests. [#115768](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115768) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#116439](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116439): Mask the `aws_external_id` setting of the `DataLakeCatalog` database engine in `SHOW CREATE DATABASE` and `system.databases.engine_full`. It was previously printed in plaintext, unlike the other AWS credential settings. Closes: [#114999](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/114999). [#115791](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115791) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116118](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116118): Reject invalid names of projections and indexes. [#115824](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115824) ([Alexander Tokmakov](https://github.com/tavplubix)).
* Backported in [#116015](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116015): Add Objects' paths to deduplication hashing, preventing incorrect deduplication. [#115866](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115866) ([Mikhail f. Shiryaev](https://github.com/Felixoid)).
* Fixed a `TABLE ENGINE` privilege bypass in the `URL` table engine. A user granted only `TABLE ENGINE ON URL` could `ATTACH TABLE ... ENGINE = URL('file://...')` (or `s3://`, `az://`, `hdfs://`) and read through it, because the privilege re-check on the backend the scheme dispatches to ran only for `CREATE`. It now runs for every statement that supplies a fresh definition, `ATTACH` and `RESTORE` included, while a definition replayed from the server's own metadata stays exempt so existing tables keep loading. [#115966](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115966) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116524](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116524): Fix a crash of the `showCertificate` function on a server that obtains its TLS certificate with ACME (Let's Encrypt). The function now reports the certificate that is actually served, also after a certificate reload. [#115976](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115976) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#116747](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116747): You can now read Iceberg v2 tables whose manifests omit the optional `snapshot_id` column, such as tables managed by BigQuery; reading one previously failed with `Cannot find column snapshot_id`. A manifest that omits `sequence_number` is also no longer read as sequence number 0. Both values are inherited from the manifest list, as the Iceberg spec requires. [#116040](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116040) ([Takayuki Enomoto](https://github.com/tkykenmt)).
* Backported in [#116143](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116143): Fix stateless workers crash with object storage. [#116067](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116067) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#116710](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116710): Fix wrong window function results for `PARTITION BY` over a floating-point key (also `JSON`, `Dynamic`, and these types nested in `Nullable`/`LowCardinality`/`Array`/`Tuple`/`Map`/`Variant`) with `max_threads > 1`: values that compare as equal, such as `-0.` and `0.`, could hash into different threads, and one logical partition got several window frames. [#116315](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116315) ([Alexander Gololobov](https://github.com/davenger)).
* Backported in [#116494](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116494): KeeperMap now writes single-expression primary keys without redundant outer parentheses, so metadata created by newer servers remains readable by ClickHouse 26.4 during supported rolling upgrades and rollbacks. [#116369](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116369) ([Sergey Kuznetsov](https://github.com/skuznetsov-clickhouse)).
* Backported in [#117056](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117056): Fixed a `WHERE _table = ...` or `WHERE _database = ...` condition over a `Merge` table silently returning no rows when the matching child table reads its data from other tables, for example a `Distributed`, `Merge`, `Buffer`, or `Alias` child. Such children are now always read, and the condition filters their rows. [#116371](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116371) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117367](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117367): Fix a `bloom_filter` skip index returning fewer rows for `IN` on an `Array` column when the set contains an empty array, for example `WHERE x IN ([])`. [#116449](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116449) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117374](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117374): Fixed a 404 (`S3_ERROR`) when reading an Iceberg table through a path that is a parent of the table directory, with the metadata document named by the `iceberg_metadata_file_path` setting: every data and manifest key was resolved against the queried path, so the directories between it and the table were dropped from the key. Writes and maintenance operations on such a table are now refused instead of acting outside the table. [#117037](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117037) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#117087](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117087): Fix flaky 03151_unload_index_race: fleet-wide reader starvation guard. [#110502](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110502) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117085](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117085): Fix flaky test_kafka_formats_with_broken_message. [#111701](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111701) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#115243](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115243): This patch: 1. Removes the global error screen (blue screen) and replaces it with a note above the dashboards. In this approach, on any error, already fetched graphs will not be hidden. 2. Dashboard now opens the graphs view immediately. 3. Reload button and any other button can be pressed during runtime refresh - this will cancel all in-flight queries and start a new refresh with the new configuration immediately. 4. Newly added graphs do not trigger a full page refresh; only new graphs will be fetched. [#115019](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115019) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Fix `02995_new_settings_history` on the 26.7 branch. [#116868](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116868) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
