# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.7.92-stable (e525f3a6cf7) FIXME as compared to v26.7.6.57-stable (bf82ad6cfcb)

#### Backward Incompatible Change
* Backported in [#118548](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118548): Reading a `File` source with `rename_files_after_processing` set now requires the `WRITE ON FILE` grant on top of `READ ON FILE`, on the initiator for `fileCluster`: the setting renames the files a `SELECT` has read, which is a write to the source, and it used to happen for anyone who could read them. A query relying on it now needs `GRANT WRITE ON FILE`. A per-query renaming rule is also no longer cached by a `Filesystem` database, where it could make an unrelated later query rename files, or be dropped silently. [#117895](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117895) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).

#### New Feature
* Backported in [#119436](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119436): Jemalloc Fragmentation Profiler. [#115456](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115456) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).

#### Performance Improvement
* Backported in [#117531](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117531): Avoid eager JSON serialization of Iceberg manifest entries when iceberg_metadata_log_level is below the call site's threshold. [#110437](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110437) ([Andy Bradshaw](https://github.com/andybradshaw)).
* Backported in [#117643](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117643): Fix performance regression introduced in 26.4 when writing `JSON` and `Dynamic` columns in text formats. [#115852](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115852) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#116283](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116283): Fixed a CPU regression for queries that issue many independent small reads against the same `MergeTree` part when the table has `LowCardinality` columns. The check deciding whether a part has a single shared dictionary scanned every mark of the whole part on each read task; it now finds each run of equal marks by binary search instead. Queries of this shape on tables with a small `index_granularity` were up to several times slower since 26.6. [#116134](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116134) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119278](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119278): Shard the serialization object pool to reduce lock contention and avoid a heap allocation on every serialization lookup. [#116869](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116869) ([Manuel](https://github.com/raimannma)).
* Backported in [#118454](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118454): The bound on the cost of estimating the selectivity of `col IN (...)` from column statistics, controlled by `statistics_max_set_size_for_exact_selectivity_estimation`, is now also applied when `compatibility` is set to 26.6 or an earlier version. [#118095](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118095) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#116859](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116859): Support `Decimal` types when writing into Iceberg tables, including decimal partition columns and decimal min/max statistics. [#115832](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115832) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119289](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119289): Log when an object storage listing returns an empty page while reporting that more objects follow. This is legal and is handled correctly, but it has twice been the trigger for silently losing objects and nothing recorded that it occurred. [#119065](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119065) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#119004](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119004): Fixes silent data loss for TTL expressions that apply large intervals directly to `Date` / `DateTime` source columns by widening the arithmetic away from 16/32-bit overflow. [#101793](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/101793) ([BoloniniD](https://github.com/BoloniniD)).
* Backported in [#117676](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117676): Fixed incorrect SQL literal escaping in `StorageSQLite` and `sqlite()` table function when pushing `WHERE` predicates to SQLite: single quotes and control characters (`\n`, `\r`, `\t`, `\`) were escaped with backslashes, which SQLite does not interpret, causing syntax errors or wrong query results. Also fixed the escaping of string literals pushed down to PostgreSQL: strings nested inside `IN` lists kept ClickHouse escaping, and control characters were sent as backslash sequences that PostgreSQL reads back as different bytes. [#104217](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/104217) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#118068](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118068): Fixed SQL injection in the PostgreSQL wire protocol emulation. Prepared-statement parameters — the `Parse`/`Bind`/`Execute` extended-query path used by `psycopg2`, JDBC, `node-postgres`, Npgsql and others, and the simple-query `EXECUTE` path — were substituted into the executed SQL by raw string splicing, so a crafted parameter could break out of its value position and inject SQL. Parameters are now bound as data. This also fixes string parameters that previously failed with `UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER` when a client sent them unquoted. [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/108469) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118923](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118923): Rejects non-monotonic `Array` offsets on every read path that decodes them as absolute values, instead of only in the `Native` format. A corrupt `set` skip index granule previously passed unchecked and was then read out of bounds. [#109212](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109212) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117854](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117854): Fixed a privilege-escalation gap where the `executable` table function did not enforce the `TABLE ENGINE ON Executable` grant. With `table_engines_require_grant` enabled, a user denied `CREATE TABLE ... ENGINE = Executable` could still run the same server-side script via `SELECT ... FROM executable(...)`. It now requires `GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON Executable`, matching `CREATE TABLE`. [#109331](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/109331) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119611](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119611): Fixed potential data loss when an `INSERT` into `ReplicatedMergeTree` was cancelled or timed out while ClickHouse was recovering an uncertain Keeper commit. [#111196](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111196) ([kakao-tars-case](https://github.com/kakao-tars-case)).
* Backported in [#118763](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118763): Fixed a SQL injection in the PostgreSQL metadata queries. The `schema` of the `PostgreSQL` database engine, the requested column names and the publication name were formatted into SQL literals without escaping, so a value containing a quote could execute arbitrary SQL on the connected PostgreSQL server as the role ClickHouse connects with. Reaching it through `schema` needed only `CREATE DATABASE` plus use of a named collection whose `schema` is overridable. [#111516](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111516) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#118576](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118576): Fix `count()` on Iceberg tables whose snapshot summary is inaccurate or corrupted: the trivial count optimization now derives exact row counts from the manifest files, and falls back to a real scan when row-level deletes make metadata counts inexact. Also fix Iceberg `OPTIMIZE TABLE` writing incorrect manifest-list counts and lineage, and make `totalBytes` metadata robust against corrupted summaries. [#111617](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111617) ([Melvyn Peignon](https://github.com/melvynator)).
* Backported in [#117507](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117507): Fix Iceberg tables written by ClickHouse being unreadable by external readers (PyIceberg, Spark). The Avro schemas embedded in the manifest-list and manifest files omitted the Iceberg `field-id` properties, so scan planning failed with `Cannot convert field, missing field-id`. [#111786](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111786) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117500](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117500): Fix `allow_feature_tier` rejecting `merge_tree_`-prefixed settings in settings profiles as unknown, and rejecting `CREATE TABLE` because of `MergeTree` settings set by the server through `compatibility` or the `merge_tree` config section. Also fix constraints on a `merge_tree_`-prefixed setting being bypassed when the setting is written through its alias, and a statement that rewrites the value such a setting already has being refused by a `CONST` constraint. [#113156](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113156) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118728](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118728): Fixed `LOGICAL_ERROR` when reading a table with a `set` skip index defined on an expression and the query repeats that expression with a `Nullable` operand, for example `WHERE intDiv(id, (SELECT 1000)) = 3` over `INDEX b_set intDiv(id, 1000) TYPE set(100)`. A scalar subquery is enough to trigger it, since it is typed `Nullable`. [#113244](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113244) ([George Larionov](https://github.com/george-larionov)).
* Backported in [#118595](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118595): Fixed a data race and a use-after-free on the metadata of a DeltaLake or Iceberg table. Two concurrent queries that read `total_rows` or `total_bytes` from `system.tables` for the same table could have one query replace the table's metadata while the other was still reading it, which could crash the server. Closes [#113265](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113265). [#113427](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113427) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117414): Fix wrong statistics part pruning for negated float predicates with NaN. [#113507](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113507) ([Han Fei](https://github.com/hanfei1991)).
* Backported in [#117672](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117672): Fixes memory leaks of abandoned nested aggregate states. [#113926](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113926) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119548](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119548): Apply `remote_url_allow_hosts` before SQL-supplied S3 and Azure endpoints send schema, metadata, or container requests. [#114357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114357) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#119482](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119482): Fixed a `LOGICAL_ERROR: Context has expired` exception when a stored expression containing `accurateCastOrDefault` or a `to<Type>OrDefault` function is evaluated after the query that created it has finished, for example a `MATERIALIZED` column default on `INSERT` or a mutation expression. [#114769](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114769) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117934](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117934): Fix wrong results when a filter on a combined literal+sub-object `JSON` subcolumn (``json.@`a``) was analyzed against a `JSONAllPaths` skip index: the subcolumn was treated as a path literally named `` @`a` ``, so all granules were skipped and the query returned fewer rows than it should. [#114873](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114873) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#118253](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118253): Fixed incremental backups to Azure Blob Storage storing the beginning of each file instead of its tail. Restoring such a backup silently dropped all the data written after the base backup. [#114975](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114975) ([Smita Kulkarni](https://github.com/SmitaRKulkarni)).
* Backported in [#117690](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117690): Fixed an exception (`Block structure mismatch in Expression for FilterSortedStreamByRange`) for some `SELECT ... FINAL` queries with `PREWHERE` over a table whose sorting key is an expression. [#115113](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115113) ([Shaohua Wang](https://github.com/tiandiwonder)).
* Backported in [#117752](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117752): Fixed silently incorrect results and undefined behavior when reading a malformed `AggregateFunction(uniq, ...)` state. The `skip_degree` field of the serialized state was used as a shift exponent without validation, so an out-of-range value produced an arbitrary cardinality instead of an error. Such states are now rejected with `INCORRECT_DATA`. [#115276](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115276) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118106](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118106): Fixed wrong results from `if`, `multiIf` and `CASE` when one branch is a `Date` or `Date32` and the result type is `DateTime` or `DateTime64`. With `compile_expressions = 1` (the default) the compiled expression copied the date's day count into the timestamp column without converting days to seconds, so `if(cond, toDate32('1900-01-01'), toDateTime64('1970-01-01', 3))` returned `1969-12-31 23:59:34.433`. Closes [#115272](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115272). [#115325](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115325) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117472](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117472): Fix a case where expensive ZooKeeper exception logging could delay session finalization and leave pending requests unresolved. [#115396](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115396) ([Antonio Andelic](https://github.com/antonio2368)).
* Backported in [#115782](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/115782): Fix `GroupingAggregatedTransform` producing duplicate chunks for the same bucket. [#115487](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115487) ([Nikita Taranov](https://github.com/nickitat)).
* Backported in [#117664](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117664): Reject a bare carriage return (`\r`), in addition to a line feed (`\n`), in HTTP header names and values that pass through the HTTP header filter. This closes an HTTP header injection (request/response splitting) gap for features that pass user-provided headers, such as the `url` table function and engine, HTTP dictionaries, and data lake catalogs. [#115510](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115510) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#118201](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118201): Fix an integer overflow in the deserialization of `String` values in the binary formats, and bound the recursion of the binary deserialization of `Dynamic` and `JSON` values. [#115702](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115702) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118678](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118678): Fix a use-after-free in the gRPC server when a query with a streaming input finishes while a read of the next message is still in flight. [#115707](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115707) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119657](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119657): Fix `LOGICAL_ERROR: No available columns` when a query reads no columns from a table expression that has no columns at all, for example `SELECT count() FROM loop(db, tbl)` where `tbl` is an `Alias` table whose target was dropped, or a parameterized view. Such a query now fails with `UNSUPPORTED_METHOD` instead of aborting the server in debug and sanitizer builds. [#115716](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115716) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117640](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117640): Fixed `ILLEGAL_COLUMN` ("Cannot convert column ... because it is non constant in source stream but must be constant in result") for a query combining `ARRAY JOIN` with a filter on an empty `IN` set, whether the set is an empty list such as `SELECT count() FROM t ARRAY JOIN [b] AS x WHERE a IN ()` or an empty `ENGINE = Set` table. Closes [#116018](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116018). ### Description. [#116057](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116057) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117930](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117930): Fixed the `Unexpected return type from materialize` logical error when reading a column that has a `text` index through the index after a metadata-only or not-yet-materialized `ALTER MODIFY COLUMN` (including lazy JSON type hints) that requires a read-time type conversion. [#116549](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116549) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#118567](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118567): Fixed `h3Line` returning uninitialized memory in the tail of the result array when a line between two valid H3 indices cannot be drawn because it crosses pentagon distortion. Such a call now throws `INCORRECT_DATA`. [#116583](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116583) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117658](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117658): Fixed wrong results from `sumKahan` when the aggregated batch does not start at the first row of the block. `sumKahanIf`, and `sumKahan` over a `Nullable` argument, tested each row against the wrong element of the condition or null map, returning silently incorrect sums inside window frames such as `ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW`, in parallel `GROUP BY`, and under `optimize_aggregation_in_order = 1`. [#116990](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116990) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118249](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118249): Fixed reading uninitialized memory as literal data when decompressing a malformed `LZ4`-compressed block. [#116992](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116992) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118081](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118081): Fixed a stack overflow when reading hadoop-snappy data containing many blocks that decode to nothing. [#116994](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116994) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118075](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118075): The handshake response of the MySQL wire protocol is now bounded, so a client can no longer make the server grow memory during the handshake. The `mysql_require_secure_transport` server setting is now enforced from the actual state of the connection instead of a capability bit advertised by the client. [#117003](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117003) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117151](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117151): Sizes declared by a server in the Native protocol no longer make the client allocate memory for data that has not arrived: exception strings are read as they arrive, the decompressed size of a block is bounded, and the maximum number of rows in a `Native` block is now a billion. [#117011](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117011) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118140](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118140): Fix background `Distributed` inserts that deleted unsent spool files after a split batch got a transient error. ClickHouse now keeps the files and retries the batch. [#117034](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117034) ([Rory Shanks](https://github.com/rorylshanks)).
* Backported in [#117861](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117861): Check the overflow when allocating a block of aggregate function states on deserialization: a malformed `Native` block could make the server write out of bounds. [#117370](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117370) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118020](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118020): Fix a path traversal on `RESTORE`. A backup metadata entry whose `<name>` was not already in normal form, for example one containing `//` or fewer `..` than the depth of its own directory prefix, was validated in normalized form but stored verbatim, so restoring the part wrote the entry outside the part's directory while `RESTORE` reported success. Such names are now rejected with `INSECURE_PATH`. [#117371](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117371) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118647](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118647): Fixes a case where GROUP BY emits a group from a zero-row block, returning a row with `count() = 0`. Closes [#116830](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116830). [#117503](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117503) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#118810](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118810): Hide the credentials that a setting value can carry, such as the password in `format_avro_schema_registry_url` or `url_base`, everywhere a setting value is displayed or logged. `system.query_log`, `system.processes`, `system.settings`, `system.settings_profile_elements`, `system.session_log`, `system.distributed_ddl_queue`, `SHOW CREATE USER` and `SHOW CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` previously showed them in plaintext to any user who could read them. [#117523](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117523) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#118144](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118144): Several aggregate function deserializers allocated memory from a size declared in the serialized state before reading the payload, so a state of a few bytes could request gigabytes. They now read only what the buffer already holds. [#117536](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117536) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118028): Fixed a bug where the `analyzer_inline_views` setting could bypass the `SELECT` access check on a view, letting a user without a grant on the view read its contents. [#117555](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117555) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#118065](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118065): `ENGINE = EmbeddedRocksDB(ttl, rocksdb_dir, read_only)` with an explicit `rocksdb_dir` now requires the `FILE` source grant that `file` requires for the same directory: `READ ON FILE` to create such a table, plus `WRITE ON FILE` when `read_only = 0`. Previously it required no source grant, so a user holding only `CREATE TABLE` in a database of their own could point a table at another table's directory and read its rows. `ON CLUSTER` and `Replicated`-database DDL are not covered: the replay runs with no user. The argument-less form is unaffected. Backward incompatible for anyone already using an explicit `rocksdb_dir` without them. [#117665](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117665) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
* Backported in [#117888](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117888): Fix rseq on amd64 (was never used in release binaries). [#117700](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117700) ([Azat Khuzhin](https://github.com/azat)).
* Backported in [#117848](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117848): Fixed `format_schema_source='query'` running the schema query with full privileges when used from a background task, such as a streaming engine consumer (`Kafka`, `NATS`, `RabbitMQ`, `ObjectStorageQueue`) or a `Buffer` background flush. The schema query is now rejected there; use `format_schema_source='file'` or `'string'` instead, or pre-populate the schema cache. [#117737](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117737) ([Pavel Kruglov](https://github.com/Avogar)).
* Backported in [#119112](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119112): Fixed OOM when reading parquet file with invalid `num_children` field in schema. [#117797](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117797) ([Michael Kolupaev](https://github.com/al13n321)).
* Backported in [#118035](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118035): Fixes a potential out-of-bounds write of function `formatDateTimeInJodaSyntax` when called with a time zone name longer than 32 characters. [#117925](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117925) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).
* Backported in [#118326](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118326): `CREATE USER OR REPLACE` and the `OR REPLACE` form of `CREATE ROLE`, `CREATE QUOTA`, `CREATE SETTINGS PROFILE` and `CREATE ROW POLICY` now require the corresponding `DROP` privilege in addition to `CREATE`, because they overwrite an existing entity. Previously `CREATE USER` alone was enough to reset the password of any other user, including a privileged one. [#117960](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117960) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#118179](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118179): Fix `EXPLAIN QUERY TREE` and `EXPLAIN SYNTAX` exposing column names and types of tables the user has no privileges for: the analyzer now checks that the user may see at least one column of the table at the moment a table identifier is resolved. The check also makes the error kind independent of whether the queried column exists and stops recording column names the user may not see into `missing_privileges` of the query log. Closes [#78938](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/78938). [#117979](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117979) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119515](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119515): Expressions supplied through the `additional_table_filters` and `parallel_replicas_custom_key` settings are now subject to the column-level `SELECT` check, and are no longer injected into the body of `SQL SECURITY DEFINER` or `NONE` views. Previously a user could evaluate predicates over columns they were not granted. [#118063](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118063) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#118206](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118206): Fix complex types schema evolution typos. [#118127](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118127) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119526](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119526): `format_display_secrets_in_show_and_select` works as expected in EXPLAIN. [#118129](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118129) ([Kirill Kopnev](https://github.com/Fgrtue)).
* Backported in [#118340](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118340): `TRUNCATE DATABASE ... ON CLUSTER` and `TRUNCATE [ALL] TABLES FROM ... ON CLUSTER` ran without checking any privilege: a user holding only `SELECT` and `CLUSTER` could destroy every table in a database, and `readonly = 1` did not prevent it. Both now require `DROP DATABASE`, the privilege the non-cluster spellings have always required. [#118155](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118155) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118290](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118290): Fixed a privilege escalation in implicit access-rights computation: holding any single child privilege of the `ALTER TABLE` group (for example `ALTER MODIFY COMMENT`) on a view implicitly conferred the entire `ALTER VIEW` group, so such a user could run `ALTER TABLE <view> MODIFY QUERY` and rewrite the view's query. `ALTER VIEW` is now implied only by the complete `ALTER TABLE` grant. A deployment that relied on a partial `ALTER TABLE` grant to alter views must now grant `ALTER VIEW` (or one of its members) or the full `ALTER TABLE` explicitly. [#118194](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118194) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118745](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118745): A simple `Query` in the PostgreSQL wire protocol now destroys the unnamed prepared statement and the unnamed portal, as PostgreSQL does, so a later `Bind` or `Execute` on them is rejected instead of silently reusing stale extended-query state. A `Flush` or unimplemented message sent outside an extended-query cycle also no longer leaves the connection unable to answer further queries; that half only affects unreleased code from [#108469](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/108469). [#118210](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118210) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118592](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118592): Fixed `SELECT count()` returning too many rows for a negated comparison (`!=`, `NOT IN`, `NOT LIKE`) over a `Nullable` primary key column: the exact-count optimization counted the NULL-key rows that the `WHERE` condition rejects. [#118214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118214) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119695](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119695): Fixed the server deserializing the payload of a `Data` packet that arrives on a connection before any query. In interserver mode the connection is not authenticated until the `Query` packet is processed, so such a packet was rejected only after its Native block had been read, which let an unauthenticated peer choose the column type the server constructed. The packet is now rejected before its payload is touched. [#118588](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118588) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119253](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119253): Proper partition pruning with dates. Closes [#103433](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/103433). [#118606](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118606) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#118694](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118694): Fixed object storage listing silently skipping objects when S3 returns an empty page together with a continuation token. This could make a `plain_rewritable` disk appear empty and hide table parts, and could make data lake tables read a stale snapshot. [#118615](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118615) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#119022](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119022): Fix a crash and wrong results when reading the `DWARF` format with column types other than the ones the format produces, for example `SELECT * FROM file('a.elf', DWARF, 'tag String')`. Requesting a column that does not exist in the format now reports a proper error instead of `std::out_of_range`. [#118794](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118794) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).
* Backported in [#119676](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119676): Fixed a server crash that could happen when a `WORKLOAD` setting limiting concurrency (e.g. `max_concurrent_queries` or `max_bytes_inflight`) was lowered below the number of currently in-flight resource requests while the workload was active. [#118836](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118836) ([Sergei Trifonov](https://github.com/serxa)).
* Backported in [#119310](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119310): Fixed an out-of-bounds access that could happen with `getURLHostRFC` function. [#119026](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119026) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119485](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119485): Fixed a `Filesystem` database serving a table from its internal cache without the `READ ON FILE` grant. The grant was checked only while a table name was resolved for the first time, so once any user holding it had read a name, every user with `SELECT` on the database was served the contents of the file. `EXISTS TABLE`, which requires only `SHOW TABLES`, answered from that cache and probed the directory without the grant too. Both now require it, and a user without it is refused before the existence of the file is observed. [#119029](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119029) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119414): Fix statistics computation on top of azure storage. [#119369](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119369) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).

#### Build/Testing/Packaging Improvement
* Backported in [#119052](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119052): Update `libxml2` to 2.15.4. [#118649](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118649) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).
* Backported in [#119344](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119344): Update `openssl` to 3.5.8. [#118927](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118927) ([Actuele AI](https://github.com/actueleai)).

#### NO CL ENTRY

* NO CL ENTRY:  'Backport macOS prod-key signing cutover to 26.7'. [#118846](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118846) ([Rahul Nair](https://github.com/motsc)).
* NO CL ENTRY:  'Backport prod Apple Developer ID cert to 26.7'. [#118859](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118859) ([Rahul Nair](https://github.com/motsc)).
* NO CL ENTRY:  'Revert "Backport [#118606](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118606) to 26.7: Proper partition pruning with dates"'. [#119431](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119431) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#118330](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118330): CI: bound each docker buildx invocation in the Docker image jobs. [#113869](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113869) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#118873](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118873): Make `04661_refreshable_mv_cancel_during_planning` robust on slow runners. [#113960](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/113960) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119287](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119287): Keep the SeaweedFS mini admin gRPC port out of the ephemeral range. [#115512](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115512) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117362](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117362): This patch fixes `removePartAndCoveredParts` when it is being called for a part that is actually present in the active data part set. The problem was that part itself will always be in `parts_covered_by,` so the subsequent remove in the loop will not be able to remove it twice. [#115640](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115640) ([Mikhail Artemenko](https://github.com/Michicosun)).
* Backported in [#118861](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118861): Do not report "Server died" when the server is stalled but alive. [#115692](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115692) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119670](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119670): Do not let an unparsable KeeperMap metadata node stop the server from starting. [#115941](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115941) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#116924](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/116924): Refactor CollectSetsVisitor to use InDepthQueryTreeVisitorWithContext. [#116561](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116561) ([Dmitry Novik](https://github.com/novikd)).
* Backported in [#119638](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119638): CI: fix integration test session timeouts (shard balance and batch count). [#116591](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116591) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#117864](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117864): Compute the `row_end` offsets index in signed arithmetic in `Aggregator`, fixing a pointer overflow reported by UBSan when an `-Array` combinator aggregate function is given an empty row range. [#116727](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116727) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#117770](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/117770): Internal follow-up correcting an implementation detail from an unreleased change; no user-visible behavior change beyond restoring the intended performance characteristics of https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115852 for `Dynamic(JSON)` text output. [#117655](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/117655) ([Nikita Fomichev](https://github.com/fm4v)).
* Backported in [#118779](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118779): Make 05054_embedded_rocksdb_explicit_dir_file_grant stress-restart safe. [#118220](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118220) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119059](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119059): Update usearch to include the arena capacity limitation fix. [#118828](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118828) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119454](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119454): Do not let a setting masking rule throw. [#119028](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119028) ([Raúl Marín](https://github.com/Algunenano)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.8.15-stable (5cf8a36253e) FIXME as compared to v26.7.7.92-stable (e525f3a6cf7)

#### Experimental Feature
* Backported in [#118802](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/118802): Fix duplicated `GROUP BY` keys in the partial aggregation strategy of `make_distributed_plan`, and allow this strategy for aggregations over a distributed read. [#114523](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114523) ([Alexander Gololobov](https://github.com/davenger)).

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#119200](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119200): Write partition field summaries into the Iceberg manifest list. [#118796](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118796) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119340](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119340): Support parallel replicas for object storage writes. [#119214](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119214) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#119733](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119733): Fixed a `LOGICAL_ERROR` (`Type mismatch when building statistics for column`) during a `MergeTree` mutation of a table whose column type was changed by a metadata-only `ALTER MODIFY COLUMN` (for example `Enum8` to `Int8` or `DateTime` to `UInt32`) while the column carries statistics. The mutation now recomputes only the statistics of columns it actually rewrites and carries the rest over unchanged, and a column rewritten by `MATERIALIZE COLUMN`, by an `UPDATE` of a column a `MATERIALIZED` column depends on, or by `CLEAR COLUMN` now gets its statistics recomputed instead of keeping stale content. [#112009](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112009) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119874](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119874): Fixed a crash when reading a subcolumn of a `Variant`, `Dynamic` or `JSON` column whose own type is `Nullable` or `LowCardinality(Nullable)` from a `MergeTree` table, for example ``SELECT value.`Tuple(a Nullable(UInt32), b String)`.a`` over a `Dynamic` column. Previously such a read hit a `LOGICAL_ERROR` in debug builds and crashed in release builds. [#112338](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112338) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119458](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119458): Fixed Iceberg `INSERT` writing manifest-wide aggregate column statistics into every `data_file` entry when a partition produced more than one data file. Each entry's `null_value_counts`, `column_sizes`, `lower_bounds` and `upper_bounds` now describe only the data file it points at. Previously an entry could report more nulls than the file had rows, so a spec-conforming external reader pruned files that contained matching rows. [#112414](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112414) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119668](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119668): Fixes a server abort in debug and sanitizer builds when inserting into a materialized view whose `TO` target is another materialized view. Such an insert already failed on released versions, with an uninformative `Code: 1001 STD_EXCEPTION`; it now reports `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming the offending view. [#115985](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/115985) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119690](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119690): Fixed a server that refused to start after the directory backing a `Filesystem` database had been removed. Such a database is now loaded without tables and can be inspected and dropped, while a `CREATE DATABASE` or `ATTACH DATABASE` issued by a user is still rejected when the path does not exist. [#118684](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118684) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119418](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119418): Don't use backoffs on concurrent inserts conflicts (when we use Iceberg + catalog, for example). [#119238](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119238) ([Konstantin Vedernikov](https://github.com/scanhex12)).
* Backported in [#119856](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119856): Fixed a crash and a `LOGICAL_ERROR` for statements that write `trim(BOTH '' FROM x)` (or the `LEADING`/`TRAILING` spelling) where a function is expected: a column's `STATISTICS(...)` or `CODEC(...)` list, `INDEX ... TYPE`, `ALTER TABLE ... ADD STATISTICS`, `auto_statistics_types`, a table function, a named collection and `SETTINGS`. The parser folded it into its operand instead of building a `trimBoth` call, and those places cast or dereference the result as a function. The fold also bypassed the function's own checks, so `trim(BOTH '' FROM <non-string>)` now raises `ILLEGAL_TYPE_OF_ARGUMENT` and a `FixedString` argument now yields `String`, as every other `trim` spelling does. [#119317](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119317) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119753](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119753): Fixed a stack buffer overflow when reading a `BIT` column from MySQL, reachable through the `mysql` table function, the `MySQL` table and database engines, and MySQL dictionaries. The length of the value sent by the server was copied without being validated. [#119680](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119680) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#119829](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119829): Fix flaky 04408_array_fold_cancellation under sanitizers. [#110942](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/110942) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119827](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119827): Make the 04780 index-analysis allocation oracle the minimum of several runs. [#114608](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/114608) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119757](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119757): Do not leave a `Filesystem` database pointing at a removed directory, which makes the server refuse to start. [#119618](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119618) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

# 2026 Changelog

### ClickHouse release v26.7.9.12-stable (dcfd8a8ee1f) FIXME as compared to v26.7.8.15-stable (5cf8a36253e)

#### Improvement
* Backported in [#119963](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119963): Bump the internal libssh from 0.12.0 to 0.12.2. [#119262](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119262) ([Robert Schulze](https://github.com/rschu1ze)).

#### Bug Fix (user-visible misbehavior in an official stable release)
* Backported in [#119941](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119941): Fix a logical error `Invalid cast from Nothing to native type` (an abort in debug/sanitizer builds) when `compile_expressions = 1` compiled an expression with a `Nullable(Nothing)` operand, e.g. `and(Nullable(Nothing), <native comparison>)`. [#111508](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/111508) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119973](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119973): Fixes a case where `date_time_overflow_behavior = 'saturate'`, an out-of-range value is clamped to the whole second and the sub-second component is discarded. Closes [#113152](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/113152). [#116122](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116122) ([Yarik Briukhovetskyi](https://github.com/yariks5s)).
* Backported in [#119952](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119952): Fix a segmentation fault when reading in order from a `Merge` table over `MergeTree` tables whose sorting key is shorter than the key prefix chosen for the query: the prefix was forwarded to the underlying reader unchecked, which grew its cloned sorting-key expression list to that length and appended null AST nodes that were then dereferenced. [#116364](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/116364) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#119931](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119931): Fix rows silently dropped by an `ngrambf_v1` index for a `LIKE` pattern with a run of escaped backslashes before a wildcard. [#118673](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118673) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#119912](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119912): Fixed `optimize_or_like_chain` returning extra rows for `OR` chains of `LIKE`/`ILIKE` patterns that do not end in `%`: a value followed by a trailing newline wrongly matched the filter. [#118766](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/118766) ([Jimmy Aguilar Mena](https://github.com/Ergus)).
* Backported in [#119995](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/119995): Fixed an `ALTER` on a view or materialized view with `SQL SECURITY DEFINER` deleting the auto-created `<user>:definer` account when the `ALTER` did not change the definer. Every later `SELECT` from the view, and every `INSERT` into a materialized view's source table, then failed permanently with `There is no user '<user>:definer' in 'user directories'` (`UNKNOWN_USER`). [#119357](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119357) ([Groene AI](https://github.com/groeneai)).
* Backported in [#120019](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120019): Fixed cleartext credentials in `system.asynchronous_insert_log.query`. Secrets of table functions such as `s3`, `url` or `mysql` are now masked as `[HIDDEN]`, the same way `system.query_log` masks them. [#119487](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119487) ([Sema Checherinda](https://github.com/CheSema)).
* Backported in [#120094](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120094): Fixed the server not validating the schema of the second and subsequent data blocks that a client sends for an external table over the native protocol. Such a block could make the data be interpreted as a type other than the one it was sent as. [#119849](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119849) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).
* Backported in [#120015](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120015): Fixed a crash of the server caused by a table with `ENGINE = NATS` whose credentials the broker started to reject, for example after a password rotation or on an expired token. Such a table now recreates its connection and resumes consuming once the credentials are accepted again, instead of staying silently idle. [#119853](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/119853) ([Alexey Milovidov](https://github.com/alexey-milovidov)).

#### NOT FOR CHANGELOG / INSIGNIFICANT

* Backported in [#120006](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/120006): Fix flaky `test_filesystem_split_cache::test_split_cache_system_files_no_eviction`. The baseline System-segment count was sampled straight after `wait_for_cache_initialized`, which only reports that the cache became usable while background loading keeps adding segments, so the baseline was a partially populated snapshot (416 or 467 against a steady state of 701). The assertion was also two-sided (`abs`), so it failed when the count *grew* — the opposite of what a no-eviction test should check, and the cause of every observed failure. Both comparison points now sample once the count has settled, and the assertion only fails on a drop. Fixes failures like this one https://s3.amazonaws.com/clickhouse-test-reports/json.html?PR=111406&sha=6282394660bff978c2f06b63ecfd9f27d28b1e97&name_0=PR&name_1=Integration+tests+%28amd_tsan%2C+3%2F6%29. [#112099](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/pull/112099) ([Pedro Ferreira](https://github.com/PedroTadim)).
